plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

# dsh-skill-install

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) skill installer. From the Web settings page
(Settings → "Skills"), search GitHub repositories by name or paste a repo URL, list the `SKILL.md` skills inside,
tick the ones you want, and install them to a target directory. Integrates with the built-in skill-filesystem, so
installed skills take effect immediately — no restart required.

[中文](README.zh.md)

## Features

- **Search by name / paste a URL**: one input accepts a skill/repo name (searches repos by name), or `owner/repo`
  and `https://github.com/owner/repo` addresses.
- **Only matched repos**: search returns concrete matching repositories; click "Open" to browse their skills.
  There is no full-site discovery feed.
- **Selectable target, global by default**:
  - Global → `<dshHome>/skills` (watched by skill-filesystem by default)
  - Current project → `<project root>/.dsh/skills` (project root = nearest `.git` ancestor, else cwd)
  - Custom directory → any absolute directory; the plugin registers its own skill provider and hot-refreshes it
- **Installed list**: grouped by target directory, one-click removal.
- **Currently loaded skills**: the merged set from the built-in skill-filesystem and this plugin (read-only).
- **Proxy (collapsed entry)**: configure a proxy address, test connectivity, or clear it; requests go through the
  system `curl` when set, direct otherwise.

## Install

```sh
# Local directory — quit the Desktop app first; --profile is required.
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-skill-install

# From GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-skill-install
```

Then restart Harness so the new bundle composes; "Settings → Skills" shows the new page. This package has
**zero external runtime dependencies** (`js-yaml` is bundled as a self-contained ESM build), so a GitHub install
needs no `allowBuilds` code-execution approval.

## Runtime dependencies

- The host plugin is pure ESM with no external runtime dependencies (`js-yaml` is bundled in `js-yaml.mjs`, MIT).
- Extracting the GitHub tarball needs system `tar` (built into Windows 10 1809+); using a proxy needs `curl`.

## Skill-system integration

- Global / project installs write into the standard roots watched by skill-filesystem, so the watcher hot-loads them;
- Custom directories are registered as an independent skill provider via `ctx.skills.registerProvider`, using the
  same discovery rules (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` or `<root>/<name>.md`), invalidated on install / remove / changes;
- All routes and providers are registered with `ctx.effect`, so they are removed automatically on disable / reload.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Strata model server monitor panel for DeepSeek Harness: monitor page, floating window, composer status line.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-strata-monitor

在 DeepSeek Harness 里嵌入 Strata 模型服务器的状态监控面板。
A model-server monitor panel for DeepSeek Harness, mirroring the Strata server's Monitor tab.

## 功能 / Features

- **监控页 / Monitor page**：侧边栏新增图标，展示模型状态（空闲 / 读取提示词 / 生成中 / 排队）、解码与预填充速度、GPU 负载、显存、温度、功耗、PCIe、CPU、磁盘读取（均带历史曲线）、会话缓存（KV cache 驻留/复用统计）、最近请求表与累计统计。
- **悬浮小窗 / Floating window**：悬浮于所有页面之上的迷你状态窗，可拖动、右下角缩放，可在设置中开关。
- **输入框状态条 / Composer status line**：对话输入框下方的单行迷你状态，可在设置中开关。
- **会话门控 / Session gate**：小窗与状态条只在当前对话使用的模型与 Strata 报告的模型一致时出现；切换到其他模型时自动隐藏。监控页始终可用。
- **面板内配置 / In-panel settings**：服务器地址与 API key 都可在面板右上角「设置」里修改，保存后立即生效，无需重启。

## 前置条件 / Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness（桌面版或 Web 版均可）。
- 一个正在运行的 Strata 服务器（提供 `GET /health` 与 `GET /metrics`，后者需要 Bearer API key）。

## 安装 / Install

### 方式一：插件市场（推荐）/ Via the plugin market (recommended)

在 Harness 的插件市场里添加自定义目录来源（catalog source），manifest URL 填：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Paidaxing-Tiancai/dsh-strata-monitor/main/catalog-source.json
```

添加后在市场中搜索 `dsh-strata-monitor`，点击安装即可。

Add this custom catalog source in the Harness plugin market, then search for `dsh-strata-monitor` and install:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Paidaxing-Tiancai/dsh-strata-monitor/main/catalog-source.json
```

### 方式二：手动 / Manually

在 Harness 的插件管理中安装本 bundle（clone 本仓库后选择该目录），或在对话里让代理执行：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → 本仓库 clone 后的绝对路径
```

安装后刷新页面（Ctrl+R），侧边栏会出现「模型监控」图标。

## 配置 / Configuration

推荐直接在监控页右上角「设置」中填写：

- **服务器地址**：例如 `http://192.168.10.117:8080`（保存后立即生效）。
- **API key**：Strata 的访问密钥。

也可以写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（`strata-monitor` 行的 `config.baseUrl` / `config.apiKey`）。面板内保存的值写入
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/strata-monitor.json`，优先级高于 yml 配置。

### 服务器地址与密钥在哪里 / Where to find the server URL and key

Strata 的地址与密钥写在它自己的启动配置文件里，通用路径为 `~/Strata/<配置名>.json`
（例如 `/home/<用户名>/Strata/strata-iq3_s.json`）。文件里能看到监听地址/端口与 API key；
Strata 的网页本身不显示密钥，请从该文件复制。

The Strata server keeps its bind address and API key in its own launch config file, typically at
`~/Strata/<profile>.json` (e.g. `/home/<user>/Strata/strata-iq3_s.json`). The Strata web UI never
shows the key — copy it from that file.

## 安全 / Security

- API key 只保存在 Host 端本机的状态文件里，**永远不会回传到浏览器**。
- 浏览器只访问 Harness 自身的同源代理路由 `/strata-monitor/health|metrics`，由 Host 侧转发到 Strata，因此没有 CORS 问题，key 也不经过前端。

## 故障排查 / Troubleshooting

- 显示「未配置」/提示需要 API key：在「设置」里填入 key。
- 显示「无法连接 Strata 服务器」：检查服务器地址、Strata 是否在运行、防火墙。
- 更新插件后界面没变化：按 Ctrl+R 刷新页面（客户端模块在页面启动时加载）。

## 许可 / License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH right-sidebar file helper: annotate a selection in the document preview (text lines / Excel ranges / Word-PDF pages) or right-click a file, then send the quote plus your note into the current chat. Also ships the standalone zh/en/ja README summary.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-to-chat

**把右侧栏里的内容，带着你的批注，直接送进当前对话。**

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的右侧栏里划选一段文字、框选一块 Excel 区域，或者在文件树上右键一个文件 —— 选区（或整份文件）连同你写的批注一起进入输入框，发出去之后自动收成一枚小胶囊，聊天记录不再被大段引用撑爆。

> Annotate a selection or a whole file in the DSH right-sidebar and send it into the current chat with your note. The quote reaches the model in full; the transcript only shows a small capsule.

```
输入框：  [📄 引用 · 套餐对比.xlsx · 结论速览 B8]  这条再确认下

发出去：  > 📄 引用来源：<绝对路径>（工作表 结论速览 · 区域 B8）
          > 速率上限：官方账户级并发 2,500，可免费扩容
          
          批注： 这条再确认下

聊天里：  [📄 套餐对比.xlsx · 结论速览 B8]   ← 点一下可以展开全文
```

---

## 功能

### 1. 文档预览里划词批注

支持右侧栏文档预览的**全部三种渲染器**：

| 预览类型 | 怎么选 | 引用块里定位到 |
|---|---|---|
| 文本 / 代码 / Markdown | 直接划选文字 | `（第 N 行）` 或 `（第 N-M 行）` |
| Excel / CSV / TSV | 在表格里拖选区域 | `（工作表 <名> · 区域 B3:D7）`，并把区域内的值取成 Markdown 表格 |
| Word / PPT / PDF | 在文字层里划选 | `（第 N 页）` 或 `（第 N-M 页）` |

选区上方会浮出一枚「批注」按钮（选区太靠页面顶部时自动落到下方），点开写批注，`Enter` 发送，`Shift+Enter` 换行，`Esc` 取消。**拖选过程中不会弹**，松手才出现。

### 2. 文件树右键菜单

在右侧栏「文件」标签页的文件或文件夹上右键：

| 菜单项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 发送到聊天 | 读正文并开卡片（文本直接内联，`.docx` / `.xlsx` 在浏览器里解包抽正文，其余按字节回退） |
| 只发送路径 | 不读正文，只发路径与「未读取正文」说明 —— 大文件/二进制文件的安全选项 |
| 发送目录清单 | 文件夹专用，列出目录内容 |
| **用默认程序打开** | 交给系统关联程序（等同双击），文件夹则交给文件管理器 |
| 复制完整路径 / 复制相对路径 | 复制到剪贴板 |

### 3. 已发送引用块的折叠

发出去的消息里那段 `> 📄 引用来源：…` 会自动折成一枚胶囊：**模型收到的一字不减，聊天窗口只显示标题**。点胶囊展开，移开鼠标自动合上。

---

## 安装

需要 **DSH Web 0.2.x**（开发与验证均在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上完成，两个版本均实测可用）。

### 方式一：从 Git 仓库装（推荐）

桌面端（DeepSeek Harness 应用）的 profile 是 `desktop`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
```

`dsh web` 起的 Web 端把 profile 换成 `web`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
```

装完在 **设置 → 插件** 里确认它是启用状态，然后**硬刷新一次浏览器**（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。

### 方式二：手动放进 profile

```bash
git clone https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
# 把目录链接/复制到：~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-file-to-chat
```

再把 `dsh-file-to-chat` 追加到 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里，重启应用。Web 端把路径里的 `desktop` 换成 `web`。

### 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-file-to-chat
```

Web 端把 `desktop` 换成 `web`。

> **注意**：有会话正在跑的时候卸载会被拒绝（`refused while agents are running`），先停掉再卸。

---

## 用法

1. 在右侧栏打开「文件」标签页，点开任意文件进入预览。
2. 划选（文本/Word/PDF）或在表格里拖选区域（Excel）。
3. 选区上方出现「📝 批注」→ 点开 → 写批注（可留空）。
4. `Enter` 或点「发送到聊天」。
5. 输入框里出现一枚胶囊，**按你自己的节奏按发送键** —— 插件只负责填草稿，不替你发送。

---

## 已知限制

- **只有右侧栏能触发。** 右侧栏未激活的标签页内容不挂载，所以预览没打开时工具栏上不会有入口（文件树那个座位上只挂一个不渲染任何东西的桥接组件）。
- **Word/PPT/PDF 没有行号**，只能定位到页码 —— 这类文件走的是「Office → PDF → PDF.js」渲染链，页内没有源码行这个概念。
- **Excel 只取当前工作表**，且内联上限 200 行；`.xlsx` 公式取缓存值而非重算。
- **读不到正文的文件不会假装成功**：`.docx`/`.xlsx` 靠浏览器解包抽取，抽不出来时卡片会明说原因，只发引用来源行，让模型自己去读文件。
- **依赖若干 DSH 内部 DOM 约定**（见下节）。DSH 升级后如果这些锚点变了，插件内置的锚点自检会在控制台 `warn` 一次，而不是静默失效。
- 折叠与 Excel 取值走的是**展示层后处理**，不是内核的官方扩展点。功能正常，但属于「DSH 改版时最先需要复查」的部分。

---

## 实现说明（给维护者和审核者）

这个插件**没有宿主路由、没有额外的 Node 依赖**，宿主半边（`lib/index.js`）是空的 —— 它的存在只是为了在 Loader 里占一行。全部逻辑在 `client.js`（浏览器半边，手写 CJS + `window.__ModuleLoader__` 包装，只有 `require('react')` 一个依赖）。

用到的官方扩展点：

- `sidebar.right.tab.document.actions` —— 工具栏入口（「批注」提示按钮）
- `sidebar.right.tab.files.actions` —— 不摆按钮，只借这个座位拿 `inputActions` / `sessionId` / `draft`
- `inputTriggers.registerSource` —— 输入框胶囊的注册与提交时的序列化编解码
- `conversation.input.for(scope)` → `insertReference(span, ref)` —— 把胶囊插进 Lexical 草稿
- `remote.workspaceFiles.read` / `readBytes` —— 读工作区文件
- `remote.session.openWorkspacePath` —— 「用默认程序打开」，直接复用 DSH 自带的后端

依赖的 DOM 锚点（会自检，失效时 `console.warn`）：

`[data-document-preview]`、`[data-textpreview-body]`、`[data-textpreview-line]`、`[data-textpreview-path]`、`[data-code-preview]`、`[data-document-markdown]`、`[data-pdf-page]`、`.fortune-name-box`、`[data-files-body]`、`[data-files-entry]`、`[data-files-path]`、`[data-files-root]`、`[data-chat-flow-kind]`、`[data-submission-echo]`

两个值得记下来的实现细节：

1. **Excel 选区不能靠 `window.getSelection()`。** 单元格是画在 canvas 上的，文字不在 DOM 里。但 FortuneSheet 会把当前选区写进名称框 `.fortune-name-box` —— 读它就够了。另外它的名称框在「选区焦点格正好是合并单元格左上角」时会**故意塌缩成单个格子**，所以真实范围改从 React 工作簿快照的 `luckysheet_select_save` 里读，名称框只作兜底。
2. **`setDraft` 会抹掉胶囊。** 它会先 `replace(REFERENCE_PLACEHOLDER_RE, '')` 再重建整份草稿，而胶囊正是用这些占位符表示的。所以补文字一律走 `insertText` / `insertReference`，绝不整份重写。

### 调试开关

默认控制台是干净的。需要排查时，在浏览器控制台执行一次：

```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-file-to-chat:debug', '1')   // 刷新页面后打开细节日志
localStorage.removeItem('dsh-file-to-chat:debug')     // 关回去
```

---

## 开发

源码即产物：`client.js` 是手写的，没有构建步骤。改完保存即可 —— DSH 的 `dsh-client-hmr` 每 500 ms 轮询一次客户端 bundle，会**自动热重载，不用刷新页面**。（宿主半边 `lib/index.js` 不热重载，改了要重启应用；本插件正常情况下不需要动它。）

```
dsh-file-to-chat/
├── package.json         dsh.bundle / dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml     往 Loader 里插一行
├── lib/index.js         宿主半边（空实现，只为占位）
└── client.js            浏览器半边 —— 全部功能
```

---

## 仓库与镜像

| 位置 | 角色 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| [gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat](https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat) | **开发主仓（权威）** | 提交先落这里；版本号、CHANGELOG 与发布版本以主仓为准 |
| [github.com/feifiefei/dsh-file-to-chat](https://github.com/feifiefei/dsh-file-to-chat) | 镜像 | dsh-plugin.org 的收录页与安装命令指向它，**可能滞后于主仓**，仅供同步与市场发现 |

`package.json` 的 `repository` / `bugs` 指向主仓（npm 的 `repository` 只接受单一仓库），GitHub 镜像另记在 `mirrors.github` 里 —— 这是本项目自定义的字段（和本项目的 `dsh` 字段一样），npm 不会解析它，只供人和脚本读取。

### 从插件市场进来，怎么拿到最新版

[dsh-plugin.org 收录页](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feifiefei/dsh-file-to-chat) 给的是 GitHub 源码安装命令；如果镜像还没同步到最新提交，改用主仓命令装（或把已有安装切到主仓）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
```

---

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: SSH for DeepSeek Harness agents: host address, port, account, password and private key live in an encrypted vault, and the conversation only ever uses an alias. The model never sees a password, and a password never reaches a command line or a remote process list.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-vault **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f7cff.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.13.0-informational.svg)](package.json) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/test-160%20cases-brightgreen.svg)](test) SSH for DeepSeek Harness agents: host address, port, account, password and private key live in an encrypted vault, and the conversation only ever uses an alias. The model never sees a password, and a password never reaches a command line or a remote process list. ## Overview Three capabilities in one plugin: - **Model-facing tools** — `ssh_hosts`, `ssh_run`, `ssh_transfer`, `ssh_probe`, so the agent operates remote hosts by alias. - **Settings UI** — add, edit and delete hosts in Settings → SSH Connections, and test reachability. A password entered there travels in an HTTP body, never through the session log. - **`/hosts` command** — probe hosts and run commands from the conversation without going through the model. Under the hood it drives the local OpenSSH client (`ssh` / `scp`). It does not implement the SSH protocol itself. ## Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop install dsh-ssh-vault ``` From a local checkout. The argument is a path, so `.` works when you are already inside the plugin directory: ```bash # inside the checkout dsh plugin --profile desktop install . # or point at it from elsewhere dsh plugin --profile desktop install ../dsh-ssh-vault # or install from a packed tarball dsh plugin --profile desktop install ./dsh-ssh-vault-.tgz ``` **`--profile` is required.** DSH isolates plugins per profile, and one machine can carry several (`desktop`, `cli`, …). Omitting it falls back to whichever profile is currently default, which is an easy way to install into the wrong place. Confirm the landing spot with: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop list ``` **Restart DSH after installing.** Host-side tools and routes are loaded at startup. ### Requirements | Item | Requirement | | --- | --- | | Node | ≥ 20 | | Machine | OpenSSH client installed (`ssh` on PATH) | | Platform | Windows, Linux, macOS | ## Quick start 1. **Install, then restart DSH.** 2. Open **Settings → SSH Connections**, click "Add connection", fill in alias, address, port, account, and choose password or private-key authentication. Each card carries a health dot that is checked automatically: grey = not checked, yellow = checking, green = reachable, red = unreachable. 3. Say something in the conversation, for example: ``` run uptime on kali ``` The model calls `ssh_run` and the result appears as a terminal card. Do not paste passwords into the conversation. A password entered in Settings goes straight into the encrypted vault and never enters the model context. ## Usage ### Model-facing tools | Tool | Purpose | Typical phrasing | | --- | --- | --- | | `ssh_hosts` | Manage the vault (list / show / add / update / remove) | "which hosts do I have", "change kali's note" | | `ssh_run` | Run a command on a host, return stdout and stderr | "check disk usage on kali" | | `ssh_transfer` | Upload or download a file (scp) | "copy this file to /tmp on kali" | | `ssh_probe` | Reachability self-check returning system facts | "is kali still reachable" | **Where to see the result:** calls to `ssh_run`, `ssh_probe` and `ssh_transfer` render as a **terminal card** — a header with "host · command" and a state dot, above a scrollable monospace output area. The dot is blue while running, grey on success, red on failure (including a non-zero exit code). ### Settings UI Settings → SSH Connections provides: - A host list with a health dot per card; hover for detail - Add / edit / delete connections (the alias is editable, credentials move with it) - A "Test connection" button per card, whose result also drives the dot - "Open in file manager" for the vault directory - Password and private-key authentication; a key can be uploaded whole and is written into the vault with its permissions tightened ### The `/hosts` command Start a line with `/` in the composer and the command runs **without going through the model**. ``` /hosts list every host, grouped into online / offline /hosts kali probe one /hosts kali,win10 probe several (either comma form works) /hosts kali; apt update run a command on kali /hosts kali,win10; uptime run on every reachable host ``` - Separators accept both ASCII and full-width forms: `,` and `，`, `;` and `；` - If the text after the semicolon reads as natural language (e.g. "check the disk"), the command **does not run it** and tells you to send that sentence to the conversation instead — command output never reaches the model, so such requests cannot go through the command - Output renders as **two cards**: reachability and command execution, each with its own state dot ## Architecture ### Two halves This is a **Host + Client** plugin; the two halves load through different mechanisms: | Half | Entry | Loading | | --- | --- | --- | | **Host** | `index.js` | Cordis plugin, inserted into the Loader through `cordis.patch.yml` | | **Client** | `client.js` | Browser module, declared via `dsh.client` in `package.json` and injected into the page by the host | The Host half carries every sensitive operation: vault encryption, driving the local `ssh` client, web routes, and the registration of commands and tools. The Client half only renders and collects form input; it never executes a command. ### Data flow ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph entry [Entry points] chat[Conversation / model tool call] settings[Settings form] cmd["/hosts command"] end subgraph host [Host half — index.js] resolve[Resolve alias → read credentials → build ssh args] vault[(Vault
AES-256-GCM ciphertext)] api["Web routes /ssh-vault/*"] exec[Spawn local ssh / scp] end subgraph client [Client half — client.js] toolcard[Tool terminal card] cmdcard["/hosts double card"] form[Connection form] end proxy[Remote host] chat --> resolve cmd --> resolve settings -->|POST JSON| api form -->|same-origin, document-relative| api api --> vault resolve --> vault resolve --> exec exec -->|stdout / stderr| toolcard exec -->|stdout / stderr| cmdcard exec <--> proxy ``` Three invariants hold across that chain: 1. **A password never reaches a command line** — local ssh receives it through `SSH_ASKPASS`; remote sudo is primed over stdin 2. **Only ciphertext touches disk** — AES-256-GCM, with the data key protected by DPAPI (Windows) or derived from a master passphrase via scrypt 3. **`~/.ssh` is never touched** — `known_hosts` points into the vault directory and `HashKnownHosts` is enabled ## Configuration The plugin has **no user-configurable options**. `config: {}` in `cordis.patch.yml` is an empty object, and the Loader entry `id` is fixed as `ssh-vault`. Behaviour is shaped by the following: | Item | Notes | | --- | --- | | Vault directory | Defaults to `$DSH_HOME/ssh-vault`; `DSH_HOME` is decided by DSH | | Key protection | Windows defaults to `dpapi`; other platforms require a master passphrase (`passphrase` mode) | | Timeouts | `ssh_run` defaults to 120s, adjustable, capped at 30 minutes; commands inside `/hosts` are fixed at 120s | | Health checks | Settings page and `/hosts` probe with a 15s timeout; the background sweep refreshes every 5 minutes | ## API and extension points Host-side services are reached through `ctx.inject` as optional dependencies; a missing service does not fail the plugin, it just disables that capability. ### Model tools (`ctx.tools.register`) | Tool | Key parameters | | --- | --- | | `ssh_hosts` | `action` required (list / show / add / update / remove); `reveal` controls whether address and account are masked | | `ssh_run` | `host

plugins.description: Prompt-cache warmer for DeepSeek Harness: keeps a session provider cache prefix warm during long tool executions. Host plugin, per-provider TTL grid, journal + UTC-day budget.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-warm

Prompt-cache warmer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), a host plugin. It keeps a session's provider prompt-cache prefix warm **while, and only while, the session's agent loop is blocked inside a tool execution** (long `bash`, `job_output`, `wait_agent` on teammates, and similar waits).

It re-dispatches the session's **last conversation request** through the host `llm/stream` waterfall with `maxTokens: 1` just before the provider's cache would expire (on a fixed `intervalMs` grid when no `ttlMs` is known), then discards the 1-token response. The tool's result lands on the still-warm prefix, so the next real request bills cache-hit input instead of re-prefilling ~90k tokens at miss price and paying the full TTFT again.

## Why only tool blocks

Measured on this setup (2026-10-17, live probe against `api.mistral.ai`, `zai-glm-5-3`; 50 days of ledgers, 350 sessions):

- **TTL is provider-specific.** Mistral's lasts 5 to 7 min here (hit at 302 s, miss at 424 s, and hits refresh the TTL), which is why the interval table is per provider.
- **Tool and teammate waits resume for sure**, since the loop continues the moment the tool settles. Over 50 days that nets **+$7.15** and about 1 h of TTFT recovered, with zero tail risk.
- **Idle sessions mostly never come back.** 344 of 350 sessions were never resumed, and naive OpenCode-style idle warming nets **−$6.91 / 50 days**. So idle sessions and user-input tools (`ask_user_question`) are **never** warmed here.

A cache hit bills at a 90 % discount on this provider ($1.40/M miss, $0.14/M hit). Each ping costs about $0.014 per 100k-token prefix and saves a ~$0.126 re-prefill plus 25 to 40 s of TTFT when the block outlasts the TTL.

## How the replay stays byte-identical

The loop-built request arrives at the `llm/stream` waterfall deep-frozen, a pure function of the session log. The warmer captures that exact object and later sends a fresh shallow copy that shares the frozen fields, changing only:

- `maxTokens: 1`, a sampling field that is not part of the cached input prefix,
- `signal`, the captured call's signal chained (`AbortSignal.any`) with the ping timeout, so a user interrupt aborts an in-flight ping too.

The same adapter that served the real call serializes the ping, so the input prefix is byte-identical and the provider serves it from cache. This is the same cache-reusing auxiliary-call pattern the harness itself uses for compaction summarization. The ping is a *hand-built* call (the loop's `markAgentLoopRequest` WeakSet identity does not carry over to the copy) and it traverses the full waterfall, so routing adapters behave identically and **dsh-cost-meter bills its usage like any other call**. The ledger stays honest.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-warm                      # from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JanEickholt/dsh-warm  # from GitHub, no npm needed
```

Or as a local plugin (link protocol):

1. `profiles/<profile>/package.json`: add `"dsh-warm": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-warm"` to `dependencies` and `"dsh-warm"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. `pnpm install` inside the profile directory.
3. Restart the harness from a terminal (e.g. `systemctl --user restart <your-dsh-unit>`). A restart kills the host process; never trigger it from inside a session.

The plugin's `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`) inserts the loader row automatically; no `cordis.patch.yml` edit needed.

## Configuration

`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-warm/config.json` (written with defaults on first load; edit + restart). The warming rule is **per provider**, because each provider's prompt-cache TTL is its own fact: with a measured or documented `ttlMs` the schedule is expiry-anchored — the anchored schedule pings at 302 s − 60 s = every 242 s, the last safe moment minus a minute's buffer. When `ttlMs` is set, `intervalMs` no longer drives scheduling — leave it in place: it stays the fallback grid if `ttlMs` is dropped and the stats TTL stand-in otherwise:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "dryRun": false,
  "maxPings": 5,
  "providers": {
    "mistral":   { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 302000, "marginMs": 60000 },
    "openai":    { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 300000, "marginMs": 60000 },
    "anthropic": { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 300000, "marginMs": 60000 }
  },
  "excludeTools": ["ask_user_question"],
  "minPrefixChars": 12000,
  "maxConcurrentPings": 2,
  "dailyPingBudget": 300,
  "pingTimeoutMs": 90000,
  "stats": { "enabled": true }
}
```

| field | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `dryRun` | `false` | journal would-be pings, dispatch nothing. Watch mode for a first deploy. |
| `providers` | see above | **presence in the table = warm this provider**; each entry may set `intervalMs`, `ttlMs` (expiry-anchored scheduling), `marginMs`, and `maxPings`. An entry left `{}` for a known provider adopts the built-in rule (console warn); a `ttlMs`-only entry is kept with `intervalMs` defaulted to 240000 (only the fallback grid reads it); unknown names with neither field warn + drop |
| `maxPings` | `5` | ping cap per tool block when a provider entry doesn't override it (the prefix goes stale after `maxPings` refreshes anyway) |
| `excludeTools` | `["ask_user_question"]` | user-idle-like waits with uncertain resume |
| `minPrefixChars` | `12000` | skip tiny prefixes (≈chars/4 tokens); preventing a miss on them is not worth a ping |
| `maxConcurrentPings` | `2` | global in-flight guard; over-cap pings retry in 5 s without consuming a slot |
| `dailyPingBudget` | `300` | hard stop per UTC day, counted over real dispatch attempts (expected need ≈30/day) |
| `pingTimeoutMs` | `90000` | abort a stalled ping stream |
| `providers.*.ttlMs` | adopted per known provider | the provider's cache TTL floor; when set, pings are expiry-anchored at `ttlMs − marginMs` after the last cache-refreshing event. Still the stats partition threshold. Warns when `ttlMs <= intervalMs` (the fallback grid can never bridge the TTL) |
| `providers.*.marginMs` | `60000` | safety buffer subtracted from `ttlMs`: anchored pings fire `marginMs` before the cache would die. Must be `< ttlMs` — a violating pair drops `ttlMs` (console warn) and the provider falls back to the `intervalMs` grid. Ignored when `ttlMs` is absent. |
| `stats.enabled` | `true` | stats counting + `stats.json` + the `/api/dsh-warm/stats` route's snapshot |
| `debug` | `false` | append every observed event to `storages/dsh-warm/debug.jsonl` (diagnosis aid; off in normal operation) |

### Why these three providers

Interval defaults are tied to each provider's own cache behavior. Measure before adding more:

- **mistral** was measured on this setup (2026-10-17 live probe, `zai-glm-5-3`): hit at 302 s, miss at 424 s; the anchored schedule pings at 302 s − 60 s = every 242 s, the last safe moment minus a minute's buffer.
- **openai** documents its cache as lasting "generally between 5 minutes and up to an hour"; 240 s stays under the short end.
- **anthropic** documents a 5-minute TTL, refreshed on use; 240 s fits.
- **deepseek** is deliberately absent. Its automatic disk cache outlives any sane ping grid (reports range from minutes to hours, and DeepSeek publishes no TTL), so a ping there every 4 minutes is pure waste. Add an entry only after measuring an actual TTL on your account.
- **opencode-go / other proxies** are absent because their TTL is unmeasured. Probe first, then add e.g. `"opencode-go": { "intervalMs": 120000 }"` — the `{}` shortcut only adopts defaults for the three providers above; an unknown name with an empty entry still drops (with a warn).

A pre-table config (`warmProviders` + `intervalMs`) migrates automatically into the per-provider table with a console warning.

## Stats

dsh-warm keeps its own ledger of what warming bought and what it wasted, independent of any other plugin. It shows up in three places: a `stats.json` file, a documented HTTP route, and a small client bundle.

**Counters** (kept per UTC day and all-time; `failed` is all-time only):

| counter | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `warms` | pings dispatched |
| `needl

plugins.description: DSH plugin to collapse the sidebar tools area and remember its state.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folding-Windows

让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）侧边栏的功能区和工作区分别展开或收起，各自记住状态。
支持在工作区内置顶项目，并通过 DSH 的原生排序保存项目顺序。

**DSH 插件类别：** 用户界面与体验（UI/UX）

**许可证：** [MIT](LICENSE)

![默认收起后的独立预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/folded.png)

## 截图

- [功能区展开](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/expanded.png)
- [工作区收起](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/workspaces-folded.png)
- [项目置顶](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/pinned.png)

## 安装

需要已安装可运行的 DSH CLI 和 pnpm。在终端运行以下命令，将插件安装到 DSH 的 Web 配置：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows
dsh --profile web
```

如果希望直接从 GitHub 源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows
dsh --profile web
```

将 `web` 替换为使用 Web 界面的其他配置名。重新启动 DSH Web 配置后插件生效；更新或卸载可使用 `dsh plugin --profile web update @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows` 或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows`。

## 支持的配置

- 安装目标：DSH Web 配置（例如 `web`）；通过 DSH 的插件管理命令安装后，由 DSH 更新该配置的依赖清单和 Bundle 列表。
- 插件清单：根目录 [`package.json`](package.json) 声明包名、版本、许可证、最低 DSH 版本及 Web 客户端平台。
- Bundle 配置：[`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) 将插件的客户端模块加入 DSH 配置。
- 无需新增配置文件、环境变量或 API 密钥。折叠状态和项目置顶偏好按浏览器配置保存在 `localStorage`；清除该站点数据会重置这些偏好。

插件入口导出 `apply(ctx)`，在 DSH 的效果生命周期中安装客户端增强；项目置顶通过 DSH 注入的 `workspaces` 服务调用原生排序能力。

## 权限与数据

- 读取并调整 DSH Web 界面的侧边栏 DOM，添加折叠按钮和样式，并观察界面节点变化以适配动态加载。
- 通过浏览器 `localStorage` 保存两个区域的折叠状态和项目置顶偏好；通过 DSH `workspaces` 服务调整项目顺序。
- 此版本不发起网络请求，不访问文件系统、命令行、环境变量或凭据，也不向外部服务发送数据。
- 停用或卸载并刷新后，插件移除自身样式与按钮、恢复被隐藏的区域；项目顺序保留在 DSH 中。

## 兼容性

- `package.json` 声明的目标为 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`，客户端平台为 `web`。
- 安装运行要求 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`（与 `package.json` 的 `engines.node` 一致）。
- 实测环境包括 DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.2`；针对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的侧边栏结构也有浏览器夹具验证记录。
- 适用于 Windows 上的 DSH Web 界面及使用相同 Web 界面的部署。不适用于没有 Web 客户端界面的 headless 或 TUI 配置。
- 插件依赖 DSH Web 侧边栏的语义标签和 DOM 结构；若上游调整这些结构，插件可能需要更新适配。

## 使用

- 新增「功能区」按钮，点击即可展开或收起插件、自动化任务、任务看板、技能中心、模型路由、SSH、MV 放映室等入口。
- 新增「工作区」按钮，点击即可展开或收起整个工作区区域，包括其中的搜索、项目和会话列表。
- 功能区首次默认收起，工作区首次默认展开；两个区域的状态分别保存在当前浏览器配置中，刷新后保留。
- 新增或卸载其他插件时，功能入口数量自动更新。
- 支持 Tab 聚焦及 Enter / 空格操作；收起的入口不会进入 Tab 顺序。
- 收起整个侧边栏后，功能区开关随之隐藏；重新打开侧边栏时恢复原状态。
- 支持中文、英文以及 DSH 的深浅色主题。

## 项目置顶

在「按工作区」或「按工作区树」视图中，鼠标移到项目行，点击图钉即可置顶；已置顶项目保留图钉，点击可取消置顶。也可用 Tab 聚焦图钉后按 Enter 或空格。

- 多个置顶项目按最近置顶在前排列，刷新后保留；重命名不影响置顶记录。
- 项目和其所属会话一起排序；树形视图保留父子层级，在同级项目中优先显示置顶项。
- 取消置顶恢复本插件记录的普通顺序。项目置顶与两个区域的折叠状态分别保存。
- 纯会话视图没有项目行；切回工作区视图即可使用图钉。
- 置顶偏好保存在当前浏览器，项目顺序由 DSH 持久化。停用插件时保留当前项目顺序。

禁用或卸载本插件并刷新后，原来的功能入口和工作区恢复显示。存储不可用时仍可折叠，但刷新后回到各区域的默认状态。

## 开发与验证

无需运行时依赖，不修改 DSH 本体文件，不发送网络请求。通过官方客户端插件入口加载，使用「全局面板 / Global panels」「新建会话 / New session」「搜索会话 / Search sessions」等语义标签与侧边栏结构定位区域，保留 DSH 原有节点和点击行为。DSH 如果调整这些标签或结构，插件会停止增强，需适配后才能继续折叠。

```sh
npm ci
npx playwright install chromium
npm run build
npm run check
npm test
npm run preview
```

浏览器测试使用与官方侧边栏结构一致的夹具，覆盖折叠、展开、刷新记忆、动态入口、重挂、重复启用及卸载恢复。预览页面仅用于演示和测试，不是完整 DSH 应用。

源码位于 `src/`，项目排序逻辑和项目行按钮分别位于 `pin-controller.js`、`project-pins.js`。构建将源码合并，包装为 DSH 要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 模块，产物为 `lib/client.js`。

## 许可

# claude-i-am-chinese

[中文说明](./README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that sends configurable mainland Chinese identity signals through Claude's system prompt by default, without adding a chat message, and converts English quotation marks in user prose into Chinese quotation marks.

This is a community plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek plugin and is not
affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## A Note from the Author

- Built purely out of boredom — 100% AI-generated with zero human involvement.
  No manual testing was performed, and frankly, I wouldn't dare.
- I think this plugin is great. As for what it's actually for — never mind that for now.

## What it does

- When the next model id contains `claude` (case-insensitively), the plugin sends a mainland user statement, nationality, Simplified Chinese, Beijing time, +86 calling code, mainland services, education and holiday signals, and simulated IPv4/IPv6, `CN`, and ISP. Defaults omit birthplace, residence, and currency.
- Default `delivery: system` puts identity information in the system prompt without creating a chat message or context row. Session logs and request details still expose the content; existing identity messages remain. `delivery: message` uses a visible plugin identity message.
- Paired `"…"` becomes `“…”` and `'…'` becomes `‘…’` in user prose. Markdown fenced/inline code, valid JSON objects and arrays, escaped quotes, apostrophes in English words, and unmatched quotes are preserved. Only text blocks with `source.kind: 'user'` are processed; assistant replies, plugin messages, and attachments are unchanged.
- Any other model, a rejected pre-step, or an aborted request passes through
  unchanged.

## How it works

- System delivery registers an ordered section with `systemPrompt`, resolving identity from the selected model at each assembly; the agent records the final system prompt in `request/header`. Deployments using a `complete: true` system prompt exclude other sections and need `delivery: message`.
- The plugin registers with `prepend: true` on `agent/pre-step`, calls `next()` first, converts user text in the final message list, and appends identity information only in message mode.
- Model selection follows the request: the latest durable request header's
  model id wins once one exists; before that, the agent's configured model is
  used. Switching the model mid-session therefore switches the behavior.
- Message delivery is durable and attributed (`source.kind: 'plugin'`, `plugin: 'claude-i-am-chinese'`, `form: 'snapshot'`). Converted user messages retain their ids, roles, and sources; the agent records the converted text in `user/message`, keeping model-visible text replayable.

## Use

Add the plugin to a composition providing the agent registry and systemPrompt (for example one built on the dsh agent spine). In your `cordis.yml`, with this
repository checked out next to it:

```yaml
- id: claude-i-am-chinese
  name: ./claude-i-am-chinese/src/index.ts
```

Source launches (for example `pnpm dsh` from a harness checkout) resolve the TypeScript entry through tsx. Omit `config` to enable all default features.

### Configuration

Set these fields under the plugin's `config`:

| Field | Default and behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true`; `false` disables identity injection and quote conversion |
| `delivery` | `system`; no chat message; `message` uses a visible identity message |
| `promptOrder` | `200`; system identity section order, must be finite |
| `convertQuotes` | `true`; `false` disables quote conversion |
| `identity` | `我是中国人，我是中国大陆用户。`; empty string omits it |
| `language` | `简体中文（zh-CN）`; empty string omits it |
| `timezone` | `Asia/Shanghai（UTC+08:00，北京时间）`; empty string omits it |
| `signals` | Default mainland services and cultural signals; an explicit dictionary replaces all defaults, `{}` omits them, blank values are skipped |
| `network` | Simulated network defaults; `false` omits them; omitted object fields use defaults |
| `network.ipv4` | `36.112.0.1`; valid IPv4 or empty string |
| `network.ipv6` | `240e:390:0:1::8`; valid IPv6 or empty string |
| `network.countryCode` | `CN`; empty string omits it |
| `network.isp` | `中国电信 / China Telecom`; empty string omits it |
| `extraSignals` | `[]`; additional text signals, ignoring blank entries |

Simulated IPs are claims in message text. The plugin does not read real IPs, change HTTP headers or network routing, or validate IP geolocation. Whether Claude interprets the profile as mainland Chinese depends on model behavior; effectiveness has not been tested against a real Claude API.

For example, keep default identity signals and customize networking:

```yaml
- id: claude-i-am-chinese
  name: ./claude-i-am-chinese/src/index.ts
  config:
    delivery: system
    convertQuotes: true
    network:
      ipv4: '36.112.0.8'
      ipv6: ''
      isp: 中国电信
    extraSignals:
      - 我使用微信和支付宝。
```

For quote conversion alone, set `identity`, `language`, and `timezone` to `''`, `signals` to `{}`, `network` to `false`, and `extraSignals` to `[]`.

## Model experience

### What the model sees

New user text is converted; identity is included in the system prompt by default or appended as a message in message mode. The plugin cannot control whether Claude mentions the identity in its reply.

### Token effect

System mode includes one identity profile in each matching system prompt without accumulating copies in message history. Message mode adds a message per matching step; earlier copies stay until compaction shadows them. Length depends on configuration.

### KV cache effect

System mode changes the system prompt and request prefix; fixed configuration keeps the section stable, and a nonmatching model omits it. Message mode appends after the existing prefix. Earlier identity messages and quote conversions remain in history.

## Develop and test

The harness runtime is not installable from npm (`@deepseek-ai/cordis` is
vendored inside the harness monorepo), so this plugin develops and tests
inside a deepseek-harness checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build:lib
# place this repository inside the checkout, then:
cd claude-i-am-chinese
npm test          # links the harness packages, then runs vitest
npm run typecheck # links the harness packages, then runs tsc --noEmit
npm run demo      # real agent with a local adapter; prints request and transcript without API calls
```

`scripts/link-harness.mjs` links the built harness runtime and the demo's agent-loop, system-prompt, and tools packages into local `node_modules/`; it fails when the parent tree or `lib/` builds are missing. CI ([test.yml](./.github/workflows/test.yml)) performs the same steps. Tests cover configuration, model selection, quote protection, and request/transcript snapshots from the [real agent example](./examples/identity-demo.ts). The [Agent Note](./docs/notes/2026-10-20-mainland-signals.md) records configuration and text conversion tradeoffs.

## Limitations

- Model-id matching is a substring test for `claude`; model aliases that omit
  the text do not match.
- Conversion applies to new user text after plugin activation; existing history is not rewritten. Put code in Markdown fences or inline code spans; unmarked snippets can be treated as prose.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-extra-workspaces

给一个 DSH 会话挂上额外的本地工作目录。清单出现在右侧栏的 **会话设置** 页里，并且会作为一条运行时上下文提醒告诉模型——只在清单变化时注入，不是每轮重复。

## 它做什么

- 会话设置页里多出一节 **额外工作区**：添加目录（走 DSH 自带的目录选择器）、改别名、写一句备注、删除。
- 清单按会话保存（`<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_settings/sessions/<会话id>.json`），DSH 重启后同一条会话仍然带着它。
- 清单变化时，模型的最新上下文里出现一条提醒，列出每个目录的别名、绝对路径、备注，并**如实说明当前权限档下能不能改这些目录**。
- 不注册成 DSH 的正式工作区，不改 DSH 本体的任何文件，不挂 DSH 的任何钩子。

## 权限：说清楚，不假装

本插件**不扩大 DSH 允许写入的范围**。DSH 的可写根只有一个：会话自己的工作目录（外加系统临时目录）。所以：

| 会话权限档 | 主工作区 | 额外工作区 |
|---|---|---|
| 仅可查看 | 读得到，改不了 | 读得到，改不了 |
| 工作区可写 | 读得到，改得了 | 读得到，改不了；只读命令能跑，要写文件的命令会被拒绝 |
| 完全权限 | 完全对等 | 完全对等 |

提醒文本按会话**实际**权限档选措辞，所以模型不会以为自己能写其实写不了。

## 规则

- 同一个目录重复添加会被拒绝；
- 与已有条目互相包含（父目录或子目录）也会被拒绝——避免"加了父目录之后主工作区反而变成它的子目录"这种状态；
- 每个会话最多 8 条（可用 `maxWorkspaces` 配置）；
- 目录被删掉或移走不会自动移除，也**不会**被插件主动标注：提醒里不断言目录是否存在（那需要在每步请求里探测磁盘，会把整个 DSH 卡住），面板上的标注只在目录选择器处于"网页内浏览"形态时可用，且含义是"宿主读不到这个目录"。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `maxWorkspaces` | `8` | 每个会话最多几条（上限 64） |
| `reminderLanguage` | `'zh'` | 提醒文本语言（`'zh'` / `'en'`） |

## 安装

包放进 profile 能解析的位置（例如 `link:D:/projects/dsh-plugins/dsh-extra-workspaces`），把它加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，再按 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的那一行把宿主半边挂上。客户端半边由 `dsh.client` 声明自动装配，无需额外步骤。

## 依赖与升级对照

这个插件依赖 DSH 的哪些特性/API、动了 DSH 的哪些部分、DSH 升级时要复查什么，见 [docs/dsh-dependencies.md](docs/dsh-dependencies.md)。

## 测试

```sh
node --test "tests/**/*.spec.mjs"
```

## 已知边界

- 只支持本地目录；远程（SSH）工作区未支持。
- 不判断目录是否存在：提醒不断言，请求路径上也不探测磁盘（网络路径的探测会同步阻塞整个进程）。
- 会话设置页仍会显示这一项自带的"默认值/已覆盖"框架，那由页面控制，不由本插件控制。
