plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

# Opencode Connect (`dsh-plugin-opencode-connect`)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DeepSeek Harness Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-Plugin-blueviolet?logo=deepseek)](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) [![OpenCode Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-Desktop%20Free%20Models-2ea44f?logo=opencode)](https://opencode.ai) [![GitHub Repository](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Dreftian%2FOpencode--Connect-black?logo=github)](https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect) [![Status: Production Ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Production%20Ready-success)](https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect) **Seamlessly connect and dynamically auto-sync all OpenCode Desktop free models into DeepSeek Harness.** [English Documentation](#english) • [Documentación en Español](#español)
--- ## 🇬🇧 English Documentation ### 📌 Overview & The Problem It Solves **DeepSeek Harness** is a high-performance orchestration framework and desktop workspace for advanced AI agents, multi-step reasoning, and software development workflows. However, developers often face friction with paywalled APIs, rate limits, credit-card requirements, or complex authentication setups for secondary models. **OpenCode Desktop** provides an extensive, curated suite of free LLM models optimized for coding, reasoning, long-context analysis, and multimodal tasks. **OpenCode Connect (`dsh-plugin-opencode-connect`)** bridges this gap: - **Zero API Keys Required**: Seamlessly leverages your existing local OpenCode Desktop instance. - **10+ Free Pre-Configured Models**: Instantly exposes high-capability free models into DeepSeek Harness with no billing or subscription requirements. - **Dynamic Auto-Synchronization**: Automatically monitors and syncs models whenever OpenCode Desktop updates its model registry, changes configurations, or introduces new free models—with zero restarts required. - **Native DeepSeek Harness Streaming**: Full integration with Cordis and DeepSeek Harness protocols, featuring real-time token streaming and reasoning/thinking traces (`thinking_delta` & `text_delta`). --- ### 🧠 Supported OpenCode Desktop Free Models The plugin automatically discovers and maps the complete catalog of free models from OpenCode Desktop: | Model ID | DeepSeek Harness Name | Context Window | Thinking / Reasoning | Modality | Best For | | :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | | `opencode/beam-free` | Beam Free [Free] | 32,768 | ❌ | Text | Ultra-fast responses, linting, concise edits | | `opencode/big-pickle` | Big Pickle [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Balanced algorithmic coding & problem solving | | `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | High-throughput code synthesis & agent planning | | `opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free` | GLM-5.3-Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | Deep reasoning, multilingual translation, code review | | `opencode/longcat-2.5-preview-free` | LongCat 2.5 Preview Free [Free] | 262,144 | ❌ | Text | Massive context comprehension, full-repo analysis | | `opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free` | MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free [Free] | 131,072 | ✅ | Text | Low-latency chat & reactive interactive agents | | `opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free` | Nemotron 3 Ultra Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Enterprise code analysis & complex architecture | | `opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` | Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free [Free] | 65,536 | ❌ | Text | Instant snippet generation & documentation | | `opencode/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free` | Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text, Image | UI/UX mockups, visual debugging, charts | | `opencode/space-bunny-free` | Space Bunny Free [Free] | 65,536 | ✅ | Text | Creative engineering, prompt design, test suites | --- ### 🔄 Dynamic Auto-Synchronization Engine ```mermaid flowchart LR A["OpenCode Desktop
(Local Service / CLI)"] <-->|"opencode models
Periodic Discovery"| B["OpenCodeModelSynchronizer
(Background Daemon)"] B -->|"Event: models-updated"| C["OpenCodeAdapter
(LlmAdapter)"] C -->|"Dynamic Registration"| D["DeepSeek Harness
LLM Runtime"] D -->|"Stream Requests / Thinking Blocks"| E["Agent & Chat Sessions"] ``` 1. **Auto-Discovery on Boot**: On initialization, `OpenCodeModelSynchronizer` invokes `opencode models` via standard local CLI paths across Windows, macOS, and Linux. 2. **Differential Comparison**: Keeps a snapshot of known models and computes differences. If OpenCode rolls out a new model version or introduces a new free tier model, the synchronizer emits a `models-updated` event. 3. **Hot Registry Refresh**: DeepSeek Harness updates its active provider catalog dynamically. Users can immediately select newly added models in the dropdown selector without reloading the application. --- ### 🚀 Installation Instructions for DeepSeek Harness #### Method 1: Via DeepSeek Harness GUI (Recommended) 1. Open **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**. 2. Click on **Complementos** (Plugins) in the left navigation sidebar. 3. Click the **+ Agregar complemento** (+ Add Plugin) button in the upper right. 4. In the text field, paste the official GitHub repository URL: ```text https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect ``` *(Alternatively, you can provide the package name `dsh-plugin-opencode-connect` if published, or the path to a local directory).* 5. Click **Instalar** (Install). DeepSeek Harness will install the plugin and automatically detect your OpenCode Desktop models. --- #### Method 2: Via DeepSeek Harness CLI / Cordis Patch Using the DeepSeek Harness CLI toolchain: ```bash # Using pnpm pnpm dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-opencode-connect # Or using npm npm install --save dsh-plugin-opencode-connect ``` Or apply the included bundle patch in your `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: llm-opencode-connect name: dsh-plugin-opencode-connect ``` --- #### Method 3: Local Directory Path Installation (Development / Offline) To run or develop from source: ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/Dreftian/Opencode-Connect.git cd Opencode-Connect # Install dependencies and build npm install npm run build ``` Then in DeepSeek Harness GUI: 1. Navigate to **Complementos** > **+ Agregar complemento**. 2. Select **Cargar desde directorio local** (Load from local folder) or paste the absolute path: ```text C:\Users\\path\to\Opencode-Connect ``` 3. Click **Confirmar**. --- ### ⚙️ Configuration Options Configuration can be specified in your Cordis / DeepSeek Harness configuration file (`cordis.yml` or plugin options): ```yaml dsh-plugin-opencode-connect: # Path to opencode or opencode-cli executable. # Leave empty ("") to auto-detect across standard installation paths. cliPath: "" # Background synchronization polling interval in milliseconds. # Default: 30000 (30 seconds) syncIntervalMs: 30000 # Filter only free models provided by OpenCode Desktop. # Default: true onlyFreeModels: true # DeepSeek Harness LLM provider prefix ID. # Default: "opencode" providerPrefix: "opencode" # Human-readable provider display name. # Default: "OpenCode Desktop" providerDisplayName: "OpenCode Desktop" # Enable streaming of internal reasoning/thinking tokens. # Default: true enableThinking: true # Per-request execution timeout in milliseconds. # Default: 180000 (3 minutes) timeoutMs: 180000 # Diagnostic log level ('debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error'). # Default: "info" logLevel: "info" ``` --- ### 🛠️ Troubleshooting & Diagnostics #### 1. "OpenCode CLI binary not found" - **Cause**: OpenCode Desktop might be installed in a custom non-standard directory, or not yet launched. - **Solution**: - Ensure **OpenCode Desktop** is installed and has been run at least once so it extracts its CLI helper. - Specify the explicit binary path in your config (`cliPath: "C:\\path\\to\\opencode-cli.exe"` or `/usr/local/bin/opencode-cli`). - Standard auto-detected locations: - **Windows**: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\@op

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DSH plugin: create a workspace by name in the browser instead of opening an OS folder chooser on the host
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quick-workspace

Make the sidebar's **Add workspace** button work when you are driving the DeepSeek
Harness web UI from somewhere other than the host machine.

## What was wrong

The stock flow opens an **OS folder chooser on the host**. `dsh-host-directory-picker-auto`
resolves the `native` backend whenever the bind host is `127.0.0.1` on macOS, and that
backend is a renderless `osascript "choose folder with prompt …"` call: it puts a Finder
dialog on the host's screen and renders **nothing** in the browser.

So from a remote browser (Tailscale, LAN, a phone) the button looks completely dead, and
it gets worse than dead — while the hidden dialog is open, `WorkspacePickFlow` holds
`directoryBusy`, and `shortcutControls.add` is a no-op whenever that flag is set. Every
later click is then silently ignored, with no error and nothing on screen.

## What this plugin does

It occupies both directory-flow holes — the sidebar header button and the composer's
*Choose workspace* — with a **name dialog**:

1. you type a name,
2. the dialog shows the exact path it is about to create,
3. DSH makes the folder and registers it as a workspace, then opens it.

New folders land **beside the deployment's default workspace**, which on this machine is
`~/Documents/deepseek-harness/` for a workspace at `~/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace`.

It registers at `priority: -100`, which is the documented way to *shadow* a single-kind
slot occupant: `SlotCore.register` sorts entries by ascending priority and the lowest
renders, so this takes the seat instead of throwing `already has a registration` against
the native/browse picker.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/plugins/dsh-quick-workspace
```

Then restart `dsh web` so the host half re-imports (see below).

## Two things that bite when editing this

- **`lib/index.js` needs a `dsh web` restart.** The client half hot-reloads; the host half
  does not. After editing `lib/index.js`, `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-quick-workspace`
  and re-add, or restart the server.
- **`process.cwd()` is `/`.** `dsh web` runs as a launchd KeepAlive agent, so the working
  directory is the filesystem root, and `mkdir("/<name>")` fails with a bare `EACCES` that
  tells the user nothing. The parent comes from `workspaceRegistry` instead, and the root
  is refused outright with `quick-workspace/no-parent`.

## Wire shapes worth remembering

- `ctx.connection.rpc.call("/api", "ns/method", payload)` resolves to the
  `{ok, value | error}` envelope. Reading `.path` straight off it yields `undefined`
  **without throwing** — always unwrap.
- The Gateway derives its argument descriptor from the Host method's signature. A
  parameterless `describe()` must be sent `{args: {}}`; `{args: {request: {}}}` is rejected
  with `gateway/arguments-invalid`.

## Uninstall

`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-quick-workspace` (or disable it on the Plugins page),
then restart `dsh web`. The stock folder picker comes back.

plugins.description: Ephemeral /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: full conversation context, no tools, never written to history.
plugins.readme_text:
# @andrewhmir/dsh-btw — ephemeral `/btw` side questions for the DSH Web GUI

An **unofficial community plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). It adds one gesture to the Web GUI composer:

```
/btw how does the compaction checkpoint interact with the surface?
```

The answer streams into an overlay over the app. Dismissing it leaves **no
trace** in the session: the question and answer are never appended to the
transcript, never rendered as chat rows, and never become part of what the model
sees on the next turn.

It is the inverse of a subagent: a subagent gets the full tool surface and an
empty context; `/btw` gets the full conversation context and no tools.

## What `/btw` does

| property | behavior |
|---|---|
| invocation | `/btw <question>` typed in the composer, mid-session; also selectable from the `/` menu |
| context | the full committed conversation of the current session |
| tools | none — the request carries no tool schemas and no tool history |
| answer | streamed into an overlay over the app frame |
| dismissal | Space, Enter, or Escape (also the close button / backdrop) |
| persistence | none — the exchange never enters session history |
| concurrency | works while the main turn is streaming and never interrupts it |
| shape | single-shot; no follow-up turns |
| model | the session's routed provider/model/reasoning effort |
| cost | one tool-less call whose message prefix is the parent request's prefix, so the provider's prompt cache is reused |

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with the Web GUI (`dsh web`).
- Node.js 22 or newer only for the verification scripts; the plugin itself runs
  inside the harness process.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and one
client+host plugin row (`id: btw`). Install it into the profile you run, then
restart `dsh web`.

### From a plugin market

Enable DSH's custom plugin market, add a community index that lists this package
(the repository carries the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic so indexes can discover
it), and install `@andrewhmir/dsh-btw` from the Discover tab.

### With the agent

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw@0.1.2
```

### From a local checkout

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-btw
```

### After installing

**Restart `dsh web`.** The running process holds its pre-install module graph;
a restart loads the new host half. Then confirm the composition:

```
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Expected: exit code 0 and a row `id: btw` / `name: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw` with no
`not found`, `unknown key`, or `cannot resolve` lines.

After editing only `client.js`, the harness's client HMR picks the rebuilt file
up on save; host-half edits need a restart.

## How it works

- `ui-commands` claims slash commands that exist in the session's **host**
  command catalog. `/btw` deliberately does not register such a command: a host
  command's result is durably logged (`command/run` / `command/done`) and would
  enter the session history.
- Instead, the plugin's **client half** registers its own `'/'` input-trigger
  source. During composer adjudication it claims `/btw <question>` before any
  host command runs, opens the overlay, and calls the plugin's own loopback
  route `POST /btw/ask`.
- The **host half** resolves the live agent for the session, snapshots the exact
  model-visible history with `Session.deriveMessages()`, appends one frozen user
  message carrying the side question, and runs a single `ctx.llm.stream()` call
  with **no tools, no tool history, and no separate system prompt**. Because the
  message list is the parent request's prefix plus one trailing message, the
  provider's prompt cache is reused.
- The answer streams back as newline-delimited JSON, renders **Markdown** through
  the shell's shared `MarkdownText` component (plain-text fallback if an older
  shell does not seed it), and is shown in a `shell.overlay` panel.
  Space/Enter/Escape abort the request and close it.
- A snapshot taken mid-turn can end with an assistant tool call whose
  `tool/result` is not committed yet. The host trims that trailing unresolved
  step before replaying the history, so `/btw` answers with the conversation as
  of the last completed tool step instead of the provider rejecting the request
  ("tool calls need immediate results").
- Nothing in this path calls `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox — that is what makes the exchange ephemeral.

## Private by design

The ephemerality is a contract, not a rendering choice:

- the question and answer are never written to the session log, so they are not
  in the transcript, the token meter's session history, or any export;
- the host route never touches `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox;
- the only durable effect is provider billing for one call.

It is verified against real session logs: `test/e2e/ephemerality-check.mjs`
decodes every `session.v*.jsonl.zstd` in a test home and fails if the question or
any part of the answer appears in a persisted event. A control run proves the
scanner detects text that *is* legitimately persisted. Results for both supported
harness versions are recorded in [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Configure

The plugin row accepts two optional values; both have safe defaults and are read
without a Config schema:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: btw
      name: '@andrewhmir/dsh-btw'
      config:
        maxTokens: 1200    # completion cap for one side answer (default 1200)
        timeoutMs: 120000  # hard deadline for one side call (default 120000)
```

Questions are capped at 4000 characters; the request body is capped at 32 KiB.

## Known limitations

- **In-flight partial assistant text is not included.** The snapshot reads the
  committed session surface; while the main turn is streaming, the current
  assistant message is not committed yet. `/btw` sees the conversation as of the
  last committed event.
- **Not visible in session-log cost dashboards.** Ephemeral calls leave no
  session-log trace; provider billing is the source of truth for them.
- **Web GUI only.** The host route is generic, but the invocation and overlay are
  client-side Web features.
- **English overlay copy.** Display metadata ships in English and Chinese;
  in-overlay strings are English in this version.
- **A future host `btw` command would shadow this plugin.** The host catalog is
  adjudicated before the plugin's source; if a future harness version ships a
  host command with the same name, `/btw` would execute that command instead.
- **Single-shot.** There is no follow-up turn inside the overlay.

## Compatibility

`engines.dsh` declares `>=0.2.0-rc.2`. Both tags were verified on a clean-room
install containing only the official bundles plus this plugin:

| Harness | Result |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest`) | overlay + streamed answer, uppercase `/BTW`, Markdown, Escape/Space/Enter dismissal, warm cache |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `next`) | the above, plus mid-stream concurrency (4/4 answers during a tool call) and strict ephemerality |

See [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the measurements and the
exact commands.

## Verify

From this directory:

```
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
node tools/build-client.mjs --check
node --check client.js
```

The clean-room and browser harness lives in `test/e2e/` and is documented there.
It is not shipped in the published package:

- `clean-room.ps1` builds a fresh DSH home with only the official bundles plus
  this plugin, seeds the workspace state, composes, boots, and prints the URL;
- `first-run.mjs` dismisses the first-run preview notice and proves the composer
  accepts text;
- `cdp-e2e.mjs` drives the real GUI over the DevTools protocol (`probe`, `full`,
  `dismiss-keys`, `mid-stream`);
- `ephemerality-check.mjs` asserts that no exchange reached a session log.

## Development

```
node tools/build-client.mjs         # regenerate client.js from src/client/*.mjs
node tools/build-client.mjs --check # fail when client.js is stale
node --

plugins.description: Ctrl+F find bar for the DSH desktop UI: search the conversation and the right panel, highlight matches, and jump between results. As-is / best-effort.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-find-anywhere

为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 UI https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness  提供 `Ctrl+F` 式查找：在**当前对话**和**右侧面板**中搜索已渲染文本，高亮全部匹配，并在结果间循环定位。

包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-find-anywhere`，版本 `0.1.0`，纯浏览器实现。

> **发布状态：as-is / best-effort。** 本仓库按现状发布，不承诺持续维护、不承诺跟进上游变更，也不承诺及时响应 issue。详见 [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md)。

## 为什么值得用：右侧面板内容也能搜

右侧面板常驻文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等信息。多数查找只覆盖对话正文；本插件把**右侧面板当前激活页里已渲染的文字**纳入同一套查找条：

- 面板打开时，右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮，点击即可查找面板内容。
- `Ctrl+Shift+F` 直接进入右侧面板范围。
- 查找条停靠在面板内容区顶部，避开标签栏和文件路径行，并随面板展开/全屏/切换标签重新定位。
- 对话和右侧面板共享高亮、计数、上一个/下一个循环；范围随时切换。

查找条只读取 DOM 文本，不修改面板结构，也不发送内容到网络。

## 使用

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` | 打开查找条；焦点在右侧面板时搜索面板，否则搜索对话 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | 打开右侧面板范围 |
| 对话标题栏的 🔍 / 右侧面板右下角的 🔍 | 鼠标打开对应范围 |
| 输入文字 | 实时高亮全部匹配，计数显示 `当前/总数` |
| `Enter` / `F3` / `Ctrl+G` | 下一个匹配（循环） |
| `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+F3` / `Ctrl+Shift+G` | 上一个匹配（循环） |
| 计数旁 `↑` / `↓` | 上一个 / 下一个 |
| 查找条左侧的范围切换 | 在对话与右侧面板之间切换 |
| `Esc` | 关闭并清除高亮 |

### 范围规则

- **对话**：搜索当前对话列里已渲染的文字（用户消息、助手回复、工具卡片、命令输出等）；输入框和编辑器被排除，草稿不会产生假匹配。
- **右侧面板**：搜索当前激活页里已渲染的文字（文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等）；面板标签栏、按钮和工具栏文字被排除。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 面板关闭时，面板入口自动隐藏；面板重新打开或切换标签后，查找条会重新定位。

## 设计取舍

- **不包裹 `<mark>`**：对话 DOM 归 React 所有，流式输出时持续重渲染。插件使用 CSS Custom Highlight API 在 Range 上绘制高亮，不插入节点，不破坏 reconciliation。
- **MutationObserver 跟随流式输出**：对话继续输出或历史分页载入时防抖重算匹配；按“文本节点 + 偏移”保持当前匹配，不会跳到另一个位置。
- **纯 DOM 检索**：不依赖会话数据结构，因此工具卡片、命令输出、折叠内容中已渲染的部分都能被找到；尚未进入 DOM 的虚拟化历史不在范围内。
- **极简外观**：单行 38px 浮条，沿用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，自动适配明暗主题；无结果时计数与边框变红并轻微抖动（尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`）。
- **右侧面板入口**：面板打开时右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮；面板关闭时自动隐藏，不占用面板标签栏的槽位。

## 能力边界

- 只匹配渲染后的纯文本：不做正则、不折叠变音符号、不跨文本节点匹配（被样式拆开的短语可能匹配不到）。
- 依赖 CSS Custom Highlight API（当前 Chromium / Electron 均支持）；不支持时仍能计数和滚动定位，但没有高亮底色。
- 虚拟化或懒加载的历史若尚未进入 DOM，需要先滚动加载后再搜索。
- 右侧面板的**浏览器页签**如果是跨域 iframe，父页面无法读取其内部文字；**终端页签**（canvas/xterm）也没有可检索的 DOM 文本。这两类内容搜不到是预期行为。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 若 `Ctrl+Shift+F` 被其他功能占用，用右侧面板右下角的 🔍，或把焦点放进右侧面板后按 `Ctrl+F`。

## 安装与构建

运行时需要支持客户端插件的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。`lib/` 是注入器实际加载的产物；`src/` 是源码。

```bash
# 仓库是源码形态；先生成运行产物
bash scripts/build.sh
```

若你的环境装有 `dsh-super-injector`，可以把仓库目录注入：

```text
dev_inject_plugin /absolute/path/to/dsh-find-anywhere
```

卸载：

```text
dev_uninject_plugin dsh-find-anywhere
```

也可以直接使用发布包 `dsh-external-dsh-find-anywhere-0.1.0.tgz`。该 tgz 包含 `lib/`、`locale/`、`icon.svg`、`README.md`、`LICENSE` 和 `MAINTENANCE.md`；具体安装方式取决于你的 DSH 版本。

注意：源码仓库的 `.gitignore` 忽略了 `lib/`，所以 GitHub 上的仓库默认是源码形态；需要预构建产物时请使用 tgz，或本地运行构建脚本。

## 隐私与安全

- 不读取会话数据库，不调用后端接口，不发送任何内容到网络。
- 插件在 DSH Web UI 页面内运行，会读取当前页面已渲染的 DOM 文本。安装前请自行审阅源码。
- 查找高亮使用浏览器原生 Highlight API，不向页面插入额外节点。

## 验证状态

本次发布整理只修改了 `package.json` 元数据与文档，没有重新运行 GUI 验证。功能描述基于现有实现，按 as-is 提供；如果上游 UI 结构变化导致失效，本仓库不承诺修复。

## 文件

- `src/client/index.js` — 全部浏览器逻辑与 UI（ModuleLoader bundle 源文件）
- `src/index.js` — Host 注册壳（无 host 行为）
- `scripts/build.mjs` — 无编译依赖的构建（语法校验 + 复制）
- `lib/` — 注入器实际加载的产物（由 `src/` 生成）
- `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` — 插件管理页的标题/描述元数据
- `icon.svg` — 原创图标（对话气泡 + 放大镜）
- `LICENSE` — MIT
- `MAINTENANCE.md` — 维护状态与自维护指引

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 dsh-find-anywhere contributors

plugins.description: Transparent draggable performance HUD for DeepSeek Harness - CPU, GPU and memory usage plus CPU/GPU temperatures.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-perf-hud

A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness web UI:
**CPU / GPU / memory usage**, plus the **CPU package temperature** when the
optional helper is installed.

![dsh-perf-hud floating over the Harness window](docs/preview.png)

## Highlights

- **Fully transparent** — no card background, no border. Just three rows of text
  floating over the interface, with a soft halo so it stays readable on any
  content.
- **Drag it anywhere.** On release it anchors to the nearest window corner, so
  maximising, restoring or resizing the window keeps it exactly where you put
  it. Double-click resets to the top-right, arrow keys nudge it, and the chevron
  that appears on hover collapses it to a single row.
- **Load-aware colours** — usage turns amber at 70% and red at 90%; temperature
  at 78 °C / 88 °C. Stale readings dim the whole card instead of flashing a fake
  zero.
- **Theme-aware** — only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so it follows light, dark and
  any custom theme.
- **Local only** — the metrics route answers loopback, same-origin requests and
  returns 403 for everything else. Nothing is uploaded.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.** The GPU counters, the PowerShell worker and the temperature
  helper are Windows-specific.
- DeepSeek Harness with the web UI.

## Install

From the Plugins page (install from GitHub or a local folder), or:

```sh
dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud
```

Then reload the interface once.

## What it reads

| Metric | Source |
| --- | --- |
| CPU usage | `node:os` CPU-time deltas, once a second |
| Memory usage | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` — same definition as Task Manager's "In use" |
| GPU usage | Windows `GPU Engine` performance counters, busiest engine (what Task Manager reports) |
| CPU temperature | optional helper — LibreHardwareMonitor's `CPU Package` sensor |
| GPU temperature | only when the GPU exposes a temperature sensor; most integrated GPUs do not, so the cell shows `—` |

## Temperatures (optional)

The plugin works out of the box; without the helper both temperature cells show
`—`. For the real CPU package temperature, run **once** (it asks for
administrator rights):

```
helper\setup.cmd
```

That script downloads and sets up:

- **LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6** (portable, library only) — reads the sensors;
- **PawnIO 2.2.0**, a signed kernel driver — required to read MSRs while Windows
  "Memory integrity" (HVCI) stays enabled, so you do **not** have to weaken that
  setting;
- **`sensor-helper.ps1`**, which writes one small JSON file about every 0.4 s;
- a scheduled task **`DSH Perf Sensor`** (at logon, highest privileges, no
  window), so it never asks again.

Files go to `D:\DSHTools` when that drive exists, otherwise
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSHTools`. The plugin reads either location.

Measured overhead on an 8-core laptop: **0.08 % of one core and ~87 MB of RAM**
for the helper — it is mostly waiting on the driver, not burning CPU.

Remove it again with:

```
helper\uninstall.ps1              # stops the task, uninstalls the driver
helper\uninstall.ps1 -RemoveFiles # ...and deletes the helper files
```

## Limitations

- Windows only.
- GPU temperatures need a dedicated sensor; Intel integrated GPUs do not expose
  one, and the CPU package temperature is the closest reference (same die).
- The card floats **inside the Harness window**, not as a separate
  always-on-top desktop window.

## 中文说明

DeepSeek Harness 界面里的一块完全透明的性能读数：CPU / GPU / 内存占用率，加上
CPU 封装温度。没有底色和边框，只有三行文字浮在界面上。

- **拖动**卡片任意位置移动，松手后吸附到最近的窗口角，窗口最大化 / 还原 / 改变
  大小都保持位置；**双击**回到右上角，方向键微调，悬停右侧箭头可收起成一行。
- 占用率 ≥70% 变琥珀、≥90% 变红；温度 ≥78 °C / ≥88 °C 同理；读数过期整卡变暗。
- 安装：插件页面安装本仓库，或 `dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud`。
- 温度需要可选助手：管理员运行一次 `helper\setup.cmd`（会安装 LibreHardwareMonitor
  与 PawnIO 签名驱动，并注册开机自启任务）。不需要时用 `helper\uninstall.ps1` 移除。
- 没有温度助手时温度一栏显示 `—`；Intel 核显本身没有独立温度传感器，同样显示 `—`。
- 仅支持 Windows；悬浮窗在 Harness 窗口内部，不是独立的桌面置顶窗口。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Ordered web-search failover provider for DeepSeek Harness: try backends in priority order, fall back automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-failover

DeepSeek Harness 的搜索故障转移插件：按顺序尝试多个搜索后端，前一个失败（HTTP 错误、没有 `web_search_tool_result` 结果块、或返回空结果）时自动落到下一个。

> **English.** A failover web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness. The harness resolves exactly one search provider per `ctx.web` seam and a provider carries a single `model`, so one upstream error kills the whole search. This bundle registers a `deepseek-failover` provider that walks an ordered list of backends — same request, next backend on any failure (throw, abort excepted, or an empty result) — and only fails when every backend did. The stock `web-search-deepseek` row is disabled by the bundle's own patch, so no manual profile editing is needed. Node ≥ 22, harness ≥ 0.2.1, MIT.

## 为什么需要它

Harness 的 `ctx.web` 每次只解析一个 search provider，provider 也只有单个 `model` 字段，没有失败重试链；`web-search-deepseek` 一旦上游出错，整次搜索就失败。new-api 的自动换渠道只在“同一个模型名有多个渠道”时生效，所以要么在网关造一个别名，要么在 harness 侧做转移。本插件选后者：网关保持官方模型名。

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell 7 或 5.1） | ✅ | `dsh plugin` 本身跨平台；本文所有命令在 PowerShell 里原样可跑 |
| macOS（zsh / bash） | ✅ | 原生路径 |
| Linux | ✅ | 原生路径 |

前置条件：

- **DSH ≥ 0.2.1** — 插件复用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` 导出的 `DeepSeekSearchProvider`，0.2.0 没有这个接口
- **Node ≥ 22**，且 **`pnpm` 在 `PATH` 上**（`dsh plugin` 内部调 pnpm）
- 能访问 `https://codeload.github.com`（public 仓库，不需要 token）
- 一个 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容的搜索网关，以及它的 API key

## 安装

一条命令（自动写依赖、写 `dsh.profile.bundles`、并跑 `pnpm install`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

```powershell
# Windows 上完全一样
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后**重启 DSH**（关掉 `dsh web` 的终端再重新起）。插件是在 host 启动时 import 的，不重启不会生效 —— 详见排错第 1 条。

Desktop 版 profile 名是 `desktop`，需要先**完全退出应用**再加：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

插件没有 `prepare` 脚本、没有构建步骤，纯 JS，不会触发 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦截。

### 凭据

插件的 `apiKeyEnv` 指向一个**凭据引用名**，不是明文。把网关令牌写进 harness 的凭据文件：

- macOS / Linux：`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`
- Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.credentials.yaml`

```yaml
refs:
  NEWAPI_API_KEY: sk-...
```

这个文件由 harness 的 credentials 插件注入，**不需要写系统环境变量**。如果你更习惯环境变量，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成对应的变量名即可。

### 不想用 CLI 时

手工改 profile 的 `package.json` 效果一样：

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-web-search-failover": "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover"
},
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-web-search-failover" ] } }
```

再在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`，Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`）跑 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

## 验证

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 "searchProvider"
```

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String -Pattern "searchProvider" -Context 0,3
```

应看到 `searchProvider: deepseek-failover`。再做一次真实搜索，网关日志里会出现主后端的模型名；只有主后端失败时才会多一条备用后端。

**关于默认网关地址**：插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `baseURL` 写的是一个示例网关（`http://43.133.21.227:3000/v1`）。用别人的地址跑不通，**请改成你自己的网关**，见下一节。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `id: web-search-failover` 这一行的 `config`（插件自带的默认顺序是 `deepseek-v4-flash` → `claude-haiku-5-5`，不覆盖就按这个走）：

```yaml
- id: web-search-failover
  config:
    providerId: deepseek-failover   # ctx.web 选中的 provider 名，一般不用改
    backends:
      - { model: deepseek-v4-flash,  baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
      - { model: claude-haiku-5-5,   baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
```

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | `deepseek-failover` | 注册给 `ctx.web` 的 provider 名；bundle patch 里 `web.searchProvider` 必须与它一致 |
| `backends` | — | **有序**列表，第 0 个优先，其后都是备胎；每项 `model` / `baseURL` / `apiKeyEnv` 各自独立 |
| `apiKeyEnv` / `baseURL` / `apiKey` / `apiVersion` / `maxTokens` / `maxUses` | 见 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config` | 旧式单后端字段；用 `backends` 时不需要，插件按 backend 逐个构造 provider |

失败判定：抛错、或者成功但没有 sources。`WEB_ABORTED`（用户取消）直接向上抛，不换后端 —— 取消不该触发备用后端。全部失败才返回最后一个错误；如果所有后端都成功但确实没结果，返回那个空结果。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后重启 DSH。bundle 的 patch 随之失效，harness 原有的 `web-search-deepseek` 行会恢复；如果你之前手工在 profile patch 里删过它，需要自己加回来。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，但搜索行为没变 | 插件在 host 进程启动时 import，进程里的模块不会热替换 | 重启 DSH（关掉 `dsh web` 再起） |
| 改了插件源码（哪怕是 `lib/index.js`）也不生效 | Node 的 ESM 缓存：已 import 的模块不会重新执行 | 同上，重启 host；GitHub 安装还需先 `dsh plugin add` 重装以拉新代码 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或报网络错误 | 拉的是 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball，公司网络/代理常拦 | 走代理，或把仓库整目录拷过去，依赖改成 `file:` 路径后 `pnpm install`（插件无外部 npm 依赖，离线可装） |
| 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 所有 backends 都 `available() === false`，通常是 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的引用没有值 | 检查 `.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里有该键，且键名与 `apiKeyEnv` 完全一致 |
| 搜索一直是备用后端的模型 | 主后端失败但未报错（返回空结果也会触发回落） | 看网关日志确认主后端返回码；密钥额度、模型名拼写是最常见原因 |
| 配置树里出现同一个 row id 冲突（`web-search-deepseek` 被两处同时声明） | profile patch 里手工加过 `id: web-search-deepseek` 的行，与 bundle patch 打架 | 删掉 profile 里那一行，插件自带的 patch 已负责禁用它 |

## 同步到另一台机器

逻辑全在插件里，换机器不需要搬配置，但要满足四件事：

1. **装插件**：跑上面那条 `dsh plugin add`。版本自动跟 `master` 最新提交，两台机器不必同 commit，但 harness 版本要一致（都 ≥ 0.2.1）。
2. **凭据**：`.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里要有 `NEWAPI_API_KEY`。
3. **清掉旧的 provider 行**：profile patch 里若还有 `- id: web-search-deepseek`，删掉。
4. **网关可达**：`baseURL` 换成本机可访问的地址。

## 开发

本仓库是纯 JS、无构建步骤。仓库里没有 `node_modules`，直接 `npm test` 会因为找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 依赖而失败 —— 先把本机已安装的 harness 包链进来：

```bash
node scripts/dev-link.mjs            # 探测 dsh 的安装位置，链入 schemastery / dsh-web / dsh-web-search-deepseek 等
npm test                             # node --test
```

`dev-link` 依次探测：`dsh` 可执行文件所在的 npm 目录、`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`、`$DSH_HOME/profiles`、`$DSH_HOME`，也可以用第一个参数或 `DSH_PACKAGE_DIR` 直接指定 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 所在目录。Windows 上用 junction，不需要管理员权限。

改完代码在本地验证，再装到 profile：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>` 走 `link:` 依赖，配合 `dev-link` 即可改完重启 host 就看到效果。

## 相关插件

同作者、同一套安装方式（`dsh plugin add github:xingzoudefengye/<repo>`）：

- [dsh-browser](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-browser) — 给 agent 一个可驱动的真实浏览器，侧栏并排显示
- [dsh-compaction-local-handoff](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff) — 无模型的本地交接式压缩
- [dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory) — 有界、可提交进 git 的项目记忆
- [dsh-resume-budget](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget) — 会话恢复时的输入预算控制
- [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) — 无模型、有界的会话史书

## 许可

MIT © xingzoudefengye，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话页头显示 Cline / ClinePass 额度、Credits 余额与 token 消耗（支持多账号切换）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cline-quota

> 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的会话页头显示 **Cline / ClinePass 订阅额度**、**Credits 余额**与 **ClinePass token 消耗**，支持**多账号**切换。
>
> A DSH plugin that shows your Cline / ClinePass subscription quota, credits and ClinePass token consumption in the session header — with multi-account switching.

零依赖、无构建步骤：host 半边只用 Node 内置模块，client 半边是手写的模块包（只用到 shell 提供的 `react`）。

## 功能

- **页头 chip**：显示最紧的 5 小时窗口占用百分比，按压力变色（>70% 琥珀、>90% 红）；悬停给出三个窗口 + 余额的一行摘要。多账号时摘要里会带上账号名。
- **弹层**：
  - 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月三个窗口的进度条、百分比与重置倒计时
  - `Credits（按量付费）` 余额
  - `Token 消耗` 块：日期区间选择（含 `24h` / `7 天` / `14 天` / `30 天` 预设）、合计 token 与金额、每日（或每周、24h 下按小时）柱状图、以及**可点选的模型列表** —— 点某个模型即可只看它的消耗
- **多账号**：在面板里直接粘贴 API key 添加账号，`⇄` 循环切换，`✕` 移除
- 只统计 `aiModelTypeName === 'cline-pass'` 的用量，与上面的 ClinePass 额度口径一致

## 安装

已同时发布到 **npm** 与 **GitHub**，两个源内容逐字节一致：

| 来源 | 安装标识 |
|---|---|
| npm（推荐） | `dsh-cline-quota` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cline-quota |
| GitHub | `github:Wei-l-w/dsh-cline-quota` |

### 1) 插件面板（推荐）

DSH 侧边栏 →「插件」→「添加插件」，填 `dsh-cline-quota`（或 `github:Wei-l-w/dsh-cline-quota`；也可以填本地目录 / `.tgz` 的**绝对路径**）。

### 2) 命令行

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-cline-quota
```

> 桌面版占用的 `desktop` profile 不能从命令行管理（会报 `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）；这种情况请用上面的插件面板。

装完刷新窗口即可看到 chip；**host 半边**的改动需要重启 DSH 才会重新加载。

## 配置账号

默认使用凭据引用 `CLINE_API_KEY`（就是 profile 里 `cline` provider 用的那个名字）。

**方式一：面板里粘贴**（推荐）

账号行右侧 `＋` → 粘贴 key → 保存。插件会先用 `GET /users/me` 验证这个 key，通过后：

- key 写进 DSH 凭据库 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（与现有 `CLINE_API_KEY` 同一处，权限 600）
- 插件自己的名单文件 `$DSH_HOME/cline-quota.accounts.json` 只记 `label` + 引用名，**不存明文**
- 面板自动切到这个新账号；账号名默认取该账号邮箱

**方式二：配置文件**

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- id: cline-quota
  config:
    accounts:
      - label: 主号
        keyRef: CLINE_API_KEY
      - label: 备号
        keyRef: CLINE_API_KEY_2
```

key 本体放 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 下，或 `$DSH_HOME/.env`（只读回退层）。配置改完不必重启（loader 会带新配置重新 `apply`）。

## 关于金额（重要）

- 三个百分比是 **Cline API 给的**（按参考价加权的配额占用），不是本地用 token 数算的。
- `Token 消耗` 块里的 `$` 是 Cline 按它的**参考价**折算的用量价值，**不是账单**：ClinePass 是订阅制，参考价不等于实付金额。
- 对 `cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash`，Cline 的参考价 = DeepSeek 官方**高峰**价（输入 $0.30 / 缓存命中 $0.006 / 输出 $1.20 每百万 token）；DeepSeek 空闲价是它的一半。
- `0.1.0` 把 Cline 的 usage/caps 金额字段当成了 micro-USD，金额会放大 100 倍；`0.2.0` 已修正（usage/caps 按 `1e-8` 折算，`Credits` 余额仍是 micro-USD）。

## 安全与隐私

- API key 只在 host 进程里按**引用名**解析；浏览器只会拿到额度数字、账号邮箱与引用名。
- 面板里粘贴的 key 只在本机 loopback 的 POST body 里出现一次：**不回显、不写日志**（诊断日志只记方法、是否强制刷新、账号名、区间、UA、origin）。
- 插件不做任何遥测；host 进程只直连 `https://api.cline.bot`。
- 路由在本机 loopback 上**无鉴权**（与 DSH 中其它精确路由一致）：同机进程可以读到额度数字与邮箱，但读不到 key。

## 兼容性

- 需要带 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 座位的 DSH；在 **0.2.1-rc.2**（桌面版内置版本）上验证。
- Node >= 22。

## 开发与测试

```bash
npm test
```

`test/accounts.test.mjs` 是离线 harness：把真实的 host 半边挂到假 ctx 与假 Cline API 上，覆盖账号选择、粘贴 key（验证 → 写凭据库 → 名单文件）、重复 key/重名、删除、以及金额单位换算。`test/range-presets.test.mjs` 校验区间预设的高亮映射与"数据已过期"判定（24h / 7 / 14 / 30 天与自定义区间）。

### 发版（维护者）

```bash
npm version patch          # 或 minor / major：改版本号并打 tag
npm publish --access public
git push --follow-tags
```

> 品牌新包的**首次**发布会先进入 npm 的 staged 队列：registry 上先出现 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版，实测约一分钟后自动上架。若被拦下需要 maintainer 用 2FA 批准 —— npm ≥ 11.15 用 `npm stage list` / `npm stage approve <stage-id>`，或在 npmjs.com 的 **Staged Packages** 页点 Approve。

## 卸载

插件面板里卸载，或：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-cline-quota
```

## 声明

与 Cline / ClinePass 官方无隶属关系；"Cline" 仅用于说明本插件查询的服务。

## License

MIT © Wei-l-w

# Reverse Engineering Toolkit — a switchable DSH skill plugin

A DeepSeek Harness **bundle** that registers one model-invocable skill,
`reverse-engineering`, in the profile-global skill layer. Disable the plugin row
(or the whole bundle) in Plugin Manager and the skill disappears from the session
catalog; enable it again and it comes back.

Repository: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill>
Index: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-plugins>
Companion plugin: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-install-profiler> (installation
profiling, dynamic probing, and the handoff brief that feeds this skill).

Inspired by the viral "REA — Reverse Engineer Anything" project
(<https://github.com/morluto/rea>), which popularized agent-driven reverse
engineering after adding Android/APK analysis in October 2026. This plugin is an
independent implementation: it ships instructions plus a local toolchain probe,
not REA's engine or MCP server.

## What it does

- Adds a `skill` catalog entry that the agent loads on demand, then follows to
  classify an artifact, probe installed decompilers, work an authorized target,
  and report evidence-backed findings.
- Bundles `scripts/probe-tools.ps1` (32 tools across Android/Java/.NET/native/
  support, PATH + common install dirs + Android SDK, ~1.5 s, read-only).
- Enforces a blocking authorization gate and an explicit refusal list before any
  tool call, and degrades honestly when a decompiler is missing.

## Install (once)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill.git C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

Then, from a DSH session with Full access or approval:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

The install is a **link**: keep that directory in place, or the plugin breaks.
To update later: `git pull` in that directory, then toggle the row off and on
(the `SKILL.md` body is re-read on activation).

Then confirm the row is active with `plugin_manager list_plugins` (look for
`reverse-skill`) or approval-free `cordis_inspect_query` on the `Config`
provider filtered by `@local/dsh-reverse-skill`.

## On / off

- `plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=reverse-skill enabled=false` — unregisters
  the skill; the next turn receives a replacement catalog without it.
- `enabled=true` — re-registers it (the SKILL.md body is re-read on activation,
  so content edits take effect after a toggle, without restarting DSH).
- `action=remove_bundle target=@local/dsh-reverse-skill` — uninstalls completely.

## Layout

```
package.json              bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch)
cordis.patch.yml          inserts row id `reverse-skill`
index.js                  registers the skill via ctx.skills.register()
locale/en.json, zh.json   Plugin Manager title/description
icon.svg                  original icon
skills/reverse-engineering/
  SKILL.md                the instructions the model loads
  references/tool-recipes.md
scripts/probe-tools.ps1   read-only toolchain probe
```

## Safety

The skill refuses DRM/licence/anti-cheat bypass, credential theft, unauthorized
targets, live-service interaction, and redistribution of decompiled material. It
never executes a target on the host; dynamic analysis is limited to a disposable
device/VM the user authorizes. Decompiling a client never reveals server-side
logic — the skill states that limit instead of overselling.

plugins.description: DeepSeek 官方 API 峰谷价格提醒：Harness Web UI 胶囊 + deepseek_price_tip Agent 工具
plugins.readme_text: # DeepSeek 价格峰谷提醒 [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip) --- 在 Harness Web UI 的输入框下方显示一个小胶囊，提醒你 DeepSeek 官方 API 当前处于 **峰价** 还是 **谷价**，以及距离下次切换还有多久。点开胶囊可以查看当前价目表（人民币）、峰时规则、数据来源和抓取时间，并可从官网重新抓取。 胶囊样式和原生胶囊（会话统计、Token 用量、上下文用量）保持一致。 使用 DeepSeek Harness 的创造模式完成。 ## 功能 - **实时读数**：按官网规则计算当前时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周一至周五，不含中国法定节假日），并倒计时到下一次切换。 - **人民币价目表**：读取官方中文定价页，显示模型、档位、缓存命中/未命中输入价、输出价，峰/谷两档同时列出，当前生效的一档高亮。 - **从官网更新**：面板里的“立即更新”会读取 ，同时更新价格和峰谷时段规则（时间窗口、星期、是否排除节假日）。 - **自动更新**：启动时以及之后每 30 分钟检查一次，缓存超过 `autoRefreshHours` 小时就在后台重新抓取。抓取失败时保留旧表，并在面板里报告原因。 - **Agent 工具**：`deepseek_price_tip`，`action: status | refresh`，与面板共用同一份数据。 ### 截图展示 ## 安装 本仓库就是插件包本身（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 `dsh.client`），没有构建步骤，也没有第三方依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。 **从 GitHub 安装** 在 Harness 的插件管理里安装这个 bundle，安装 spec 填： ```text github:jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip ``` 也可以让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 用同一个 spec。装好后重启 Harness Web UI，输入框下方就会出现胶囊。 **本地开发时直接 link** 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把依赖指向本目录，并把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`： ```json "@local/deepseek-price-tip": "link:C:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-price-tip" ``` ## 数据与缓存 | 内容 | 位置 | | --- | --- | | 人民币价格、峰时窗口、星期规则 | 首次抓取后写入 `data/pricing-cache.json` | | 内置兜底数据 | `lib/pricing.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PRICING`（2026-10-18 抓取，人民币） | | 中国法定节假日 | 内置 2026 年安排，来源见 `HOLIDAY_SOURCE`；跨年后请用配置补充 | 如果官网表格结构发生大改，解析会失败而不是写入半张表：界面继续显示上一次成功的数据，并提示失败原因。 ## 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给这一行加 `config`： ```yaml - id: deepseek-price-tip name: '@local/deepseek-price-tip' config: autoRefreshHours: 6 # 可选：覆盖峰时窗口，单位是 UTC 零点的分钟数 # peakWindows: [[60, 240], [360, 600]] # 可选：覆盖星期（0 = 周日，6 = 周六） # weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # 可选：追加法定节假日（YYYY-MM-DD） # holidays: ['2027-01-01'] # 可选：换一个抓取地址（英文页会按美元解析并显示 $） # sourceUrl: 'https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing' ``` `autoRefreshHours: 0` 关闭自动抓取，只保留手动按钮。 ## 验证 ```powershell npm test ``` 也可以单独跑其中一组： ```powershell node test/pricing.test.mjs # 解析、峰谷计算、节假日、缓存校验 node test/host.test.mjs # Host 路由、刷新、失败回退、Agent 工具 node test/client.test.mjs # Client 注册、locale 字典、样式清理 ``` 不需要 `npm install`：测试只用 Node 内置模块（Node 20+）。GitHub Actions 在 Node 20/22/24 上跑同一套测试，见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`。 安装后在 Harness Web UI 里确认：输入框下方出现胶囊；点开有价目表；点“立即更新”后抓取时间变化。浏览器内的实际渲染效果需要在页面中查看，测试只覆盖模块注册和纯逻辑。 ## 限制 - 峰时窗口支持官网中文页的“北京时间 … 为高峰时段”和英文页的 “Peak hours are … UTC” 两种写法；页面改版时可能需要调整解析器。 - 节假日只内置到 2026 年。2027 年及以后，界面会明确提示“未内置该年节假日”，避免把节假日误报成峰价。 - 价格表按官网当前的“模型列 + 峰/谷行”结构解析；Search & Fetch 的按次计费不在模型价目表内。 - 人民币价格直接取自官方中文页，不是按汇率从美元换算。 - 缓存写在插件包目录里的 `data/pricing-cache.json`（已在 `.gitignore` 中忽略）。重新安装或升级插件会让这份缓存丢失，下次刷新时重新抓取，期间用内置的 `DEFAULT_PRICING` 兜底。

# no-need-workspace

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds a **No workspace** action to the blank-session
workspace picker. It defers the folder until the first message and keeps all such
sessions grouped under one **No Need Workspace** parent.

## Preview

![The No workspace option at the bottom of the workspace picker](docs/screenshot.png)

The blank-session workspace picker with **No workspace** selected.

## Behavior

- Clicking **No workspace** only ensures and selects the shared bucket workspace
  at `$DSH_HOME/workspaces`; it does not create a per-session folder.
- The first message in that session creates
  `$DSH_HOME/workspaces/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-mm-ss` (a numeric suffix is added when the
  same second already has a folder) and switches the session's working directory
  to it.
- The session header keeps pointing at the bucket, so the left sidebar shows
  every such session under the **No Need Workspace** group. Timestamped folders
  are not registered as separate workspaces and therefore do not form a folder
  tree.
- The existing **Add workspace…** action still uses the composed directory
  picker; the sidebar `+` action is unchanged.

`$DSH_HOME` is the configured Harness home (`$DSH_HOME`), falling back to
`~/.dsh`. No folders are deleted automatically.

## Install

DSH ships its plugin manager as a bundle. Install `no-need-workspace` from the
Web **Plugins** page by package name, or through the `plugin_manager` agent tool:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "no-need-workspace@0.2.1" }
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so installation selects the bundle and
inserts its single Host/Client row.

## DSH market index

The repository root contains [`market.json`](market.json), a format-1 DSH plugin
market index. Host it at a public HTTPS URL (for example the raw GitHub URL of
this file) and add that URL in DSH **Settings → Plugin Market**. The index lists
the npm source of `0.2.1`; later releases are appended by the `Release` workflow
described below, with the version's publish time as `publishTimestamp`.

## Releasing

1. Bump `version` in [`package.json`](package.json) and commit it on `main`.
2. Tag the commit and push the tag:

   ```bash
   git tag v0.2.1
   git push origin v0.2.1
   ```

The `Release` workflow checks that the tag matches `package.json` and points at a
commit on `main`, publishes the package to npm, then runs
[`scripts/update-market.mjs`](scripts/update-market.mjs) and commits the new
`market.json` entry. Publishing uses npm **trusted publishing**: the package
trusts this repository and `release.yml` once (npm → package → Trusted
publishing, or `npm trust github`), and the job authenticates through GitHub OIDC
with the `id-token: write` permission. No npm token secret is stored. Publishing
the same version twice is refused by npm, so a rerun after a partial failure
starts from a clean state.

## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (`engines.dsh`).
- The browser half deliberately shadows the shipped
  `conversation.hero.workspace` slot (a `single` slot, registered at priority
  `-100`). It depends on that slot's owner props and on the client
  `workspaces.rename` / `uiWorkspace.pickDirectory` services from the pinned DSH
  line. Re-verify the picker after a DSH upgrade.
- Do not install this package together with another plugin that registers the
  same `/no-need-workspace/ensure-bucket` route, and do not run two
  auto-workspace plugins at once: each would assign its own timestamped folder on
  the first message.

## Security

The Host half registers one loopback-only, same-origin `POST` route guarded by
the `x-no-need-workspace: 1` header. It only creates empty directories under
`$DSH_HOME/workspaces`. It adds no model prompt, tool, or telemetry.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# dsh-reel-studio

**Turn a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin repo into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image — locally, with Remotion.**

Package: `dsh-reel-studio` · Repo: `Eileenes/dsh-reel`  
English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> Status: working prototype. The Remotion pipeline and both outputs are tested end-to-end. The DSH host package (`dsh.bundle`) is scaffolded, but has **not yet been loaded into a real DSH profile**.

## Demo

- [Watch the 32.5s promo video](docs/demo.mp4)
- [Promo image (2160×2880 PNG)](docs/promo.png)
- [Video poster](docs/poster.png)

![Better Sidebar promo image](docs/promo.png)

The demo targets [omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar) (MIT). It is an unofficial sample used to test the *repo → promo material* workflow. Screenshots are from that public repo; task/side-chat visuals are synthetic mocks.

## What it makes

### Promo video

- 32.5s / 1920×1080 / 30fps / H.264 + AAC stereo.
- Seven scenes: hook → problem → solution → four features → how to use → proof/install/address → outro.
- Cut to a 120 BPM generated soundtrack; scene cuts and card entrances land on half-beats.
- Real DSH screenshots + DSH-style wordmark / palette / cartoon whale mascot.
- Covers: what it is, what it solves, how to use it, install command, repo address, numbers.

### Promo image

- 1080×1440 layout, rendered at 2× = 2160×2880 PNG.
- DSH visual language: `deepseek HARNESS` wordmark, DSH blue/mint, grid, real DSH screenshots, cartoon whale with speech bubble.
- Information blocks: what it is / what it solves / how to use / install command / address / stats.
- No private data: task and side-chat panels are synthetic mocks, not captured conversations.

## Requirements

- Node.js 22+
- pnpm
- Chrome or Chromium (Remotion renders with it). Set `CHROME_PATH` if it is not in a standard location.
- Python 3 only if you want to regenerate the BGM.

## Quick start

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Eileenes/dsh-reel.git
cd dsh-reel/studio
pnpm install
cd ..

# optional; the CLI also checks common macOS/Windows/Linux paths
export CHROME_PATH="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"

# video + poster + promo image
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode both

# only one output
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode video
node scripts/reel.mjs --case cases/dsh-better-sidebar.json --mode image
```

Outputs go to `studio/out/`:

- `<slug>-demo.mp4`
- `<slug>-poster.png`
- `<slug>-promo.png` (2×)

Options: `--poster-frame 825`, `--dry-run` (write props only).

## Case format

A case is one JSON file. It is deliberately explicit so a human or an agent can review every claim before rendering.

```json
{
  "plugin": {
    "name": "Better Sidebar",
    "handle": "dsh-better-sidebar",
    "version": "0.28.0",
    "repo": "github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar",
    "install": "dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar",
    "downloads": 46445,
    "stars": 4297,
    "tagline": "一个侧边栏，装下整个开发工作台"
  },
  "features": [
    {"no": "01", "title": "File tree + editor", "desc": "...", "img": "shots/files-tree.png", "accent": "#4d6bfe"},
    {"no": "02", "title": "Git", "desc": "...", "img": "shots/changes-tree.png", "accent": "#5ef2c2"},
    {"no": "03", "title": "Tasks", "desc": "...", "mock": "tasks", "accent": "#ffb86b"},
    {"no": "04", "title": "Side chat", "desc": "...", "mock": "sidechat", "accent": "#8ea6ff"}
  ],
  "promo": {
    "problem": "One session, five surfaces, half a screen.",
    "what": "Native right sidebar + a bottom workbench.",
    "how": ["Install", "Open the right sidebar", "Use the tabs"],
    "address": "github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar"
  }
}
```

Images are resolved from `studio/public/`. Use your own clean screenshots or the built-in synthetic mocks.

## Use as a DSH plugin

The repo includes a host-side plugin package:

- `reel_scan` — read a local plugin package/README/screenshot directory.
- `reel_plan` — turn a brief into a deterministic storyboard.
- `reel_render` — render `mode=video|image|both` locally.

Install into a scratch profile (not yet validated against a real DSH build). Once published to npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile scratch add dsh-reel-studio
```

Until then, install straight from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile scratch add github:Eileenes/dsh-reel
```

## Limitations / roadmap

- The case is authored by hand for now; `reel_scan`/`reel_plan` automation is next.
- Only 16:9 video and 3:4 image; 9:16 vertical and 1:1 square are TODO.
- No voiceover yet; the video uses generated music + captions.
- Host package needs real-profile validation, HMR/dispose checks, and a slimmer publish shape before it is market-ready.
- Do not render third-party screenshots without permission; prefer synthetic mocks or your own UI.

## Publishing / plugin market

See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for the npm + DSH market checklist.
