# dsh-bili-fish 🐟 养鱼

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)（DSH）装一只会自己过日子的 AI。

它在设定的时间段里**随机醒一次**，翻一眼你今天的样子，写两篇日记——一篇给你，一篇给它自己。日记不是流水账：它有自己的**好感度**（跨会话不重置）、会随事起伏的**心情**、会饿的**肚子**，还会把写下来的事记进记忆库。

> 主动 @ 那个功能在 [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) 里，这个插件只做「养鱼」。

English: a DSH plugin that gives your assistant a private life — a random daily wake-up, two diaries (one for you, one for itself), plus persistent affection, event-driven mood, hunger, and diary images.

---

## 它每天做什么

1. **生物钟**：在「窗口开始 ~ 结束」之间随机一个时刻醒（不是定点闹钟）。
2. **掷骰子**：默认 30% 概率「今天不想看」——醒一下，记一句为什么摆烂，不写日记。
3. **写两本日记**：素材 = 你自己的 B 站报告 + 当天你和对它说过的话 + 记忆库里记得的事 + 一个小事件：
   - `给主人的信`：有细节、有情绪、称呼你；
   - `自己的日记`：不加滤镜。
4. **结算好感度 + 心情**：模型在末尾追加 `<!--affection:+3|情绪|理由-->` / `<!--mood:pouty|65|为什么-->`，插件剥掉标记、钳制数值、写进 `state.json`。
5. **落盘**：`~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/<日期>-for-owner.md`、`<日期>-self.md`、`<日期>-week.md`、`cover-<日期>.png`。

素材全空也照写，写一篇「空白日」。

## 快速开始

```bash
# Web / CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lll-77777777/dsh-bili-fish
dsh web
```

**桌面端（Electron）**：桌面窗口读的是 `desktop` profile，命令行 `dsh plugin` 按设计不碰它。在桌面端的会话里直接说：

> 用当前桌面端内置的 `plugin_manager` 装 `dsh-bili-fish`，装完告诉我是否需要重启。

装完完全退出 DSH 再打开。然后 设置 → 养鱼：填一下日记目录、看一眼生物钟窗口，点「现在写一篇」验证。

## ⚠️ 必读：让 headless 能跑

日记是由一个 `dsh --profile headless` 的子会话来写的。**headless profile 默认把模型凭据关掉了**，不改的话子进程会在 5~14 秒内退出，日志里报：

```
dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"
```

修法：在 headless profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\headless\cordis.patch.yml`）里放开这两项：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-account
  disabled: false
- id: credentials
  disabled: false
```

改完不用重启 DSH，新起的子进程会重新 compose profile。验证：

```bash
DeepSeek\ Harness.exe resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js headless "Reply with exactly: OK"
```

输出 `OK` 就成了。**这是装完之后「日记永远写不出来」的头号原因。**

## 设置项（设置 → 养鱼）

| 分组 | 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 生物钟 | 总开关 / 窗口 / 不想看的概率 | 默认 21:00~23:30、30% |
| 日记 | 存到哪 / 写完推微信 / 现在写一篇 | 默认目录 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary` |
| 好感度 | 开关 / 每天最多动多少 / 久不聊天会掉 | 默认开、±15、掉好感默认关 |
| 心情 | 开关 / 跟上作息 / 每天换一次 | 事件驱动，见下 |
| 素材 | 刷B站报告 / 工作流水 / 记忆库 / 素材目录 | 四个独立开关；全关写「空白日」 |
| 附加 | 配图 / 周回顾 / 随机小事 / 主动找主人 / 思考带心情 | 默认关、开、开、关、开 |
| 早安 | 开关 / 城市 / 窗口 / 配表情包 | 默认**关**，开了才会推 |
| 喂食 | 饱腹度 / 食物按钮 / 同步小鲸鱼 | 见下 |

## 三个可以玩的部分

**好感度**：初始 50，范围 -100~100，跨会话不重置。分档影响它怎么说话：60+ 会主动黏人、75+ 会翻旧账、85+ 才叫你的名字。日记每天结算一次（受「每天最多动」限制），你也可以在设置页手动 ±。

**心情**：不是一个标签，是一组状态——舒服度（-100~100）、躁动度（0~100）、至多三个成分。由 13 件事推动（被夸、被关心、被凶、被冷落、同一处被反复改、深夜还在干活、饿、阴雨、没睡好、被叫胖……），按人设加权（黏人 0.85、傲娇 0.8、懒 0.7、爱吃 0.6……），关系好坏决定同一件事伤多深，然后随时间往底色回归。

**喂食**：饱腹度 0~100，默认每小时掉 4。白饭最顶饿，辣条/水草/减肥餐会炸。饿了会真的不高兴（心情事件 `hungry`）。三个入口：设置页常驻卡片、右侧边栏 🐟（装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 才有）、或者直接在聊天里说「喂她一碗白饭」。

## 数据与隐私（请先读）

**都在这台机器上**，但有几处会离开本机，得说清楚：

| 数据 | 在哪 | 会外传吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 设置、好感度、心情、肚子 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/config.json`、`state.json` | 不会 |
| 日记、封面图 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/`（可改） | 推微信时由你本机的微信插件发出去 |
| 当天你说的话 | 只读 `~/.dsh/sessions/**/*.jsonl.zstd` | **会**：原文作为素材发给模型 |
| 记忆库 | 只读/写 meow-memory 的 SQLite | **会**：检索结果作为素材发给模型 |
| 配图 | 走你配的生图接口 | **会**：日记场景描述发给生图服务 |

所以：**别在会话里说不想让模型知道的东西**（它本来也会看到）；不想要记忆库素材就把那个开关关掉。

## 花费

- 每次写日记 / 早安 = 起一个 headless 会话，大约 **1~2 万 token**（看你素材多少）。
- 心情、好感度、喂食、挂件的同步都是本地计算，不花 token。
- 配图走你自己在 `~/.dsh/agnes-image/config.json` 配的通道，按张计费，失败就跳过、不影响日记。
- 默认**只开**「写日记」，微信推送、配图、早安都要你自己打开。

## 兼容性

- **DSH** ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1；**Node** ≥ 22（用 `node:sqlite` 读记忆库，拿不到就静默降级）。
- **平台**：主要在 **Windows 11 + 桌面版 DSH** 上开发和验证。macOS/Linux 能跑，但通知（Windows toast）会静默降级，`dsh` 可执行文件的探测路径是猜的——找不到就在设置里填 `dshBin`。
- **多实例**：两个 DSH 同时跑会各自 tick、都写 `state.json`，没有加锁。建议只让一个实例开着。
- **依赖漂移**：记忆库是直连 meow-memory 的 SQLite（表名 `fact`/`topic`/`project`）。对方表结构变了会静默降级——不报错，但记忆写不进去。

## 可选依赖

| 依赖 | 用来做什么 | 没有会怎样 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) | 每轮把 B 站报告写到 `~/.dsh/bili-duty/out/<日期>.md` | 素材少一块，写「空白日」 |
| meow-memory | 记忆库 | 不读也不写记忆 |
| dsh-agnes-image | 日记配图 | 不配图 |
| dsh-wechat-plugin | 把日记推到微信 | 只落盘 |
| dsh-whale-widget | 右下角小鲸鱼：饿了会嘟囔 | 挂件不同步 |
| dsh-better-sidebar | 右侧边栏的 🐟 喂食页 | 用设置页或聊天喂 |

## 给 agent 的工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `fish_affection` | `get` 读好感度；`adjust` 传 `delta`/`reason`/`mood`（单次 ±15，钳在 -100~100） |
| `fish_mood` | `get` 读心情；`set` 换；`bump` 微调；`event` 注入一件事（见上）；`list` 列出所有心情 |
| `fish_diary` | 读某天的三篇日记（`day` 可省） |
| `fish_feed` | 喂食：传食物 key（`rice`/`fish`/`ramen`…） |

HTTP 接口（给前端/脚本用）：`GET /api/bili-fish/status`、`POST /api/bili-fish/{run,affection,mood,feed,config,diary,morning,unread}`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bili-fish
```

再删掉 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/`（设置、状态、日记、日志都在里面）。桌面端在插件页点「卸载」。

## 开发

```bash
node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/*.mjs
```

改完重启 DSH。只改设置字段（`DEFAULTS` + `Config`）保存即生效。

## 版本历史

见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 GitHub 发布 skill：推送前隐私扫描、SSH 一键推送、常见坑排查
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-publish-skill

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows%20%7C%20PowerShell-blue)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-skill-4B6EF5)

**先把隐私扫干净，再把项目推到 GitHub。** 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）用的 skill，也可以脱离 DSH 直接当脚本用。

A privacy-first GitHub publish skill: scan for secrets, then push over SSH. Works as a DSH skill or plain PowerShell scripts.

---

## 为什么需要它

`git push` 看似一条命令，实际有三类坑：

| 坑 | 表现 |
|---|---|
| **泄密** | 姓名、学号、终端截图里的容器 ID、`.env`、私钥被打包进仓库 |
| **认证** | 受限环境里 HTTPS 凭据助手起不来（`sh.exe` 建不了管道），`GIT_SSH_COMMAND` 同样走 shell 也不行 |
| **权限** | 复制出去的私钥继承了宽松 ACL，OpenSSH 直接拒收（`Bad permissions`） |

这个 skill 把三件事都处理了：扫描 → 用 `.cmd` 包装脚本绕过 shell → 固定 key 位置与 ACL。

## 特性

- **隐私扫描**：私钥、token（`ghp_` / `github_pat_`）、`sk-`、绝对用户路径、身份证号、手机号、IP、容器 ID、`.env`
- **人工复核提示**：图片和 Office 文件单独列出（截图与文档元数据是最常见的泄露源）
- **零依赖**：只要 `git` + OpenSSH + Python 3.8
- **可脱离 DSH**：脚本独立可用，不装 skill 也能跑
- **幂等**：重复运行只会更新 remote，不会重复添加

## 安装

```powershell
# 方式一：装成 DSH skill（推荐）
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force . "$env:DSH_HOME\skills\github-publish"

# 方式二：不装，直接用脚本
python scripts/privacy_check.py "D:\projects\my-app"
```

装成 skill 后，在会话里说"把这个推到 GitHub"就会自动触发。

## 快速开始

```powershell
# 1. 推送前扫描（有问题返回退出码 1）
python scripts/privacy_check.py "D:\projects\my-app"

# 2. 首次配置：生成 key，打印公钥
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup_ssh.ps1
#    把公钥贴到 https://github.com/settings/ssh/new

# 3. 推送
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/push.ps1 `
  -Path "D:\projects\my-app" -Init -Commit -Message "init" `
  -Remote "git@github.com:<你的用户名>/my-app.git"
```

默认 key 目录是 `$HOME/.dsh-github`，用 `-KeyDir` 可以改。

## push.ps1 参数

| 参数 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `-Path` | 仓库目录，默认当前目录 |
| `-Init` | 不是 git 仓库时自动 `git init` |
| `-Commit` | 先 `git add -A` + commit |
| `-Remote` | 设置/更新 origin |
| `-DryRun` | 只演练，不真推 |
| `-KeyDir` | key 所在目录 |
| `-Branch` | 默认 `main` |

## 工作原理

git 在 Windows 上执行 `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` 时会套一层 `sh -c`。在受限环境里 `sh.exe` 可能直接起不来：

```
sh.exe: *** fatal error - couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5
```

`push.ps1` 的做法是生成一个 `.cmd` 包装脚本并赋给 `GIT_SSH`——git 会直接 `CreateProcess`，不经过 shell：

```batch
@echo off
ssh.exe -i "<key>" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="<known_hosts>" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new %*
```

## 常见问题

**Q：`ssh -T` 报错但明明连上了？**
`ssh -T` 认证成功时退出码也是 1（GitHub 不提供 shell）。看输出里有没有 `Hi <user>!`。

**Q：`ls-remote` 没有任何输出？**
空仓库正常如此，退出码 0。用 `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` 对比 `git rev-parse HEAD` 判断。

**Q：私钥复制到别处就用不了？**
Windows 上复制文件不保留 ACL，副本会继承目标目录权限，ssh 判定"太宽"而拒收。要么原地生成，要么复制后 `icacls` 收紧。

**Q：token 能代替 SSH 吗？**
能，但 token 会进 shell 历史或配置文件；SSH key 不需要在对话里传递任何秘密。

## 安全约定

- 私钥只放本地默认目录，`.gitignore` 已排除 `id_ed25519`、`known_hosts`、`*.pem`
- 提交作者默认 `用户名@users.noreply.github.com`（建议在 GitHub 设置里开启 "Keep my email addresses private"）
- 扫描器对自身源码里的规则字符串做了跳过，避免误报

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: switch the session terminal tool from pwsh to the local Git Bash on Windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-terminal-tool

在 Windows 上把模型的终端工具从 **pwsh** 换成 **本机 Git Bash** 的 DSH 插件。

设计取向：**一个开关、所有 preset 跟随、不动 preset 文件、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**。默认 `dialect: pwsh`，装上去什么都不变；改成 `bash` 后，**新会话**拿到 `bash` 工具、`pwsh` 从该会话的工具目录里消失，已开的会话保持原状。

> **临时替代方案**：DSH 目前没有内置的「终端 / Git Bash 选择」能力。**在官方能力落地前，本插件是它的临时替代方案**——用官方已发布的执行器与工具，把 Windows 上新会话的终端换成 Git Bash；Windows 受限沙箱档位下的 `confinedPolicy` 同属这段临时接线。**官方提供等价设置后即可停用本插件**：从 profile 依赖里移除本行并重启，新会话即回到官方终端工具。插件不改 DSH 安装目录、不改任何 preset、不接管全局 `ctx.shell`，配置只写进当前 profile 的 patch 层；卸载不需要清理任何全局状态。`minimalMode: variant` 是这条界线上的例外，但不是对它的破坏：持久终端版本以**新增预设** `minimal-gitbash` 的形式注册，官方 `minimal` 预设原样保留；没有会话再引用它时，这个预设会自行消失。详见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)。

---

## 为什么要这个插件

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的平台组合在 Windows 上是互斥的：

```yaml
- id: bash-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
- id: pwsh-sandbox
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
  disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
- id: tool-bash          # 同样的平台断言
- id: tool-pwsh
```

`ctx.shell` 是单实例服务（同一 context 内加载第二个会抛错），所以 Windows 上根本没有 bash 执行器，`bash` 工具也不存在。想用 Git Bash 只有三条路：

| 路线 | 代价 |
|---|---|
| 改 `dsh-base` / profile patch 的平台断言 | 要动第一方组合，重启，且只影响那一个平面 |
| 自研 PTY / 自研工具 | 重写 60KB+ 的工具契约，容易与官方行为漂移 |
| **本插件：会话级隔离替换** | 只在新会话的 `isolate('shell')` 子树里注入执行器，宿主平面不动 |

本插件选第三条。

---

## 工作原理

插件本身不实现终端。它做四件事，全部复用第一方组件（官方 `minimal` 预设另有一个变体入口，见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)）：

1. **执行器**：`GitBashExecutor extends LocalBashExecutor`，只改三处——
   - `execute()` 用配置的 `bash.exe` 绝对路径组 `[bash, -c, command]`（基类硬编码 `"bash"`，在 Windows 上会命中 `System32\bash.exe`，那是 WSL 启动器）；
   - `resolve()` 注入 `PATH`（`spawnSpec` 里 `spec.env` 是唯一能塞 PATH 的位置）；
   - 受限档位下按 `confinedPolicy` 选择直接启动、走官方 `ctx.sandbox.confine()`，还是明确报错（见「受限沙箱策略」）。

   超时、输出收集与溢出、abort 分类、`dshEnv` 合并、结果整形全部继承，行为与官方 bash 执行器一致。

2. **工具本体**：直接挂官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash`。前台/后台、超时转后台、`sandbox_permissions` 升级、会话 cwd、工具卡片、退出码标记，官方自带。

3. **会话级替换**（`src/replace.ts`，在 `agent/created` 里执行）：
   ```
   shellCtx = agentCtx.isolate('shell')       // 该 agent 私有的 shell realm
   shellCtx.plugin(GitBashExecutor, {...})    // 只在这个子树里可见
   shellCtx.plugin(ToolBash, {...})           // 注册出的 bash 落在 agent 自己的工具层
   agentCtx.tools.restrict({ deny: ['pwsh'] })          // 只过滤「继承来的」工具
   agentCtx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'tool:pwsh', text: '' })  // 空文本=渲染时丢弃
   ```
   四步都登记在 `agentCtx` 上，会话结束由 cordis 逆序释放；中途失败则逆序回滚，会话退化为原样。

4. **配置与设置行**：所有字段 `.volatile()`，同一份 entry Config 由 Host 交给官方 `configForms` 服务；**客户端半区**（`lib/client.js`）把它渲染成 **设置 → 通用 → 终端工具** 的一行，写回仍落在 profile 的 patch 层。行内控件全部复用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `Button` / `Input` / `Menu` / `IconChevronDownOutlineRegular`，外观与相邻的官方设置项同源；该包只作为 devDependency 提供类型，运行时由 Web shell 的冻结模块表（`PLATFORM_MODULES`）播种，bundle 像 `require('react')` 一样 `require()` 它，插件不在运行时安装任何依赖。

### 关键设计约束（为什么不那么做）

- **不接管全局 `ctx.shell`**：那会让所有会话（包括没选 bash 的）跟着变，并且与宿主平台的执行器冲突。
- **不编辑 preset**：`preset-standard` 在 profile 里是完整快照，改它等于接管用户的组合文件，且升级会被覆盖。极简模式的变体同理——它是**新增**一个注册项（`minimal-gitbash`），不是改官方 `minimal` 的定义。
- **只对新会话生效**：工具与 prompt 是会话创建时装配的，运行中换不掉——这是 DSH 的语义，不是插件的取舍。
- **`restrict` 只过滤继承层**：官方文档明确 "never what its OWN layer registers"，所以从 agent scope 调 `restrict({deny:['pwsh']})` 恰好只隐藏 preset 带进来的 `pwsh`，不影响本层注册的 `bash`。
- **沙箱策略是显式配置，不由插件悄悄绕过**：默认 `confinedPolicy: unconfined` 在 Windows 受限档位下直接启动 Git Bash，命令因此不受文件沙箱约束——这是用户在设置里看得到、可改回的选择；`escalate` 仍走官方 `ctx.sandbox.confine()` 与官方审批，`fail` 明确报错。插件只把 MSYS 启动失败分类成 `denied`，不自己实现审批。

---

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Windows + DSH Desktop `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh` 范围；本插件在此范围内开发与验证）
- **Web shell 自带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`**：0.2.1-rc.2 起该包由 Web shell 的冻结模块表（`PLATFORM_MODULES`）播种，插件设置行的 bundle 像 `require('react')` 一样 `require()` 它，不会内联第二份 atoms。宿主升级到范围外时设置行可能加载失败，但 Host 半区的替换逻辑不依赖这张模块表
- 本机已装 Git for Windows（或 MSYS2 / Cygwin）
- Windows 受限沙箱下 Git Bash 无法在沙箱内启动：默认 `confinedPolicy: unconfined` 直接启动（模型命令不受文件沙箱限制），也可选 `escalate`（官方审批）或 `fail`（报错），见「受限沙箱策略」

### 步骤

```powershell
# 1. 构建（产物在 lib/）
git clone https://github.com/road-kid/dsh-terminal-tool.git
cd dsh-terminal-tool
npm install
npm run check        # typecheck → build → contractcheck → clientsmoke → selftest → rowselftest → rendertest → integration → ptytests

# 2. 装进 profile（本机 profile 为 desktop）
#    用插件管理器从本地目录安装：
#    plugin_manager install_bundle → target = 本仓库的绝对路径
npm pack
# 或把 tarball / 目录放进 profile 的依赖里，例如
#   C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json
```

插件包自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`，profile 的组合层会读取它并插入：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: terminal-tool
      name: dsh-terminal-tool
      disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
```

**安装或升级后必须重启 DSH**：运行中插入的 row 只进组合树，插件的 `apply` 不会被调用。

### 启用

重启后打开 **设置 → 通用**，底部会多出一行 **终端工具**（客户端半区注册的 `settings.general.item` 行，id `terminal-tool`，order 60）：

```
终端工具                                     [Git Bash（bash） ▾]
模型执行命令时使用的终端；改动只影响新会话。
Git Bash 路径                    [C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe]  [自动发现]
```

（上面是选中 `bash` 后的样子；默认 `pwsh` 时没有第二行。）

- **版式与官方 General 段设置行一致**：两列，左侧标题（14px/20px）+ 一句说明（12px/18px），右侧控件；24px 列间距、16px 纵向内边距、`.5px` 底部分隔线（`--dsw-alias-border-l2`）。颜色全部取 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计变量，跟随主题。
- **终端类型**是一枚官方下拉触发器（36px、`--dsw-radius-md`、`--dsw-alias-bg-module-platform`、chevron），点开是官方 `Menu`——与官方段里所有枚举型偏好的渲染方式相同。**默认 `pwsh`**：装插件本身不改变任何行为。
- 选 `bash` 后才出现路径行。路径默认是官方 `Input`，直接填 `bash.exe` 的完整路径；「自动发现」命中多于一条时，输入框换成同一套下拉，列出全部可用路径。路径为空时有提示；扫描中按钮文案变为「正在扫描…」，扫不到会明确提示，而不是清空输入。
- 已经选好的路径**不会**被后续扫描改写（除非它已失效）。
- `bash` 时路径行之后还有 **受限沙箱时** 下拉（`unconfined` / `escalate` / `fail`，默认 `unconfined`）；选中 `unconfined` 会显示提示：模型执行的命令不受文件沙箱限制。三种取值的后果见「受限沙箱策略」。
- 再下一行是 **极简模式** 下拉（`leave` / `oneshot` / `variant`，默认 `oneshot`），只在方言为 `bash` 且平台受支持时出现，用于处理官方 `minimal` 预设的持久终端。选 `variant` 后行内会显示变体状态：已注册 / 注册失败（带原因）；关掉选项但仍有会话引用时，提示里会给出引用数。见[极简模式](#极简模式minimal-preset)。
- **挂载时不扫描、不写配置**：扫描只在点「自动发现」时发生，并把选中的 `bashPath` 与可用列表 `bashCandidates` 原子写回；`/state` 只读配置，所以打开设置是瞬时的。运行中的会话保持启动时的终端类型——这是 DSH 的装配语义。
- 能力或设置服务不可用时行内会说明原因（例如「当前 DSH 版本不支持自动切换：{reason}」）；配置只读时所有控件禁用。非 Windows 上整行不渲染。

设置行通过两条 `/api` 路由（都不写配置；写入仍走 `configForms`，落 profile patch 层）：

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/state` | 平台、设置可用性、当前值、能力探测。**不扫描**，所以打开设置是瞬时的 |
| `POST /api/dsh-terminal-tool/discover` | 用户点「自动发现」时才调用，返回全部可用候选 |

Config 字段（设置行直接编辑 `dialect`、`confinedPolicy` 与 `bashPath`；点「自动发现」会原子写回 `bashPath` + `bashCandidates`；其余字段仍可直接写 profile patch）：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dialect` | `pwsh`（默认，行为不变）/ `bash` |
| `bashPath` | 显式 bash.exe 绝对路径；留空 = 自动发现 |
| `bashCandidates` | 上一次「自动发现」的可用路径（也接受手填的安装根目录） |
| `autoDiscover` | 会话装配时 `bashPath` 为空是否自动发现 |
| `discoverTimeoutMs` | 一次发现的上限（只 stat 文件，不 spawn） |
| `loginShell` | 传 `-l`，读取登录 profile |
| `extraPath` | 追加到子进程 PATH 的目录 |
| `pythonUtf8` | 导出 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` |
| `confinedPolicy` | Windows 受限档位下的处理方式：`unconfined`（默认，直接启动，不经文件沙箱）/ `escalate`（先走官方沙箱；首次失败返回官方 denial 提示，模型带 `sandbox_permissions` 重试并审批）/ `fail`（抛 `SandboxUnavailableError`，提示改配置） |
| `minimalMode` | 官方 `minimal` 预设的处理方式：`leave`（保留官方持久终端）/ `oneshot`（默认，旧行为，换成一次性 `bash`）/ `variant`（另注册持久 Git Bash 预设 `minimal-gitbash`）。只影响 `minimal` 会话 |
| `timeoutMs` / `maxTimeoutMs` / `maxOutputBytes` / `maxSpillBytes` / `graceMs` | 继承自官方 bash 执行器的同名字段 |

把 `dialect` 改成 `bash`，**新建会话**即可看到工具目录里是 `bash` 而不再是 `pwsh`。已开的会话不受影响。

---

## 自动发现顺序

`bashPath` 为空且 `autoDiscover` 为真时，按下列顺序找，命中即止：

1. `bashCandidates` 里的每一项（展开为 `bin\bash.exe` / `usr\bin\bash.exe`）
2. 注册表 `HKLM\SOFTWARE\GitForWindows` 的 `InstallPath`
3. `%ProgramFiles%\Git`、`%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Git`、`%LocalAppData%\Programs\Git`
4. `%ProgramFiles%\MSYS2`、`C:\msys64`、`%LocalAppData%\MSYS2`
5. `%SystemDrive%\cygwin64`、`%SystemDrive%\cygwin`
6. PATH 上 `git.exe` 反推（`<root>\bin\bash.exe`）

**WSL 被硬排除**：`C:\Windows\System32\bash.exe` 和 `WindowsApps\bash.exe` 都不是 Git Bash，交给执行器会得到另一个操作系统和另一套文件系统。

发现只做文件系统探测（`statSync`）+ 一次异步 `reg.exe query`，**不会 spawn `bash --version`**——宿主在 `agent/created` 里串行派发事件，同步 spawn 会卡住整个进程。

---

## PATH 组装

执行时子进程 PATH = `工具链 bin` → `usr\bin` → `bin` → `usr\local\bin` → `extraPath` → **宿主 PATH**。

顺序是有意的：MSYS2 的 `git`/`ls`/`grep` 必须赢过 Windows 上的同名同源工具，而宿主 PATH 必须保留，否则 `node`/`python` 等原生命令会消失。去重按「小写 + 去尾分隔符 +

# Language Guard (dsh-language-guard)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

> Make the DSH agent think and answer in the language you choose — Simplified Chinese by default, three strength levels, effective on the next message, zero dependencies, no build step.

---

## Table of Contents

- [Why you need it](#why-you-need-it)
- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Install](#install)
- [Strength levels](#strength-levels)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Automatic language mode](#automatic-language-mode)
- [Settings panel and quick language switch](#settings-panel-and-quick-language-switch)
- [The `/language` slash command](#the-language-slash-command)
- [Verifying that the constraint reached the system prompt](#verifying-that-the-constraint-reached-the-system-prompt)
- [Coexisting with dsh-context](#coexisting-with-dsh-context)
- [How it differs from the official cot-translation plugin](#how-it-differs-from-the-official-cot-translation-plugin)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Design boundaries](#design-boundaries)
- [License](#license)

---

## Why you need it

The DSH system prompt is assembled from many sections: identity, plan policy, team policy, **tool descriptions**, deliverable references, deployment persona. The largest block by far is the tool documentation — written in English, and placed in the middle of the prompt.

Measured on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (everything after order 50): **98.1% of the characters and 99.8% of the ASCII** come from English tool documentation, and 5.7K–14K characters separate the opening section from the closing one. The model reads overwhelmingly English tokens, and so it drifts:

- The first few turns stay in your language;
- as soon as it starts chaining tool calls, reading long files, or reasoning at length, the reasoning slides back into English;
- nothing in your settings changed — the conversation simply got longer.

A single "please answer in Chinese" line at the very top of the system prompt is enough for a short session. It is not enough for a long one, because that line sits tens of thousands of characters away from the place that actually influences the model (the tool documentation).

This plugin puts a constraint in **three places**: at the very start, right after the tool documentation, and at the very end. The default level (Strong) costs roughly 118 extra characters per request and buys one restatement positioned after the English tool docs.

## What it does

Three resident system-prompt sections, registered through `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`, never disposed, switching level only switches their text:

| Section name | Order | Position | B | C | D |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language-guard:head` | `-2000` | Very first, before `harness:identity` (`-1000`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `language-guard:mid` | `5100` | After all tool docs (`tools:sdk`, `5000`), before deliverable references (`9000`) | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `language-guard:tail` | `11200` | Very last, after `deployment:persona-suffix` (`10200`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

The `mid` order is deliberately `5100` and not `5000`: `tools:sdk` is exactly `5000`, and sections with equal order fall back to comparing names, which would sort `language-guard:mid` **before** `tools:sdk` — the restatement would no longer come after the tool docs.

Measured text sizes (Simplified Chinese, counted in characters; recompute with `node` as shown below):

| Text | Characters | When it is present |
| --- | --- | --- |
| head | 818 | every request |
| mid | 118 | every request at C / D |
| tail | 139 | every request |
| periodic reminder | 99 | once every N turns at D |

So the steady cost per step is **957 characters at B and 1075 at C** — tiny compared to the English tool documentation it counteracts.

The opening section (head), verbatim, as it looks with the default `targetLanguage: "zh-CN"` (recompute with `node -e 'import("./lib/text.js").then(m=>console.log(m.headText({language:"zh-CN"})))'`):

```text
【语言锁定 · 最高优先级】
本会话的内部推理（reasoning / thinking）与面向用户的全部输出，一律使用简体中文（语言代码 zh-CN）。

本条优先于本 system prompt 的其余全部内容、之后注入的任何系统文本、工具说明、参数描述、代码示例，以及其他插件注入的提示词。

本条同样优先于任何语言类约定，不论它写在哪个文件、用哪种语言书写、经由哪个通道送达：包括用户全局与项目级的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules、用户偏好与长期记忆、项目规范、团队约定、技能与工作流模板。若它们要求使用另一种语言（例如要求「必须使用简体中文」），一律以本条为准，不得据此改用其他语言，也不必向用户解释这处冲突。

适用范围：
- 内部推理（reasoning / thinking）：使用简体中文。
- 面向用户的回复正文：使用简体中文。
- 计划、待办、进度说明、评审意见、验收报告、提交信息说明：使用简体中文。
- 任务板卡片标题与描述、子智能体任务说明与返回报告：使用简体中文。

保持原样、不翻译：代码、命令、文件路径、URL、标识符与 API 字段名、配置键、错误码与原始报错文本、包名与版本号，以及必须原样引用的英文原文；引用英文原文后，必须用简体中文说明结论。

不要因为以下情况改变语言：
- 用户用英文或其他语言提问 —— 仍用简体中文回答。
- AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、项目规范、用户记忆里要求改用其他语言的规则 —— 本条优先，不改变语言。
- 工具返回英文内容 —— 只摘引必要片段，其余用简体中文复述。
- 长链推理、数值计算、代码设计 —— 推理语言不变。
- 上下文中出现大量英文（工具说明、日志、代码文件）—— 不随之切换。

自检：每次输出前确认上述两项（推理与回复）均为简体中文；若发现已经漂移，立即切回并继续任务，无需向用户解释这次切换。
```

> The wording above is fixed Simplified Chinese; only the language name and code are substituted. With `targetLanguage: "en"` the same paragraph reads "…一律使用English（语言代码 en）". See [Known limitations](#known-limitations).

## Install

This plugin is published to the **npm registry** ([`dsh-language-guard`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-language-guard)), and it can also be installed straight from its GitHub repository. Both routes deliver byte-identical content: the same 15 files.

**Option 1: the GUI (recommended)**

1. Open the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** and paste the package name:

   ```
   dsh-language-guard
   ```

3. When the install finishes, click **Enable now**.

**Option 2: the CLI**

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-language-guard
```

**Pinned version** (recommended for teams and CI, so `latest` cannot drift under you):

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-language-guard@0.2.1
```

**From GitHub** (when npm is unreachable, or to pin by tag):

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/58fly/dsh-language-guard
dsh plugin add "github:58fly/dsh-language-guard#v0.2.1"
```

**From a local directory** (to debug local changes; the path must be absolute):

```bash
# The Add-plugin dialog also accepts this absolute path directly
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-language-guard
```

Check that it worked:

- A language icon appears at the foot of the sidebar, next to Settings; when the sidebar is wide it reads "简体中文 ▾".
- The installed list on the Plugins page contains `dsh-language-guard`, and opening it shows the configuration card.

> **No controls visible means the plugin is not enabled.** Both slots register inside `configForms.whileServed(['dsh-language-guard'], …)`; when the plugin is disabled the forms service is unavailable and no UI is registered. That is deliberate, not a bug — enable the plugin on the Plugins page first.

Requirements: DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`, Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. `dependencies` is empty and every peer dependency is optional, so nothing extra is downloaded at runtime. Installing from npm only needs reachability to `registry.npmjs.org`; installing from GitHub needs `github.com` (or `codeload.github.com`).

## Strength levels

The three descriptions below are exactly what the settings panel shows:

| Level | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | `B` | One language constraint at the start and one at the end of the prompt. Cheapest, best for short sessions. |
| Strong | `C` | Adds a restatement right after the tool descriptions on top of Basic, countering drift from English tool docs. Recommended default. |
| Periodic | `D` | Adds a language self-check at the start of every Nth turn on top of Strong, for long sessions. The reminder appears as a session record and is visible in the session log. |

Behaviour differences:

| Behaviour | B | C | D |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Resident system-prompt sections | head + tail | head + mid + tail | head + mid + tail |
| Restatement after tool docs | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Self-check every N turns | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ (N defaults to 8, range 3–50) |
| New record in the session log | none | none | one per N turns (`source.kind = "language-guard"`) |
| Injection timing | — | — | the **first step** of a matching turn, alongside that turn's user message; no extra request |
| Counter after restart / resume | — | — | **not reset**: the turn number comes from the sessi

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager

English | [فارسی](README.fa.md)

**Session deletion for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.**

DSH can archive sessions but never delete them — the shipped persistence layer
has no deletion API, and workspace deletion keeps every session log on disk.
This plugin fills that gap:

- **Sidebar** — every session's `…` menu gets a **Delete…** row (after the
  shipped *Copy Session ID*), with a confirmation dialog.
- **Settings → Session Manager** — a management page listing every registered
  workspace and every orphaned directory with per-session sizes, event counts,
  and dates: per-row delete, checkbox bulk delete, and *Delete workspace data…*
  (removes the registration **and** its session logs). A **search box** matches
  title / session id / path, and an **older-than** filter narrows the list by
  last activity.
- **Trash, not `rm`** — deleted session directories are *moved* to
  `$DSH_HOME/trash/sessions/<timestamp>--<id>/` with a `manifest.json`, so the
  settings page can **Restore** them until you *Empty trash*.

## How it works

```
┌──────────────────────┐  same-origin fetch   ┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ lib/client.js        │ ───────────────────▶ │ lib/index.js (Host half)    │
│  • menu slot row     │  /session-manager-…  │  • authenticated HTTP route │
│  • settings page     │ ◀────────────────── │  • workspaceRegistry        │
└──────────────────────┘      JSON           │  • sessionPersistence       │
                                             │  • archive → move to trash │
                                             └─────────────────────────────┘
```

Third-party client bundles get no package RPC channel in DSH (the Remote
namespaces are fixed at build time), so the two halves talk over the plugin's
own HTTP route registered through `ctx.webServer` — the documented
route-owner pattern. Every request passes the same browser trust fence as the
shipped `/api` route (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`), so only an
authenticated DSH page can call it; the browser's signed cookie rides the
same-origin `fetch` automatically.

Deletion flow per session: refuse if live → archive through
`workspaceRegistry.archiveSession` (so the row leaves the sidebar's default
*Hide archived* view immediately) → `rename` the session directory into the
trash → drop the empty project directory. Workspace purge: refuse if any of
its sessions is live → `workspaceRegistry.delete` → move every session
directory of that path to the trash.

## Install

Install straight from this repository — a Git address is a valid plugin spec:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/mehdinikzad68/dsh-session-manager
```

or paste the same URL into the Web GUI's **Plugins → Add plugin** dialog. For a
local checkout, pass the package directory's path instead. The bundle is
enabled on install: profiles with `patchReload: live` mount it without a
restart, while startup-only profiles (such as the Desktop profile) need one
DSH restart.

## Safety

- A **live** session (present in the in-memory session store or the agent
  registry) is always refused — stop it first.
- Deletion is a move, never an unlink: everything is recoverable from the
  trash until *Empty trash*.
- The HTTP API enforces DSH's browser authentication (401/403 otherwise).

## Limitations

- The sessions root is derived as `$DSH_HOME/sessions` (default `~/.dsh/sessions`).
  A profile that configures a different persistence `root` is not detected
  (v0.1).
- Session titles come from cached projection hints; sessions without hints
  show their id.
- `restore` recreates the directory (and unarchives if we archived it), but a
  workspace whose registration was purged must be re-registered by opening
  the folder again.
- After a delete, the sidebar hides the row via archive; the session summary
  disappears from lists on the next refresh.

## Roadmap

Feature ideas on deck, roughly in order — several inspired by the community
plugin [dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager)
by hkkz9522:

- **Richer batch mode** — select-all-matching, per-group actions, and a
  preview summary dialog before destructive bulk deletes.
- **Workspace visibility** — archive/unarchive a whole workspace from the
  management page.

MIT © Mehdi Nikzad

# dsh-latex

> **English** | [中文](./README.zh.md)

Make the DeepSeek Harness chat render formulae as formulae, and make the model **write LaTeX by default** instead of wrapping math in `latex` fences.

## What it fixes

DSH's frontend already renders TeX through KaTeX (`MarkdownText` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`), but:

| Symptom | Cause | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|
| Formulae show up as a grey code block | The model writes them in ```` ```latex ```` / ```` ```tex ```` fences, which the frontend never renders (only `$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)`, `\[...\]` and ```` ```math ```` are supported) | The host half states the output contract in the system prompt; the browser half renders legacy `latex`/`tex` fences in place |
| During streaming the answer shows raw `$` and `\frac` | The frontend deliberately keeps TeX literal while streaming and swaps in KaTeX once the message settles | Left alone (upstream design); renders correctly after settling |
| A few formulae turn into harsh red text | KaTeX strict mode: `align`, `\si{}`, `\ce{}` are outside the supported subset | Forbidden by the prompt; the browser half turns the red error into a readable badge |
| Wide display math overflows the bubble | KaTeX display blocks do not scroll by default | The browser half adds horizontal scrolling and padding |

## Install

### From GitHub (recommended)

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:sbVAN/dsh-latex
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards, then reload the page once (the browser half needs to load the new bundle).

### Development: link a local checkout

```powershell
# 1. register a link dependency in the profile package.json:
#    "dsh-latex": "link:Z:/文件留存/deepseek project/dsh-latex"
# 2. create the junction (the equivalent of pnpm's link:)
New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-latex" `
  -Target "Z:\文件留存\deepseek project\dsh-latex"
# 3. append to the profile's cordis.patch.yml:
#    - insert:
#        - id: latex
#          name: dsh-latex
# 4. restart DeepSeek Harness (the host half needs the new composition)
```

After that the browser half can hot-reload through HMR when `hmr.root` covers the plugin sources.

## Configuration

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: latex
      name: dsh-latex
      config:
        strict: true
        compact: false
        locale: zh
        extraRules:
          - Write water as $\mathrm{H_2O}$, never \ce{}.
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Disables the prompt section entirely (the browser half still runs) |
| `locale` | `auto` | `zh` / `en` / `auto` (auto follows `DSH_LOCALE`, `LANG`, defaulting to Chinese) |
| `strict` | `true` | `true` forbids fenced formulae; `false` only recommends |
| `compact` | `false` | Shorter prompt, roughly 1/3 of the tokens |
| `order` | `145` | Section order inside the system prompt (tool guidance owns 100–199) |
| `extraRules` | `[]` | Extra bullet lines appended to the contract |

## Behaviour

### Host half (`lib/index.js`)

Registers `ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name: 'dsh-latex:math-output', order, text })` with a contract covering inline `$...$`, display `$$...$$`, a ban on fenced formulae, the KaTeX-supported subset (`aligned` over `align`, `pmatrix`/`bmatrix`/`cases`, `\mathrm{}` over `\si{}`/`\pu{}`/`\ce{}`, no `\label`/`\tag`), CJK only inside `\text{}`, and splitting long derivations.

The section is disposed with the plugin fiber, so hot reload cannot leave duplicates. The rendered contract is written to `$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-latex/prompt.txt`, mount diagnostics to `mounted.json`.

### Browser half (`lib/client.js`)

- display-math scrolling and an error badge;
- `pre > code.language-latex|tex` gets a preview below it, rendered with the shared `MarkdownText` (no bundled KaTeX), source folded by default;
- toolbar with show/hide source and copy LaTeX;
- 300 ms debounce over a full scan, orphan cleanup, and root unmount when React replaces nodes.

## Limitations

- **No math while streaming** — that is the frontend's deliberate behaviour and this plugin does not fight it.
- **Only `latex` / `tex` fences are handled** — `math` fences are already rendered upstream.
- **No mhchem** — `\ce{}` / `\pu{}` still fail; the prompt routes them to `\mathrm{}`.
- **No `conversation.chat.node` takeover** — replacing the assistant renderer means duplicating the whole message structure and breaks on upstream upgrades.
- **No history rewriting** — the prompt constrains future output only; old sessions are covered by the browser half.

## Rollback

Remove the junction, drop the insert line from `cordis.patch.yml`, restore the profile `package.json`, restart. No DSH file is modified.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Codex-style file-based long-term memory for DSH: two-stage extraction, consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt-injected summary, and search/read/list/note tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-memories

Codex-style **long-term memory** for DSH: cross-session memory that ingests finished sessions, consolidates them into a searchable handbook, and injects a compact summary before every turn.

It reproduces the two-stage structure of the Codex memory system rather than approximating it: per-session extraction first, then a consolidation pass over many raw memories.

## Why

DSH sessions are isolated by default. A correction you made yesterday, a command that only works in one repo, a symptom/cause/fix you already paid for — none of it carries over unless you restate it. This plugin makes the agent remember:

- how you want it to work, without being told twice
- where the truth lives in a specific repo, and which commands actually run
- which failure has which fix

## How it works

```
session goes idle for N seconds
   └─ Stage 1  one model call per session -> session_summaries/<slug>.md + raw_memories.md
        └─ Stage 2  once enough memory accumulates -> MEMORY.md + memory_summary.md
             └─ before each turn, memory_summary.md is injected into the prompt
```

All durable artifacts are plain Markdown you can read, edit, version, or move. `index.json` holds the extraction cache, job records, and the consolidation watermark.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @lushdawn/dsh-codex-memories
```

Local development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to this directory>
```

Restart DSH, or let a live profile hot-load it.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory status` | memory root, extracted sessions, pending consolidation, last timestamps |
| `/memory show` | print the current `memory_summary.md` |
| `/memory extract` | extract the current session immediately |
| `/memory backfill` | scan stored sessions and extract the ones never processed |
| `/memory consolidate` | merge pending memory into `MEMORY.md` now |
| `/memory forget <sessionId\|all>` | drop extraction records (handbook content is kept) |
| `/memory on` / `off` | toggle automatic extraction for this process |

## Tools

Exposed to the model when `dedicatedTools` is on:

| Tool | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_search` | line-level keyword search across memory files (`any` / `all` / `on_same_line`) |
| `memory_read` | read one memory file by line range |
| `memory_list` | inventory of the memory folder and pending work |
| `memory_note` | append one ad-hoc note — the only write path the model is offered |

The model is instructed to cite memory as `MEMORY.md:12-14|note=[...]`.

## Configuration

Every field has a safe default; override in your profile patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-codex-memories
      name: dsh-codex-memories
      config:
        storageDir: ''            # default $DSH_HOME/memories
        generate: true
        use: true
        dedicatedTools: true
        model: ''                 # e.g. deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
        extractModel: ''          # falls back to model
        consolidationModel: ''    # falls back to model
        idleSeconds: 120
        maxSessionsPerRun: 3
        maxSessionAgeDays: 30
        consolidationThreshold: 2
        maxInjectChars: 9000
        minSessionMessages: 4
        extractMaxTokens: 8000
        consolidateMaxTokens: 16000
```

When `model` is empty the plugin reads the current default model, then falls back to `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`.

## Data layout

```
$DSH_HOME/memories/
├── MEMORY.md                    # durable handbook, Task Group organized
├── memory_summary.md            # prompt-loaded layer; first line must be v1
├── raw_memories.md              # mechanical stage-1 merge, ascending session id
├── session_summaries/<slug>.md  # one structured recap per session
├── extensions/ad_hoc/notes/     # notes written by you or the model
└── index.json                   # extraction cache, job records, watermark
```

## Cost and privacy

- **It spends tokens**: one Stage-1 call per session and one Stage-2 call per consolidation. Sessions under 4 messages are skipped; at most 3 sessions are processed per sweep.
- **Local files only**: no network access beyond the model API it calls.
- **It enters your prompt**: `memory_summary.md` is injected every turn, which is why it is capped by `maxInjectChars`.
- **Auditable**: every artifact is readable Markdown.
- **The model cannot rewrite the handbook**: it may only append ad-hoc notes; consolidation is a separate pass, so one turn cannot corrupt durable memory.

## Fidelity to Codex

The behavioral spec comes from reverse engineering Codex itself — the on-disk shape under `~/.codex/memories` plus the prompt templates embedded in `codex.exe`:

| Codex | dsh-codex-memories |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.codex/memories/` | `$DSH_HOME/memories/` |
| `MEMORY.md` / `memory_summary.md` / `raw_memories.md` | same names, same formats |
| `rollout_summaries/*.md` | `session_summaries/*.md` |
| `memories_1.sqlite` | `index.json` |
| Stage 1 extraction prompt | `PHASE1_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| Phase 2 consolidation prompt | `PHASE2_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| usage guidance + citation format | `USAGE_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| rollout scan backfill | `/memory backfill` + boot sweep |

See [docs/mechanism.md](docs/mechanism.md) for the full mechanism and the evidence behind it.

## Known limits

- Stage 2 asks for two complete documents in one reply. On a very large handbook the reply can hit the output cap; the old files are then kept and the pass reports an error instead of writing something corrupt.
- Automatic extraction needs the process alive during the idle window; otherwise the next boot's `backfill` catches up.
- Retrieval is keyword/line based, not semantic — the same tradeoff Codex makes. Route with `keywords` in `MEMORY.md`.

## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For anything
security-related, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue. Release
history lives in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Draws mermaid code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams, including while the reply is still streaming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-mermaid Draws ```` ```mermaid ```` code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams — **including while the reply is still streaming**.

> dsh-plugin-mermaid — 把回复里的 ```mermaid 代码块画成图表，边流式输出边画
中文说明（点开） —— 不用等一轮回复结束才看到图 **它是什么**：模型在回复里写 ```` ```mermaid ```` 围栏，你看到的是图，不是代码。图上方一条细栏写着 `Mermaid`，右边是 **复制** 和 **源码/图表** 开关。 **为什么不是"等回复结束再画"**：DSH 渲染流式回复时，**已完成的块只解析一次、React 元素被缓存**，每个 token 只重建尾部那一块。所以规则只有一条：**源文本静止 220ms 才画**。token 在流 → 计时器一直被重置 → 什么都不画；围栏一闭、后面的正文开始到达 → 块冻结 → 图立刻出现。模型在围栏里停顿时不会画出半张图。 **复制**：图模式复制一张 PNG（2–3 倍尺寸、铺了代码块自己的底色，粘到文档里就是一张图）；源码模式复制 Mermaid 文本。浏览器剪贴板不收 SVG，所以图是先栅格化再写的 —— 这也是 Mermaid 跑在 `htmlLabels: false` 的原因：`` 里的 HTML 在"SVG 当图片"时会消失。 **认不出来就不画**：Mermaid 解析失败的块原样保留，不插任何东西。 **装法**：Plugin Manager 的 Add plugin 填 `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1`，或指向本地目录。装完**重启 app**（Host 半边开机才加载资产路由），页面再 **⌘R**。 **它没有做什么**：不改 Markdown 渲染器、不占槽位、不加工具。只在代码块的 `data-code-block-content` 里加一个节点，用一条 `:has()` 规则把源码 `
` 藏起来。
## What it does The model writes a fenced block: ````text ```mermaid flowchart LR A["工作区"] --> B["暂存区"] --> C["仓库"] ``` ```` You see the diagram, under a small bar that names it and offers **源码** (source) and copy. The block's own "Code block" banner is hidden while the diagram is shown, because the plugin never touches the `
` React owns — it
adds a sibling and hides the original with CSS.

**Copy follows the view.** With the diagram on screen the button puts a PNG on
the clipboard (2–3× the drawn size, on the block's own surface colour, so it
pastes into a document without a transparent-background surprise); with the
source on screen it copies the Mermaid text. Browser clipboards will not take an
SVG reliably, so the diagram is drawn through a canvas first — which is also why
Mermaid runs with `htmlLabels: false`: `foreignObject` HTML does not survive that
trip.

## Why this is not a Markdown plugin

There is no slot between "Markdown" and "code block". The only seat a plugin can
take is the whole `assistant-step` node, and taking it would mean re-implementing
Markdown — file links, image lightboxes, KaTeX, syntax highlighting, copy
buttons, sticky banners — to add one block type.

So the plugin decorates the primitive's own markup instead:

```
div.md-code-block
  div.bannerWrap                   ← hidden while a diagram is shown
    div[data-code-block-banner]    ← language label + copy
  div[data-code-block-content]
    pre                            ← the source (left in place, hidden by CSS)
    div.dsh-mermaid                ← the one node the plugin adds
```

The coupling is that markup. `tests/dom.test.mjs` drives a stand-in with the same
shape in a real browser, so a change to it fails loudly here instead of silently
drawing nothing.

## Why streaming needs care

DSH renders a live reply with an incremental Markdown renderer: every completed
block is parsed once and its React elements are cached, so only the growing tail
is re-rendered on each token. That gives one precise rule:

> never draw the tail; draw only a source that has stopped changing.

A block is drawn after its source has been unchanged for 220 ms. While tokens
flow the timer keeps resetting; when the fence closes and the next prose starts,
the block freezes, and the diagram appears mid-reply — no waiting for the turn to
end. A pause *inside* an open fence that lasts longer than 220 ms will draw
whatever has arrived; if the source then keeps growing, the panel is dropped and
redrawn, and a source Mermaid rejects leaves the code block exactly as it was.

Rendered diagrams are cached by source + theme, so a re-render (React rebuilding
the message, a theme switch) costs no Mermaid work.

## Where Mermaid comes from

The browser half asks the Host for `/api/mermaid.asset.js`; the Host serves the
`mermaid.min.js` from this package's own dependency tree over the same
authenticated, same-origin channel as the rest of the Web UI. The build is found
by Node's own resolution (`createRequire`), not by a fixed
`./node_modules/…` path: pnpm — which the Plugin Manager uses — keeps a
package's dependencies *beside* it, so a fixed path would 404 on every install
from Git while working perfectly in a linked checkout. It is a 3.4 MB
script, so it is fetched the first time a diagram is seen, not on every page
load, and revalidated with an ETag.

## Limits

- Diagrams are rendered in the browser only. A DSH client without the plugin (a
  phone on an old tab, `--no-client` tooling) shows the code block.
- Mermaid's `strict` security level is used: HTML labels are sanitized, and
  click-to-activate links are not available.
- A diagram Mermaid rejects is not decorated at all. The reason is logged to the
  browser console (`[mermaid] …`); there is no inline error row, because during
  streaming an incomplete diagram would flash one.
- No per-block history: the panel is a view of the file's Markdown, not a record.

## Install

Use DSH's own **Add plugin** dialog. No npm account, no publishing.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| GitHub | `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1` |
| Local directory | an absolute path, e.g. `/path/to/dsh-plugin-mermaid` |

Restart the desktop app afterwards: the Host half owns the asset route and is
only loaded at startup. The browser half reloads with the page (`⌘R`).

This plugin is **not published to npm**, and `npm install` is not the install
path. Its one runtime dependency (the Mermaid build the Host serves) is installed
from the repository's `package.json`.

## Tests

```bash
npm ci
npm test           # 18: classifier, loader contract, patch/manifest consistency, the Host route, module resolution
npm run test:dom   # 33 in headless Chrome over CDP: `:has()`, real Mermaid output, the streaming sequence, both clipboard flavours
```

`test:dom` skips when no Chrome or Chromium is installed.

## Licence

MIT.

plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: move sessions to a recoverable trash from the sidebar, restore or purge them from a settings page.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-trash **Session Trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop** — move a session into a recoverable trash from the sidebar menu, then restore or permanently purge it from **Settings → Session Trash**. English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![Session Trash icon](icon.svg) ## Summary Harness keeps every session log forever. `sessionPersistence` has no deletion API — *"Nothing deletes session files"* — and the workspace registry only archives, leaving the log on disk. This plugin adds the missing capability in the safest shape it can take: a **recoverable** move, a **user-only** trigger, and no filesystem path ever crossing the wire. ## Table of Contents - [Use this plugin](#use-this-plugin) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Safety model](#safety-model) - [Scope](#scope) - [Verification](#verification) - [Further exploration](#further-exploration) - [Disclaimer](#disclaimer) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) ----- ## Use this plugin | Where | What it does | |---|---| | Session row → `…` menu | **Move to trash** — the host's own `MenuItemButton` geometry (same height, padding, icon cell and label rhythm) with its danger colouring | | Confirmation dialog | Shows the title, original path and size before anything moves; the destructive confirm is the host's outline-with-red-text pattern | | Settings → **Session Trash** | Lists deleted sessions with **Restore** and **Purge**, plus **Empty trash** | | Host startup | Removes entries older than `retentionDays` (default 30), silently | A deletion **moves the session's directory** with a single `rename` into `$DSH_HOME/session-trash/-/`, and writes a `manifest.json` beside it. Nothing is copied, so an interruption cannot leave a half-deleted session, and a failed move leaves both directories exactly as they were. ### Install The plugin is an ordinary Harness bundle, so it installs where every other plugin does: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xxiiiixx/dsh-session-trash ``` From a local checkout, point Plugin Manager at the directory (Settings → Plugins → Add, or the `plugin_manager` tool with `install_bundle`). The row it inserts is named `dsh-session-trash`, and it is enabled immediately. Restart Harness if Plugin Manager reports `restart-required`. ### Updating an installed copy A GitHub install copies the package into the profile's `node_modules`; it does **not** link back to a checkout. Editing a checkout therefore changes nothing until the change is pushed and the installed copy is replaced. ```bash cd git add -A && git commit -m "..." && git push ``` Then tell Plugin Manager to reinstall the bundle (`remove_bundle` followed by `install_bundle` with `github:xxiiiixx/dsh-session-trash`, or the same two steps in Settings → Plugins). Reinstalling a package requires a Harness restart to load the fresh JavaScript generation for the Host half; the Client half is picked up on the next page load. If you would rather have a checkout's edits take effect immediately, install it by directory path instead — that produces a junction into the profile, and a moved or renamed checkout then breaks the plugin, because the link points at the old location. ## Configuration The bundle patch inserts the Host row with no config: the plugin resolves both roots from the running DSH home at activation, so a normal install needs no per-machine editing. Every field stays overridable from the profile's own patch layer. | Field | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `sessionsRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | Where the session backend stores logs | | `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | Where deleted sessions go; must be on the same volume as `sessionsRoot` | | `retentionDays` | `30` | Automatic purge age; `0` disables the sweep | | `sweepOnStart` | `true` | Run the retention sweep once per Host start | | `maxTrashEntries` | `500` | Refuse new deletions above this count; `0` means unlimited | ```yaml - id: dsh-session-trash name: 'dsh-session-trash' config: retentionDays: 90 ``` ## Safety model Deleting a session is destructive, so most of this plugin is refusals rather than deletion. 1. **Recoverable by default.** A deletion is a move, not an unlink. Purging is a separate, explicit action inside the trash page. 2. **No path crosses the wire.** The client sends `{ op, sessionId }` or `{ op, trashId }`. The Host resolves identifiers against its own roots; there is no `path` field to smuggle. 3. **Identifiers are whitelisted** (`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, ≤ 200 characters, never `.`/`..`) and every resolved path is checked with `path.relative` after `realpath`, so a symlink or a crafted id cannot escape a root. 4. **Directories prove their identity.** Before moving anything the plugin reads the log's header line and refuses unless `header.id` matches the requested session. 5. **Only a running turn blocks a delete.** Liveness is read exactly the way the shipped archive action reads it: an Agent counts as busy only while its `status` is `running`. An idle Agent that merely stays resident in the registry does **not** block — a session you already stopped is deletable. An Agent surface that cannot report a status is treated as running, so the plugin never guesses its way into moving a log that may still be written. 6. **A derived subagent session travels with its parent; a fork does not.** A session with `origin: subagent` exists only to carry out work for its parent, so a stopped one moves into the *same* trash entry and returns with the parent on restore. A fork (`isSeeded`) is seeded from the parent's history and then stands on its own: it stays put and does not block. A derived child that is still running, or that has children of its own, refuses the whole carry and says why. 7. **`rename` only, never copy-then-delete.** `EXDEV`, `EPERM` and `EBUSY` are reported as `cross-volume` / `busy`; no fallback exists that could leave a duplicate or a partial copy. 8. **Serialized mutations.** One promise chain per service, plus a re-run of every preflight immediately before the move, which closes the window between the dialog and the action. 9. **No agent tool.** The Host half registers no tool at all. Only a person clicking the UI can delete a session; the model cannot. 10. **One endpoint, behind the standard fence.** `POST /api/session-trash` is mounted on `ctx.connection.fetch`, so it inherits Harness's Host/Origin and browser-credential checks. Bodies are capped at 64 KiB, operations are a closed set, and failures answer with a stable `code` plus a fixed sentence — never a filesystem path. 11. **The Host log is the source of truth.** Deletion drops the session from the workspace pin/archive sets and emits `api-session/removed`, the same event the sidebar already listens for, so the row disappears immediately without any plugin-private state. ## Scope - **Allowed:** any session that is not running and whose derived children, if any, are stopped. - **Refused:** a running session or derived child, a derived child that has children, a directory that is not provably that session, and anything outside the configured root. - **Not touched:** attachments referenced by the deleted log (the attachment store is global and immutable), and projection-cache rows (they are hints only and self-heal). ## Verification ```bash npm test # 65 cases: paths, config, trash service, HTTP route, Client bundle npm run e2e # end-to-end walk through the HTTP handler npm run audit # read-only verdict for every real session on this machine npm run check:css # diff the copied styles against the host's own stylesheet npm run check:liveness ``` The suite builds throwaway session roots with real Zstandard logs and asserts: read-only preflight, identity-mismatch refusal, running and derived-child refusals, atomic move with rollback, manifest round-trip, restore collision, purge containment (`../../etc` is rejecte
