plugins.description: LCU (Codex computer use) for DeepSeek Harness: macOS app control with an approval dialog, via an MCP adapter.
plugins.readme_text:
# @kinocode/dsh-lcu

[日本語](README.ja.md) | English

[LCU](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu) (Codex computer use, decoupled from the Codex app) as a
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin. The agent gets
`mcp__lcu__js` / `mcp__lcu__js_reset` to read and operate native macOS apps.

DSH's stock `dsh-mcp-client` cannot answer LCU's per-app approval requests (MCP *elicitation*), so a plain
MCP mount fails with `createElicitation is unavailable`. This plugin launches LCU behind a small adapter
(`lib/adapter.mjs`) that handles approval.

## Requirements
- macOS (Apple Silicon) with the official **ChatGPT desktop app** installed
- **LCU** installed, e.g. `~/.local/share/lcu` ([installation guide](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)); `--runtime-only` is enough
- macOS permissions: Accessibility (ChatGPT Computer Use) and Screen Recording (ChatGPT)

## Install
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kinocode/dsh-lcu
```
Restart DSH and start a new session. Other LCU location: set `prefix` (below) or `LCU_PREFIX`.

## Approval modes
Set in your profile patch:
```yaml
- id: lcu
  config:
    approval: ask      # ask (default) | all | deny
```
| `approval` | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `ask` | A macOS dialog asks you: Deny / Allow this time / Always allow (Touch ID, same as `lcu apps allow`). Closed, timed out, or answered faster than a human → denied |
| `all` | Approve every app without asking |
| `deny` | Always deny |

In every mode the adapter refuses apps the agent could use to approve itself: DSH, terminals, Claude,
`osascript` / System Events. Other config: `prefix`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`.

## What the adapter does
- Exposes only `js` and `js_reset` (host-only tools such as `turn_ended` are hidden)
- Saves screenshots as files under `$TMPDIR/dsh-lcu-shots/` and returns the path (view with `read_image`),
  because the MCP client turns images into placeholders
- Reconnects to LCU on the next call if it exits

## Safety
`all` lets the agent operate any app, including browsers and password managers. Prefer `ask`.
This is an unofficial community plugin; it is not affiliated with OpenAI or amontlabs. The ChatGPT app and
its runtime keep their own terms; this package contains neither.

## License
MIT

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `allowedModels` | `[]` | Model whitelist, adapter mode only — legacy sidecar ignores it (plugin 0.3.14+, issue #83): exact model ids DSH may show and call. Empty exposes every eligible free-lane model. Narrowing only — paid/deprecated/blocklist/probe rules still win, and a direct call to a non-whitelisted id fails fast with a tagged error before any network traffic. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | **Local OpenCode delegation** (plugin 0.3.x, [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md), ref #76) — opt-in fallback for the persistent `403 FreeTierError` credential gate. Disabled by default; the anonymous path is unchanged unless you enable it: ```yaml delegation: enabled: true # arm the delegate (default false) # opencodePath: '' # explicit binary; else managed -> global -> npm # minVersion: '1.18.0' # candidates below this are skipped # memLimit: '96MiB' # GOMEMLIMIT for the child # gcPercent: 30 # GOGC for the child # trimIntervalMs: 60000 # Windows EmptyWorkingSet tick; 0 disables # startTimeoutMs: 60000 # health-wait budget ``` Enabling it makes the plugin custody your opencode credential (only the `opencode` entry, seeded 0600 into an isolated XDG root, never logged) and run a managed local `opencode serve` when — and only when — the anonymous lane *and* its sibling retry both refuse with the credential gate. Read [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md) §2 before enabling. ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely ca

# dsh-codex-rail

English  |  中文说明

--- ## English Transforms **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** into a sleek, immersive **Codex-style dual-column workspace** with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, and smooth session history navigation. > [!NOTE] > **Author Disclaimer: This project is for personal use by the author and is a product of vibecoding.** > Crafted to bring a sleek, distraction-free, and immersive Codex dual-column workflow to DeepSeek Harness. Feature evolution and maintenance are primarily tailored to the author's daily workflow. Feedback, suggestions, and PRs are warmly welcomed! ### ✨ Key Features - 🎨 **Unified Titlebar & Activity Rail** Seamlessly fuses the native window titlebar with the 48px vertical Activity Rail, eliminating jarring borders, white gaps, and layout seams. - 🗂️ **Codex Dual-Column Layout** - **48px Activity Rail**: Consolidates plugins, web browser, terminal, and workspace switchers into a sleek vertical navigation column; - **Flexible Drawer Panel**: History sessions and side drawers slide smoothly, maximizing your conversation and coding viewport. - 👤 **Quick Account Center & Avatar Access** A dedicated 30px circular crystal avatar entry is pinned at the bottom of the Activity Rail for instant one-click access to account, profile, and model settings. - 🌈 **Wallpaper Engine Seamless Transparency** Deeply integrates with Wallpaper Engine plugins, supporting liquid glass blur, acrylic frosted sidebar, and full transparent mode with zero visual clipping. - ⚡ **Session History Navigation (Forward / Back)** Built-in browser-like navigation buttons with native global shortcuts: Alt + ← (Back) and Alt + → (Forward) to effortlessly traverse multi-turn conversations. - 🪄 **10px Floating Card Workspace** The main chat and coding area is wrapped in a refined floating container with subtle inner shadows and rounded corners for maximum visual depth. - 🚀 **Buttery-Smooth Animations** Optimized CSS transform transitions and GPU repaint boundaries, completely eliminating frame drops during sidebar expand and collapse. ### ⌨️ Keybindings | Shortcut | Description | | :--- | :--- | | Alt + ← | Navigate back to previous session history | | Alt + → | Navigate forward to next session history | | Click Bottom Avatar | Open / focus Account Center & Profile Settings | ### 📦 Installation #### Method 1: DSH Plugin Market (Recommended) 1. Open DeepSeek Harness (DSH); 2. Go to **Plugin Market**; 3. Search for `dsh-codex-rail` and click **Install**; 4. Restart or refresh DSH to enjoy. #### Method 2: Command Line ```bash # In your DSH profile directory (e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop) npm install dsh-codex-rail ``` And ensure it is enabled in your `cordis.yml`: ```yaml dsh-codex-rail: {} ``` #### Method 3: Local Symlink for Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail.git # Create Junction on Windows: mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\packages\dsh-codex-rail" "path\to\dsh-codex-rail" ``` ### ⚙️ Compatibility - **Compatible with DSH**: `>= 0.1.1-rc.1` (Full native support for DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 Desktop & Web) - **Platforms**: Windows / macOS / Linux --- ## 中文说明 将 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 界面重构为极具现代质感的 **Codex 式双列活动栏**与**全窗一体化**工作区主题插件。 > [!NOTE] > **作者声明：此为作者自用且为 vibecoding 产物。** > 本插件旨在为 DeepSeek Harness 打造精致沉浸的 Codex 双列活动栏与顶栏一体化视觉体验。功能演变与日常维护主要依据作者个人实际工作流展开，欢迎交流体验与提交 PR！ ### ✨ 核心特性 - 🎨 **全窗顶栏一体化质感** 无缝打通原生标题栏与 48px 活动栏（Activity Rail），彻底消除断层与多余留白，与原生明亮/暗黑主题深度贴合。 - 🗂️ **Codex 级双列工作流** - **48px 图标活动栏**：将插件、终端、浏览器、工作区切换等功能归拢于左侧纵向 Rail，布局井然有序； - **弹性会话面板**：侧边列表支持平滑收展，留出最大化的主对话与编码视野。 - 👤 **快捷账号中心与水晶头像入口** 在活动栏底部常驻 30px 精美圆形水晶微质感头像与个人中心入口，点击即可直接呼出或定位到账号与模型配置。 - 🌈 **壁纸引擎无缝透光与毛玻璃兼容** 深度适配 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸插件，无缝支持液态磨砂毛玻璃（Liquid Glass）、侧边栏亚克力与全透模式（Full Clear）。 - ⚡ **会话前进 / 后退历史导航** 内置导航控制按键，并原生支持 Alt + ←（后退）和 Alt + →（前进）全局快捷键，顺畅穿梭于多轮历史会话。 - 🪄 **工作区 10px 悬浮圆角卡片** 主对话与代码编辑区域采用卡片化容器包裹，搭配轻量内衬阴影与圆角设计，层次分明，极具科技美感。 - 🚀 **丝滑动画与高帧率过渡** 深度优化 CSS Transform 与浏览器重绘机制，彻底解决原生在侧边栏折叠与展开时的掉帧卡顿。 ### ⌨️ 快捷键速查 | 快捷键 | 功能说明 | | :--- | :--- | | Alt + ← | 后退至上一个会话历史 | | Alt + → | 前进至下一个会话历史 | | 点击活动栏底部头像 | 快速唤出 / 跳转个人账号中心 | ### 📦 安装与使用 #### 方式一：DSH 插件市场安装（推荐） 1. 启动 DeepSeek Harness (DSH)； 2. 进入 **插件市场 (Market)**； 3. 搜索 `dsh-codex-rail` 并点击 **安装**； 4. 安装完成后重启或刷新 DSH 即可生效。 #### 方式二：命令行安装 进入你的 DSH 用户 Profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` 或指定 workspace）： ```bash npm install dsh-codex-rail ``` 并在 `cordis.yml` 中确认启用： ```yaml dsh-codex-rail: {} ``` #### 方式三：开发者本地软链接调试 ```bash # 克隆仓库 git clone https://github.com/ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail.git # 在 DSH 的 packages 目录下建立软链接 (Windows 示例) mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\packages\dsh-codex-rail" "你的本地仓库路径\dsh-codex-rail" ``` ### ⚙️ 兼容性说明 - **兼容 DSH 版本**：`>= 0.1.1-rc.1`（完美支持 DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 Desktop 与 Web） - **适用平台**：Windows / macOS / Linux --- ## 📄 开源许可 / License 本项目基于 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 开源发布。

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入递归自化能力优化，以及可视化调整
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-harness2

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

[![CI](https://github.com/WangHaiLongWang/dsh-harness2/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WangHaiLongWang/dsh-harness2/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1--alpha.4-blue)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH/Cordis）的 Harness² 递归执行框架。在不修改模型权重的前提下，它针对一个明确任务运行 Base → INV/DOM 候选 → Probe → Compose，比较行为差异并返回采用结果；可选的领域经验库把有执行证据支持的经验用于后续任务。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 这是第三方社区项目，不是 Google 或 DeepSeek 官方产品。设计参考 Google Research 的 [Harness²](https://github.com/google-research/harness2) 与[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224)，当前精确适配 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-alpha.4`。

## 当前能力

- 内置 DSH Web 可视化面板，展示 Base → INV/DOM → Compose 流程与文件/行级 Harness Diff。
- Parallel 和 Sequential 两种递归模式；一种模式约执行 `4k` 个 rollout 和 `3k` 个编辑/合成阶段。
- INV（通用执行能力）与 DOM（领域能力）分工、匹配 Probe、选择性 Compose、匿名最终选择。
- C1–C7 Harness 组件：system prompt、guardrails、memory、tool guidance、subagents、skills、scripts。
- Token/显式价格预算、超时、取消、失败回退、运行状态和脱敏生命周期事件。
- 按 `tenant/project/domain` 隔离的经验库，以及 Base 配对评估和 CI 发布门槛。
- 32 项自动化测试、真实 DSH AgentLoop 集成测试和 `k=1` 实机冒烟。

## 安全默认值

- 普通 DSH 任务不会自动触发；只有显式调用 `harness2_run` 才执行递归。
- Bundle 默认禁用，安装本身不产生模型调用。
- `k=1`、`libraryMode=off`、`enableScripts=false`。
- C8 middleware plugin 禁止自动生成或加载。
- C7 只支持固定的 `scripts/<name>.py` 工具，且默认关闭。DSH 当前 sandbox 不承诺网络隔离，不应把 C7 当作运行不可信 Python 的完整安全边界。

## 要求

| 依赖 | 支持范围 |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0` |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-alpha.4`，源码 commit `86a402200d95fecef4529d969836f1fe13c6cb0d` |
| Cordis | `4.0.5-alpha.2` |
| Python | 仅开启 C7 时需要，命令名为 `python` |

DSH API 尚未稳定。其他 DSH 版本需要先更新 peer dependency、重新构建并运行原生 AgentLoop 契约测试。

## 安装

### 从本地源码安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/WangHaiLongWang/dsh-harness2.git
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git

cd dsh-harness2
npm install
npm run link:dsh -- ../deepseek-harness
npm test

cd ../deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(cd ../dsh-harness2 && pwd)"
```

Windows PowerShell 可以直接传绝对目录：

```powershell
npm run link:dsh -- C:\src\deepseek-harness
cd C:\src\deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add "link:C:\src\dsh-harness2"
```

安装后在 DSH Plugins 页面启用 `harness2`，或在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加：

```yaml
- id: harness2
  name: dsh-plugin-harness2
  disabled: false
```

### npm 安装

本仓库已经包含 npm 发布元数据，但只有发布到 registry 后下列命令才可使用：

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-harness2
```

## 使用

首先运行零成本预检：

```text
harness2_plan
  mode: parallel
  k: 1
```

确认预算后执行：

```text
harness2_run
  domain: office
  mode: parallel
  k: 1
  task: <完整任务描述>
```

运维工具：

| 工具 | 作用 | 模型调用 |
|---|---|---|
| `harness2_plan` | 预览调用拓扑和预算 | 无 |
| `harness2_run` | 执行递归 Harness 改进 | 有 |
| `harness2_status` | 查询活跃运行 | 无 |
| `harness2_cancel` | 按精确 run ID 取消 | 无 |

## 配置

完整字段和风险说明见 [配置参考](docs/configuration.md)。推荐起点：

```yaml
- id: harness2
  name: dsh-plugin-harness2
  disabled: false
  config:
    mode: parallel
    k: 1
    timeoutMs: 3600000
    maxParallelProposals: 2
    maxParallelRollouts: 2
    maxTotalTokens: 100000
    libraryMode: off
    enableScripts: false
    tenant: default
    project: default
    dataDir: !!js dshHomePath('harness2')
```

设置货币预算时必须同时填写真实 provider 费率。插件不会猜测价格：

```yaml
maxCost: 1.0
pricing:
  inputPerMillion: 1.0
  outputPerMillion: 4.0
  cacheReadPerMillion: 0.2
  cacheWritePerMillion: 1.0
```

以上数字只是字段示例，不是任何供应商报价。

## 数据与审计

默认数据目录位于 `$DSH_HOME/harness2/`：

```text
harness2/
├── runs/<run-id>/summary.json
├── runs/<run-id>-<stage>/run.json
├── library/<tenant>/<project>/<domain>/entries.json
└── assets/                         # C7 临时目录，正常结束后删除
```

`harness2/event` 只广播 run/stage 标识、状态和 usage，不广播任务正文、轨迹或交付物。详细内容只写入 Run Store；部署者应自行设置目录权限、备份和保留周期。

## 评估

输入 Base 和候选方法的配对 observation JSON，可生成 Win/Tie/Loss、交付率、回退率、工具错误率、Token/费用/时延、Gain-per-Cost、bootstrap 95% CI 和上线门槛：

```bash
npm run eval:report -- observations.json harness2-k1
```

门槛不通过时命令返回非零退出码。格式示例见 [examples/evaluation-observations.json](examples/evaluation-observations.json)，方法详见 [评估指南](docs/evaluation.md)。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run link:dsh -- ../deepseek-harness
npm run build
npm test
npm run demo
npm run check
```

`link:dsh` 只在本项目的 `node_modules` 中建立开发链接，不修改 DSH 源码。CI 会检出固定 DSH commit 后运行相同测试。

## 文档

- [DSH 可视化面板与 Web Harness Diff](docs/dsh-visualization-panel.md)

- [架构说明](docs/architecture.md)
- [配置参考](docs/configuration.md)
- [部署与运维](docs/deployment.md)
- [安全模型](SECURITY.md)
- [评估指南](docs/evaluation.md)
- [实施状态](docs/implementation-status.md)
- [完整开发计划](docs/dsh-plugin-harness2-development-plan.md)
- [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [变更日志](CHANGELOG.md)

## 许可证与致谢

本项目使用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。Harness²、DeepSeek Harness 及其第三方依赖分别保留自己的许可证；本仓库没有复制 Google Harness² 的实现代码。来源与免责声明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

plugins.description: DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify —— 用于 DSH 的桌面壁纸 + 毛玻璃美化插件（零布局侵入、可逐字节回滚、自带诊断面板）
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify **语言 / Languages:** 中文（本页） ｜ **English**（点击下方「English version」展开） > 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。项目名 **DSH UI Beautify**：包名 `dsh-ui-beautify`，路由 `/dsh-ui-beautify/*`，全局 `__DSHUI__`，存储键 `__dshui.*`。 > 原包名 `dsh-dsniang-beautify` 的旧存档会自动迁移；旧 hash（`#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag`）与旧 URL 参数（`?dsniang=`）仍兼容。 > 仓库：`Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`（私有） **版本：v0.8.3** · 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。 > ⚠️ **v0.1 出过事故**：它会改目标面板的 `position` / `overflow`，导致界面布局坍塌、 > 基本无法操作。v0.2 从设计上取消了所有这类改动，详见下面「为什么 v0.2 不会再弄坏界面」。 ---
English version（点击展开 / Click to expand） # English version **DSH UI Beautify** — a wallpaper + frosted-glass beautifier for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop client. Package `dsh-ui-beautify` · routes `/dsh-ui-beautify/*` · global API `__DSHUI__` · storage keys `__dshui.*`. Settings stored under the old package name (`dsh-dsniang-beautify`) are migrated automatically; the legacy hashes `#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag` and the legacy URL parameter `?dsniang=` still work. Repository: `Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`. > This is the English manual. The Chinese manual above is the full one (troubleshooting, internals, release tooling). ## What it does - **Three modes**: **Off** (factory default — touches nothing) / **Texture** (multiply blending; the wallpaper is tinted into the UI) / **Backdrop** (the image is truly behind the content, with a scrim slider). - **Real frosted glass** (`backdrop-filter`): composer card, user bubbles, DSH dialogs and menus, the whale-widget panel, and — in Backdrop mode — code blocks and attachment cards in the chat. All share one parameter set. - **Two wallpapers**: drop `deepseek 4k.png` / `deepseek 黑白无水面.png` on your Desktop and those are used; otherwise the bundled WebP fallbacks are used (you always have two options on any machine). Switching is a cross-fade (no blank frame). - **Click the background** → fades to the default background (420 ms), then restores the wallpaper after **2 s**. - Clicking bubbles, the composer, buttons, links or icons is **never intercepted**. - **Built-in diagnostics** (`Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I`): mode, wallpaper source and health, glass state, frame rate — no DevTools required. - **Motion**: the shared foundation is in place (master switch **off** by default); decorative animations are deliberately left for later. ## Three buttons | Button | Effect | Does it touch the page layout? | |---|---|---| | **Off** (default) | Everything restored; nothing is mounted | No | | **Texture** | Multiply wallpaper (default concentration 0.49) + frosted glass (with "clearing" of the composer seat's own scrim) | Adds our own layers, a class toggle, and clears background colors (byte-exact restore) | | **Backdrop** | The image really sits behind everything (`z-index:-1`), with theme-aware scrim; the shell's full-screen opaque background is overridden by a class toggle; frosted glass works here too | Only our own layers + one class-toggle rule | ## Factory defaults | Item | Default | Stored in | |---|---|---| | Startup mode | **Off** | `localStorage['__dshui.mode']` | | Texture concentration | **0.49** | `localStorage['__dshui.opacities']` | | Backdrop concentration | **0.5** | same | | Scrim strength | 0 (slider 0–90%, 1% steps) | `localStorage['__dshui.scrim']` | | Wallpaper | **`deepseek 4k.png`** (shown as `deepseek`) | `localStorage['__dshui.image']` | | Frosted glass | **on** | `localStorage['__dshui.frost.v3']` | | Glass blur / white layer | **2 px / 20%**（径向渐变：内部更透） | same | | Panel white layer (edge / center) | **94% / 80%**（径向渐变） | same | | Bubble transparency / color / blur | **45% / original color / 12 px** | same | | DSH panel blur | **20 px** | same | | Motion | **off** (master switch; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M`) | `localStorage['__dshui.motion.v1']` | | Startup splash | **on** (Rhine-Lab-style loading animation; panel toggle, `?splash=0` or `prefers-reduced-motion` skips it) | `localStorage['__dshui.splash.v1']` | | Pill position | `10, 10` (top-left) | `localStorage['__dshui.pill']` | Defaults apply only when nothing is stored yet; once you move a slider, the stored value wins. ## Install 1. Extract `dsh-ui-beautify-0.8.3.zip` → you get a `dsh-ui-beautify/` directory (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib` / `assets` (both fallback images) / `test` / `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` / `README.md` / `HANDOFF.md` / `LICENSE` — 13 entries); 2. Put it somewhere that won't be deleted (an ASCII-only path is recommended); 3. Install it through the official plugin channel with the extracted directory as `target`: `pluginManager.installBundle('file:D:\\dsh-plugins\\dsh-ui-beautify')` (same as `dsh plugin add file:...`); 4. **Restart the DSH client** (the bundle stack is collected once at startup); 5. Self-check: `node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs` inside the extracted directory — all green. The official channel registers three things (all of them are needed, otherwise the plugin manager treats the bundle as a stray entry): the `node_modules/dsh-ui-beautify` junction, the profile `package.json` `dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies`, and the `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer record. ## Uninstall 1. **Quickest** (no restart): `__DSHUI__.setMode('off')`, or open `...#dshui-off` and reload; 2. **Proper**: Settings → Plugins → `dsh-ui-beautify` → Uninstall (or `pluginManager.removeBundle('dsh-ui-beautify')`); 3. **Manual fallback**: `.rollback/` holds a copy of the pre-install profile config; restore it, remove the junction with `cmd /c rmdir "\node_modules\dsh-ui-beautify"` (links only), then restart DSH. After uninstalling, `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` runs the post-uninstall self-check: it asserts the "four-piece" state (`package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `node_modules/.modules.yaml`, `cordis.yml`) and removes a leftover `node_modules` junction (link only, never the target). Idempotent, supports `-DryRun`, writes a log, exit codes `0/1/2/3/4`. ## External side effects Pure Cordis plugin: it does **not** modify `app.asar`, the registry, scheduled tasks, environment variables or ports; no daemon, no child processes, no external network requests. Only six read-only loopback routes (`/dsh-ui-beautify/*`). Runtime changes are limited to our own DOM nodes, class toggles and CSS variables, all restored byte-exactly on teardown. The startup splash is a **same-origin iframe**; it is removed entirely when it finishes (or is skipped / times out) and never touches the host page CSS. ### User data All settings live in `localStorage` under `__dshui.*` (mode, opacities, scrim, frost, motion, splash, pill, image). Uninstalling **keeps** them by default. To wipe: ```js Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => k.startsWith('__dshui.')).forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)) ``` ## Diagnostics - Panel: `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I` (or open `...#dshui-diag` and reload). - HTTP: `/dsh-ui-beautify/status.json` (wallpaper resolution) and `/dsh-ui-beautify/diag.json` (last report). - Console API: `__DSHUI__.status()` / `.wallpaper()` / `.reapply()` / `.uninstall()` / `.setMode('off'|'multiply'|'backdrop')`. ## Motion The motion foundation (master switch, `prefers-reduced-motion`, pause on blur) and the `requestAnimationFrame` frame-time probe are in place. Motion is **off** by default; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M` toggles it. All future animations must go through `motionAllowed()`. ## Startup splash On page load a **Rhine-Lab-style** startup sequence plays (black identity act → over-exposed wash → technical HUD → six authorization steps → white-flash cut into the session), then fades out and removes itself with zero residue. It is independent of the mode: it plays by default whenever the plugin is installed. - **When it plays**: on by default; skipped automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, with `#dshui-off` (emergency switch), or `?splash=0`; `?splash=1` forces it on for debugging. - **Panel**: an "开屏动画：开/关" toggle (persisted to `__dshui.splash.v1`) plus "↻ 重播" to preview it anytime. - **Console API**: `__DSHUI__.splash.replay()` / `.skip()` / `.setEnabled(true|false)` / `.config()`. - **Isolation**: the splash is a **same-or

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 常驻余额胶囊：右下角一眼看到 DeepSeek 账户余额，不碰凭据、不需要 API Key。A tiny resident balance pill for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-pill

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A50.2.0--rc.2-blue)](package.json)
[![size](https://img.shields.io/badge/size-12%20KB-lightgrey)](client.js)

**DeepSeek Harness 常驻余额胶囊** —— 右下角一眼看到你的 DeepSeek 账户余额，不用再点开设置。

> A tiny resident balance pill for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI.
> ~12 KB of plain JavaScript, **no HTTP endpoints of its own, no credentials touched, no API key needed**.

---



## 它长什么样

界面右下角一个圆角小胶囊：

```
● 余额 ¥12.34
```

- 鼠标悬停 → 显示赠送额度、更新时间、刷新说明
- 点击 → 立刻刷新
- 每 60 秒自动刷新，**只在页面可见时计时**；切回页面或窗口重新获得焦点时立刻补一次
- 亮/暗主题自动跟随，中英文跟随界面语言

| 状态 | 外观 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 正常 | 绿点 + `余额 ¥12.34` | 读到充值钱包余额 |
| 加载中 | 灰点 + `余额 --` | 正在读取 |
| 未登录 | 灰点 + `余额 --` | 当前用 API Key，没有平台账户凭据 |
| 读取失败 | 橙点 + `余额 --` | 平台请求失败；悬停显示原因 |
| 异常 | 红点 + `余额 --` | 调用本身出错；悬停显示错误信息 |

## 快速开始

**官方桌面端** —— 侧栏 → **Plugins（插件）** → 安装 → 填：

```
github:fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill
```

装完如果没出现，**完全退出客户端（含托盘）再打开**。

**`dsh web` / 其他 profile**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill
```

装完重启 `dsh web`，浏览器 `Ctrl+F5`。

## 安装细节

### 官方桌面端（Electron 客户端）

桌面端读的是 **`desktop` profile**，而 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 这条命令**按设计会被 CLI 拒绝**——它归应用的插件管理器管。所以只能走应用内的 Plugins 页面，不能照抄下面的 `--profile web` 命令。

### 本地开发

```sh
git clone https://github.com/fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:\path\to\dsh-balance-pill
```

`link:` 是软链安装，改源码立即生效（前端改动刷新页面即可）；**之后不要移动该目录**，移动了要重新 `add` 一次。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-balance-pill
```

桌面端在 **Plugins 页面**里点卸载。

## 它是怎么工作的

余额**不是**自己去请求平台接口，而是复用宿主已经挂载的 `account` Remote 命名空间：

```js
ctx.remote.account.getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })
```

这和「设置 → 账户 → 余额」卡片调用的是**同一个宿主方法**。因此：

- **浏览器永远拿不到 token** —— 凭据、平台地址、请求头、超时、失效处理全部留在宿主侧；
- 插件不碰账号逻辑，也不需要你配置任何 API Key；
- 未登录（只用 API Key）时该方法返回 `null`，胶囊显示为「未登录」。

金额格式与官方账户卡片对齐：两位小数、千位分组、正的次分金额显示为 `<¥0.01`。

### 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向补丁；`dsh.client` 声明浏览器半边 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 只插入一行宿主条目 |
| `index.js` | 宿主半边，空实现 —— 它的唯一作用是让 Loader 有一行条目，浏览器模块系统据此发现 `dsh.client` 声明 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半边：注册进 `shell.overlay` 浮层并渲染胶囊 |

界面文案走 Client locale 服务（命名空间 `dsh-balance-pill`，`zh` / `en`）；配色只使用宿主主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`），因此亮暗主题自动跟随；控件自己打开 `pointer-events`，浮层其余部分保持点击穿透。

## 常见问题

**装完右下角什么都没有？**
依次查三处：① 装到了哪个 profile —— 桌面端必须是 `desktop`，用 `--profile web` 装的东西桌面端读不到；② `dsh.profile.bundles` 里有没有 `dsh-balance-pill`；③ 完全退出客户端再打开（热加载对首次安装不总是够）。

**一直显示「未登录」？**
说明宿主里没有平台账户凭据。去「设置 → 账号」登录 DeepSeek 账号；只用 API Key 是不会走到账户余额接口的。

**和别的挂件打架？**
它固定占据右下角 16px 处。先看看有没有其他插件（比如桌宠类）也占这块；要挪位置就改 `client.js` 里按钮的 `right` / `bottom`。

**刷新太频繁 / 太懒？**
改 `client.js` 里的 `REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS`（默认 60000 毫秒）。

**会消耗我的 API 额度吗？**
不会。它读的是账户余额，一次 `GET` 快照，不发起任何模型请求。

## 兼容性

- 在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2（Windows 桌面端）** 上实测可用；
- 只在**浏览器半边**生效（`dsh.client.platform = web`），需要宿主挂载了 `account` Remote（桌面端 / 登录了 DeepSeek 账号的 Web 端）。没有该命名空间时插件会安静地不激活，不会报错。

## 已知限制

- **只显示余额**，不做记账、不算每轮消耗。想要「今天花了多少 / 每轮花了多少 / 多厂商额度」，用 [dsh-whale-widget](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget) 这类完整桌宠记账插件更合适 —— 这个胶囊解决的是「一眼看到」。
- 位置固定在右下角，没有设置界面（改常量即可）。
- 没有单元测试。验证方式见下 —— 是「宿主是否真的把这个 bundle 编进了启动图」，而不是「代码看着没问题」。

## 开发与验证

改刷新间隔：`client.js` 里的 `REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS`。
改文案：同文件的 `COPY`。

验证插件真的被宿主加载了（而不是只躺在 `node_modules` 里）：DSH 的 `/plugins` 路由**只按精确的 `id + rev`** 响应，`rev` 由 bundle 的 `mtimeMs/ctimeMs/size` 派生：

```sh
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/plugins/??dsh-balance-pill/client.js&rev=<rev>"
```

返回 `200` 且响应体含 `__ModuleLoader__` 即说明：Loader 条目已启用、`dsh.client` 声明合法、bundle 已编入启动图。错 `rev` 或错 id 必须 `404` —— 拿这个做反向对照，否则容易把「服务器对什么都答 200」误判成成功。

## 变更记录

见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## License

MIT —— 见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。图标由脚本生成，随项目一并按 MIT 发布。

---

## English

A ~12 KB resident widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that shows your DeepSeek **account balance** in the bottom-right corner.

- Registers a React component into the `shell.overlay` slot; follows theme tokens and the client locale service.
- Reads the balance through the host's existing `account` Remote (`getBalance`) — **the browser never receives a token**, and no API key is required.
- Refreshes every 60 s while the page is visible, on click, and when the window regains focus.
- Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:fdghdfghdfghd/dsh-balance-pill` (on the official desktop app, use the in-app **Plugins** page instead — the `desktop` profile belongs to the app's plugin manager).

MIT licensed. It only *displays* the balance; for per-turn cost accounting and multi-vendor quotas, use a full desktop-pet accounting plugin instead.

plugins.description: Multi-source image search & download for DeepSeek Harness: 19 engines (Baidu/Bing/360/Duitang/Huaban/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/Wikimedia/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru/Iconify), saves into the session workspace with per-file meta.json and renders inline.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-image-hunt

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-image-hunt)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-image-hunt)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D18-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4b8bb4)](https://github.com/fomalhaut1998/dsh-image-hunt)

多图源搜图 → 下载进当前会话工作区 → 图片直接显示在对话里。**DeepSeek Harness 宿主插件，零外部依赖。**

[English](README.en.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-image-hunt)

- **14 个图源 + 7 个别名**：国内 5（百度 / 必应 / 360 / 堆糖 / 花瓣）、国外 4（DuckDuckGo / Yandex / Openverse / 维基共享资源）、二次元 4（Pixiv / Wallhaven / Konachan / Safebooru）、外加 Iconify 图标库
- **三个工具**：`image_hunt`（搜 + 下 + 显示）、`image_search`（只搜）、`image_download`（已知直链落盘）
- **每张图都有据可查**：同目录 `meta.json` 记原图直链、来源页、标题、真实像素、来源站中文名、授权信息
- **国外源自动走代理**：插件内建 CONNECT 隧道，不依赖宿主环境变量；国内源照旧直连
- **不装插件也能跑**：仓库自带 `cli.mjs`，一条 `node` 命令直接出图

## 要求

| 项 | 要求 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| DSH | 0.2.x（支持 `dsh.bundle` 补丁的版本） | 通过 `cordis.patch.yml` 注册，纯宿主侧，无需客户端半 |
| Node | **≥ 18** | 用到 `fetch` 与 `AbortSignal.timeout` |
| 依赖 | **无** | 纯 ESM，只用 `node:` 内置模块（fs / path / net / tls / http / https / zlib） |
| 系统 | Windows / macOS / Linux | 无平台特定代码 |
| 代理 | 仅国外源需要 | 默认 `http://127.0.0.1:7890`；不通会熔断并回退直连 |
| 会话 | 一个可写的会话工作区 | 输出目录被 `safeJoin` 限制在工作区内，越界直接报错 |

## 安装

```sh
# 从 npm 装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-hunt

# 或直接从 GitHub 装，跟最新提交
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fomalhaut1998/dsh-image-hunt

# 或本地开发：把本仓库 link 进 profile
#   ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json
#   dependencies["dsh-image-hunt"] = "link:/path/to/dsh-image-hunt"
#   并把 "dsh-image-hunt" 加进 dsh.profile.bundles
```

已发布：[npmjs.com/package/dsh-image-hunt](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-image-hunt)。

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主会缓存 ESM 模块，改完 `index.js` 也必须重启才生效）。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-image-hunt`。

## 快速上手

装完直接对 agent 说人话，不必记参数：

| 想要什么 | 这么说 |
|---|---|
| 中文配图 | 帮我找 6 张「城市夜景 长曝光」，要高清、不要水印 |
| 可商用素材 | 找 4 张 CC 授权、可商用的山林图，之后可能用在文章里 |
| 二次元 / 不要 AI 图 | 找 8 张吉卜力风格的乡间风景，不要 AI 生成的 |
| 只挑不下 | 先搜 20 张「莫兰迪 静物」，把候选和来源列给我 |
| 已知直链 | 把这几条 URL 的图下到 `images/todo/` |

## 工具与参数

### `image_hunt` —— 搜 + 下 + 显示

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | **必填** | 关键词。中文词在 booru 系会被内置映射转成英文 tag |
| `count` | integer | `8` | 目标下载张数，1–40。候选不足时会少给 |
| `engine` | string | `auto` | 单个图源 id 或别名，见下方图源表 |
| `sources` | string[] | — | 直接给源数组，**覆盖** `engine`，可任意混用 |
| `minPixels` | integer | `0` | 长边下限，0 = 不过滤。做 PPT / 背景图建议 ≥ 1200；`icons` 无尺寸不受影响 |
| `noAI` | boolean | `false` | 只要非 AI 图，**仅 pixiv 生效** |
| `dir` | string | `images` | 输出根目录（工作区相对路径），实际落 `dir/<关键词>/` |
| `collection` | string | — | `icons` 专用图标集：`simple-icons` / `mdi` / `tabler` / `logos` / `ph` |
| `color` | string | — | `icons` 专用，给 SVG 上色，如 `#ffffff` |

返回形状（真实一次调用的结果）：

```json
{
  "query": "禾木 冬季 雪 雾凇 村落 摄影",
  "dir": "images/禾木-冬季-雪-雾凇-村落-摄影",
  "downloaded": 4,
  "candidates": 17,
  "skipped": 0,
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "images/禾木-冬季-雪-雾凇-村落-摄影/01.jpg",
      "bytes": 5866667,
      "source": "baidu",
      "site": "百度图片",
      "width": 1440,
      "height": 2128,
      "page": "https://…",
      "url": "https://…",
      "title": "禾木冬日奇景：风雪中的童话世界"
    }
  ],
  "errors": []
}
```

`skipped` 是被跳过的候选（尺寸低于 `minPixels`、格式不支持等），`errors` 里是单个源或单张图的失败原因。

### `image_search` —— 只搜不下

参数：`query`、`engine`、`sources`、`minPixels`、`noAI`、`collection`、`color`（语义同 `image_hunt`，没有 `count` / `dir`）。

```json
{
  "query": "海边小镇 黄昏",
  "sources": ["baidu", "so360", "bing"],
  "total": 160,
  "results": [
    { "engine": "so360", "full": "https://…", "thumb": "https://…", "page": "https://…",
      "title": "…", "width": 1920, "height": 1080 }
  ],
  "errors": []
}
```

结果按源**轮转交错**，避免前 N 条被单个源占满；`total` 是去重过滤后的总数，`results` 截到 20 条。

### `image_download` —— 已知直链落盘

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `urls` | string[] | **必填** | 图片直链，1–30 条 |
| `dir` | string | `images/downloads` | 输出目录（工作区相对路径） |
| `prefix` | string | `img-` | 文件名前缀，序号自动补零：`img-01.jpg` |
| `referer` | string | — | 过防盗链用（如 pixiv 需 `https://www.pixiv.net/`） |
| `proxy` | boolean | `false` | 让这条直链走代理（抓国外图站时需要） |

返回 `{ dir, downloaded, files: [{ path, bytes, url }], errors }`。SVG 只落盘，不登记为附件。

## 图源（engine / sources）

共 **14 个图源**，另有 **7 个别名**，合计 21 个可填的 `engine` 名。

| id / 别名 | 站点 | 适合 | 实测候选 / 查询 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auto`（默认） | 百度 + 360 + Bing | 中文综合，最快 | 三源轮转 |
| `baidu` | 百度图片 | 中文语义最强，带来源标题 | 60 |
| `bing` | 必应图片（www → cn 自动兜底） | 国际原图直链多 | 70 |
| `so360` | 360 图片 | 量最大、快，但缩略图常只有 426×240 | 259 |
| `duitang` | 堆糖 | 插画 / 头像 / 手账 / 手机壁纸 | 47 |
| `huaban` | 花瓣 | 设计 / 家居 / 摄影 / 灵感图 | 40 |
| `icons` | Iconify 图标库 | SVG 图标、品牌 logo（可改色） | 40 |
| `all` | 除图标外全部 13 个 photo 源 | 要「什么都来一点」 | 270–371 |
| `both` | 百度 + 必应 | 中文语义 + 国际原图，两源互补 | 两源轮转 |
| `duckduckgo` | DuckDuckGo 图片 | 国际图，免 key | 99 |
| `yandex` | Yandex 图片 | 原图直链质量高，含 Pinterest 原图 | 60 |
| `openverse` | Openverse | CC 授权图库聚合，带 license | 60 |
| `wikimedia` | 维基共享资源 | 公有领域 / CC，多数需署名 | 40 |
| `intl` | duckduckgo + yandex + bing | 国外综合 | 三源轮转 |
| `cc` | openverse + wikimedia | 只要带授权 / 可商用的图 | 两源轮转 |
| `pixiv` | Pixiv | 二次元原创 / 同人，画师原图 | 82 |
| `wallhaven` | Wallhaven | 二次元壁纸，SFW，高分辨率 | 48–96 |
| `konachan` | Konachan | 二次元插画，按评分排序，质量稳 | 44 |
| `safebooru` | Safebooru | 量最大，但多合辑 / 拼贴 | 100 |
| `anime` | pixiv + wallhaven + konachan | 二次元综合（推荐） | 三源轮转 |
| `moe` | anime + safebooru | 二次元要量 | 四源轮转 |

- `sources:["duitang","huaban"]` 可任意混用，比合成别名更灵活。
- `engine:"icons"` + `collection:"simple-icons"` = 品牌 logo（CC0）；`color:"#ffffff"` 给 SVG 上色。
- **国外源走代理**：duckduckgo / yandex / openverse / wikimedia / pixiv / wallhaven / konachan / safebooru 标记为 foreign，只有它们经代理；bing 的 www 国际站同理。

### 二次元源的三个特性

1. pixiv 下载时会用 `/ajax/illust/<id>` 换成**原图**，画师写进 meta 的 `license`（形如 `Pixiv · @作者`），AI 图另标 `AI 生成`；
2. booru 系（konachan / safebooru）**只认英文 tag**，中文词走内置映射（宫崎骏 / 吉卜力 → `ghibli`、龙猫 → `totoro`、千与千寻 → `spirited_away` …），映射不到的中文词会被丢掉并报错；
3. `noAI:true` 只要非 AI 图（仅 pixiv 生效，实测过滤后 aiType 全为 1）。

> 想找**纯景背景**（无人物），在 safebooru / konachan 上组合 `no_humans` + 主题词，比自由词有效得多。pixiv 是角色本位，搜风景基本不可用。

## 独立 CLI（不装插件也能用）

仓库根目录的 `cli.mjs` 直接调用同一份实现，不经过 DSH：

```sh
# 克隆后
node cli.mjs "新疆 禾木村 秋景" --n 4 --min-pixels 1200

# 二次元 + 排除 AI 图
node cli.mjs "吉卜力 风景" --engine anime --noai --n 6

# 指定源 + 自定义输出目录
node cli.mjs "莫兰迪 静物" --sources huaban,duitang --out images/still-life
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `--n <数字>` | 下载张数，默认 8 |
| `--engine <名>` | `auto` / `all` / `both` / `intl` / `cc` / `anime` / `moe` / `icons` 或单个源 id |
| `--sources a,b` | 直接列源，覆盖 `--engine` |
| `--out <目录>` | 输出根目录，默认 `images` |
| `--min-pixels <数字>` | 长边下限 |
| `--collection <名>` / `--color <色>` | `icons` 专用 |
| `--noai` | 只要非 AI 图（仅 pixiv） |

输出末行是 JSON：`{ dir, downloaded, candidates, sources, files, skipped }`。

## 代理（只给国外源用）

插件内建 CONNECT 隧道，无需宿主环境变量。

- 解析顺序：`IMAGE_HUNT_PROXY` → `HTTPS_PROXY`/`https_proxy` → `HTTP_PROXY`/`http_proxy`；值取 `off`/`none`/`no`/`0`/`false` 表示关闭；缺省 `http://127.0.0.1:7890`。
- 代理不通 → 60s 熔断 + 自动退回直连（国外源此时多半超时）；`proxyErrors` 保留最近 20 条失败原因（url / error / code / addrs）供诊断。
- 三个必踩的坑：① 把连好的 socket 塞进 `http.request` 的 `createConnection` 会被隐式默认 Agent 忽略，请求绕开隧道直连 → 必须自建 `new Agent({keepAlive:false,maxSockets:1})` 并覆写其 `createConnection`；② CONNECT 响应要累积到 `\r\n\r\n`，剩余字节 `unshift` 回 socket（TLS 握手字节可能同包到达）；③ 直连兜底强制 IPv4，避免只有 AAAA 的域名先空耗 IPv6 超时。

## 设计说明

- **输出收口**：`safeJoin` 强制输出目录落在 `exec.agent.session.header.cwd`（会话工作区）内，越界抛错。
- **路径即用**：`huntStandalone(..., relBase)` 让 `files[].path` 始终是工作区相对路径（`images/cat/01.jpg`），可直接喂给 `read_image` / HTML / `present`。
- **UI 走内核**：图片登记为 attachment（`ctx.attachments.saveImage`），`output.render` 返回 `{type:"image", attachment}` 块；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool` 自带 image card，无需客户端半。附件名必须 ASCII。
- **meta 尺寸以文件为准**：各源接口给的 width/height 是索引元数据，常与真下载的文件不一致（实测 Yandex 报 2844×1600、文件 2730×1536）。下载后读字节头（jpeg/png/webp）写 `width`/`height`，接口值另存 `metaWidth`/`metaHeight`。
- **落盘按文件头判格式**：`sniffExt` —— safebooru 的 `file_url` 后缀常是 `.jpg` 实际是 PNG，content-type 也不总对。
- **多源并行 + 轮转交错**：各源并行搜，结果按源轮转合并，避免前 N 张被单个源占满。

## 已知限制

| 站点 | 情况 |
|---|---|
| Google 图片 | `tbm=isch` 只回约 92KB 的 JS 壳，`AF_initDataCallback` / `encrypted-tbn` 计

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: DSH 插件：任务完成 / 审批请求 / DSH 提问时用 Windows 原生通知（带提示音）提醒你——只有你不在看 DSH 时才打扰
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remind

**任务做完了 / DSH 需要你批准或回答，但你在看别的窗口 —— 用 Windows 原生通知（带提示音）提醒你。**

DSH 的会话跑完不会主动告诉你，切出去以后只能靠回来瞄一眼；DSH 等你批准或回答时更是干等着。这个插件把「这一轮真的做完了」和「DSH 需要你处理」都变成一条 Windows 通知，而且**只在你不在看 DSH 的时候**才打扰。

---

## 它做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 完成任务提醒 | 顶层会话的 agent 从 `running` 落回 `idle`（这一轮真的结束）；后台任务（jobs）落地时也会补一条 |
| 审批提醒 | DSH 请求批准时提醒。**只有真的在等你决定才提醒**：先等 800ms 确认窗口，期间被自动批准/拒绝/自动审批器决定掉就不打扰 |
| 提问提醒 | DSH 调用 `ask_user_question` 向你提问时提醒，通知里带问题原文（多个问题显示第一条 + 数量） |
| 提示音 | 三类通知都可配提示音（`default` / `reminder` / `alarm` / `im` / `mail` / `sms` / `call` … 或 `none` 静音）；默认任务完成用 `default`，审批/提问用更醒目的 `reminder` |
| 只在该提醒时提醒 | 用 Win32 `GetForegroundWindow` 读当前前台窗口的**标题与进程名**，命中 `focusMarkers`（默认 `DeepSeek Harness`）就认为你正在看 DSH，不弹通知（审批/提问可单独配置） |
| 通知形态 | Windows 原生 Toast（进操作中心、可关闭、可点击） |
| 通知内容 | 任务完成：`DSH · 任务完成` + 会话标题 · 工作区 · 用时；审批：`DSH · 需要批准` + 工具名 · 会话；提问：`DSH · 需要你的回答` + 问题文本 · 会话 |

### 防误报设计

一轮「结束」到真正「没事干了」之间可能还有后续动作，所以判定做了四层：

1. **只认顶层会话**：`ctx.agents.roots()` 排除子代理——子代理结束时父轮还在跑，不该打扰。
2. **静默期复查**（默认 700ms）：复查时仍须满足「agent 仍是 idle、inbox 没有排队的 `nextTurn`/`nextStep`、该会话没有 `running|stopping` 的 job、`workspace/session-activity` 里没有 `turn/job/subagent`」。任何一条不满足就放弃这次提醒。
3. **同会话冷却**（默认 5s）：避免 turn 结束与 job 落地撞在一起弹两条。
4. **宽限期**（默认 1500ms）：弹通知前先等 1.5 秒，你刚切回 DSH 就不打扰。

### 审批 / 提问提醒怎么判断「真的在等你」

- **审批**：订阅 `approval/asked` / `approval/decided` 审计对。注意 `approval/asked` 对**每一次**审批都会追加，包括策略为 `never`（直接拒绝）或自动审批器立即决定的情况——所以不是「一见到 asked 就弹」，而是先静默 `attentionSettleMs`（默认 800ms）：期间收到同 id 的 `approval/decided` 就当作没发生。
- **提问**：订阅 `tool/call`，且工具名是 `ask_user_question`。解析其参数 JSON 取问题文本；同样先静默 800ms，期间收到同 `callId` 的 `tool/result`（你已经答完或工具已返回）就取消。
- 子代理里发出的审批/提问会沿 `session.header.parentSession` 上溯，展示到顶层会话的标题上；`turn/end` 或会话销毁时清掉该会话所有待发提醒。

---

## 架构与关键取舍

```
src/index.js            宿主端 cordis 插件：订阅事件、注册 /api/dsh-remind.* 路由、拼通知
src/detect.js           「任务完成」判定（纯逻辑，可脱离 DSH 单测）
src/attention.js        「审批 / 提问」判定（确认窗口、去重、子代理上溯）
src/notify.js           Windows 通知层：调助手脚本、提示音归一化、解析结果
scripts/dsh-remind.ps1  单次 PowerShell 助手：宽限 → 前台判定 → WinRT Toast + 提示音（一次进程完成）
src/config.js           配置读写（原子写、BOM 容错、非法值夹紧）
src/contract.js         对 DSH 宿主接口的全部假设清单（升级体检用）
test/                   单测 + 真实通知实测
tools/                  侦察与验证工具（读 app.asar、带鉴权调路由、真实宿主端到端、doctor）
```

**为什么是 PowerShell，而不是 Electron 的 `Notification`？**
DSH 桌面端把宿主跑在**独立的 Node 进程**里（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host`），插件拿不到 Electron API；DSH 自身也没有对插件开放的 OS 级通知接口（整个壳里只有更新提示那一处 `Notification`）。所以走系统自带能力：Windows PowerShell 5.1 的 WinRT Toast API。整轮（含前台判定）实测约 **300ms**，任务完成这种低频事件完全够用。

**为什么不用 koffi FFI 直接调 user32？**
koffi 的原生 `.node` 在 DSH 安装目录里有两套（3.1.1 / 3.3.2，互不兼容），且只能按绝对路径加载；插件里引它会把「DSH 升级 / 换机器」变成故障源。PowerShell 是每台 Windows 都有的稳定面。

**前台判定为什么看窗口标题而不是页面可见性？**
GUI 可能在 Electron 窗口里，也可能在浏览器标签页里（比如 Edge 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:19387`）。两种情况的活动窗口标题都来自页面 `<title>DeepSeek Harness</title>`，所以标题匹配同时覆盖两种形态；浏览器里切到别的标签页时，窗口标题变成那个标签页的标题，于是正确判定为「不在看 DSH」。

---

## 安装

本机**已安装并已生效**（desktop profile）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <克隆下来的仓库目录>
```

这一步会：把包以 `link:` 形式加进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 的 dependencies，并把 `dsh-remind` 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 负责把自己挂进 profile 组合树：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-remind
      name: dsh-remind
```

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-remind`，或在 GUI 的 Plugins 页里移除。

> **改完插件源码要重启 DSH 才生效**：插件以 `link:` 方式安装，profile 热重载会重新执行 `apply()`，但 Node 的 ESM 模块缓存不会失效——已加载过的模块仍是旧代码。实测：改动 `src/` 后触发 profile 重载，日志里出现的仍是旧版 `ready` 行；重启桌面端后才是新代码。纯配置改动（`config.json` 或 `setConfig` 路由）不受影响。

---

## 配置

配置文件：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\plugins\dsh-remind\config.json`（改完**重启 DSH** 生效；也可以用下面的 `setConfig` 路由热改）。

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `onlyWhenUnfocused` | `true` | 只在「前台不是 DSH」时提醒；`false` = 每次都提醒 |
| `focusMarkers` | `["DeepSeek Harness"]` | 命中即视为「正在看 DSH」的窗口标题/进程名片段（子串匹配） |
| `graceMs` | `1500` | 弹通知前的宽限期：你马上切回来就不打扰 |
| `settleMs` | `700` | 判定「真的做完了」前的静默期 |
| `minRunMs` | `0` | 短于此时长的任务不提醒（0 = 不限制） |
| `cooldownMs` | `5000` | 同一会话两次提醒的最小间隔 |
| `notifyOnJob` | `true` | 后台任务全部落地时也提醒 |
| `title` | `DSH · 任务完成` | 通知标题 |
| `bodyTemplate` | `{{session}} · {{workspace}} · 用时 {{duration}}` | 正文模板，支持 `{{session}}` `{{workspace}}` `{{duration}}` `{{cause}}`；空片段连同分隔符自动省略 |
| `sound` | `default` | 任务完成通知的提示音：`default` / `im` / `mail` / `reminder` / `sms` / `alarm` / `alarm2`…`alarm10` / `call` / `call2`…`call10` / `loop` / `none` |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | DSH 请求批准时提醒 |
| `notifyOnQuestion` | `true` | DSH 向你提问时提醒 |
| `attentionOnlyWhenUnfocused` | `true` | 审批/提问是否也遵守前台判定（`false` = 正在看 DSH 也弹） |
| `attentionGraceMs` | `300` | 审批/提问通知的宽限期（比任务完成更短） |
| `attentionSettleMs` | `800` | 审批/提问的确认窗口：期间被决定/回答就不打扰 |
| `approvalTitle` | `DSH · 需要批准` | 审批提醒标题 |
| `approvalBodyTemplate` | `{{tool}} · {{session}}` | 审批正文模板，支持 `{{tool}}` `{{reason}}` `{{session}}` `{{workspace}}` |
| `questionTitle` | `DSH · 需要你的回答` | 提问提醒标题 |
| `questionBodyTemplate` | `{{question}} · {{session}}` | 提问正文模板，支持 `{{question}}` `{{session}}` `{{workspace}}` |
| `attentionSound` | `reminder` | 审批/提问提醒的提示音 |
| `openOnClick` | `false` | 开启后通知可点击，用默认浏览器打开带令牌的 DSH 地址 |
| `actionLabel` | `打开 DSH` | 可点击时的按钮文案 |
| `aumid` | `""` | Toast 的 AUMID；留空用系统 PowerShell 已注册的那个 |
| `debug` | `false` | 把每次判定写进 `events.jsonl`，排查「为什么没提醒」时打开 |

---

## 自检与排查

**1) 立刻弹一条测试通知** —— 在 DSH 页面（浏览器/桌面窗口均可）按 F12 打开控制台执行：

```js
// 任务完成样式
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' })
  .then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
// 审批 / 提问样式（带 reminder 提示音）
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'approval' }) }).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'question', sound: 'alarm' }) }).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```

**2) 看当前状态、前台判定与最近判定**：

```js
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.status', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' })
  .then(r => r.json()).then(x => console.log(x.result))
```

返回里的 `foreground` 就是「现在算不算在看 DSH」的判定依据（窗口标题、进程名、是否命中）；`recent` 是最近若干次任务完成判定（`notified` / `focused` / `queued-work` / `jobs-running` / `session-active` / `cooldown` …）；`attention.recent` 是审批/提问判定，`attention.pending` 是还在确认窗口里的条数。

**3) 热改配置**（不重启）：

```js
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.setConfig', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ onlyWhenUnfocused: false, debug: true }) }).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```

**4) 判定轨迹**：`debug: true` 时，`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\plugins\dsh-remind\events.jsonl` 会记录加载与每次判定。

**5) 命令行测试**：

```powershell
node --test                                        # 单测（判定逻辑、配置、路由装配）
$env:DSH_REMIND_E2E='1'; node --test test/notify.test.mjs   # 真实弹一条 Windows 通知
```

---

## 验证记录（本机实测）

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 前台窗口探测 | ✅ 正确读出前台窗口标题与进程名，耗时 ~250ms |
| 原生 Toast（中文 + emoji） | ✅ 弹出并进入操作中心历史（`History.GetHistory` 可查） |
| 提示音 | ✅ Toast XML 带 `<audio src="ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Reminder" loop="false"/>`，实测可闻 |
| 通知层实测 | ✅ `node --test` 全部通过（含前台命中时正确跳过、提示音参数） |
| 真实宿主加载 | ✅ desktop（DSH 0.2.1-rc.2）宿主启动即加载，`events.jsonl` 记录 `ready: … approval=true question=true sound=default/reminder` |
| 真实任务端到端 | ✅ 临时 profile 跑一轮真实任务：`status running → status idle → notified`，并真实弹出通知 |
| **真实提问端到端** | ✅ 临时 web profile 里让 agent 真的调用 `ask_user_question` → 插件 `attention.recent` 记录 `kind=question, action=notify`，通知里带问题原文与 `reminder` 提示音 |
| 审批/提问通知样式 | ✅ `/api/dsh-remind.test` 的 `kind=approval|question` 在真实宿主里弹窗、提示音正确（`ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Reminder`） |
| 插件路由 | ✅ `/api/dsh-remind.{status,config,setConfig,probe,test}` 在真实宿主里可用（信封与裸 JSON 两种请求体都支持） |
| 升级稳定性 | ✅ 零依赖 + 零 `peerDependencies`，不会被 DSH 的版本兼容校验拦下（`evaluatePluginCompatibility` 无 peer 直接放行）；bundle 解析失败只会「跳过 + stderr 一行」，不会导致 profile 启动失败 |
| 契约体检 | ✅ `node tools/doctor.mjs` 五层全 PASS：20 条公开契约对着**新版本 DSH 自带 API 目录**逐条核对通过，另有 2 条实现核对（审批/提问事件名、提问工具名）通过 |

---

## DSH 升级后的稳定性

**结论：升级不会把插件卸载或禁用，真正的风险是宿主接口漂移；后者已用「契约清单 + 体检脚本」兜住。**

### 升级不会动它（已核对 DSH 自身源码）

| 事实 | 依据 |
|---|---|
| 插件代码在本地克隆目录里，不在 DSH 程序目录里；升

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：选中任意文字，一键引用进输入框
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quote-to-composer

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

> 在 DSH 里**选中一段文字 → 点一下「引用」→ 它就变成输入框里的一条迷你引用条**，
> 接着写你的追问，一起发出去。适合「这句话什么意思」「这段代码为什么报错」这种指代式提问。

![演示：选中文字 → 指针旁出现「引用」胶囊 → 输入框里出现迷你引用条](docs/demo.gif)

![输入框里的迷你引用条；悬停显示被引用的完整内容](docs/screenshot-chip.png)

## 它能做什么

- **选中即引用**：在助手回复、代码块、表格、侧栏预览里选中任意文字，松开鼠标后指针右下方出现一个深色胶囊「引用」，点它即可。
- **整条引用**：每条助手回复的动作行（复制 / 好的回答 / 有问题的回答 / …）里多了一个「引用这条回复」按钮，一键引用整条回答。
- **输入框里是迷你条，不是一大段文字**：插入后是 21px 高的灰色圆角小条 +「引用」两个字，和正文同一行高，不占地方。
- **悬停看全文**：鼠标停在引用条上会浮出深色卡片，显示被引用的完整内容（多行、代码都保留）。
- **发出去是引用卡片**：消息发出后，用户气泡里渲染成引用卡片；模型收到的是标准 Markdown 引用块：

  ```
  > 被引用的每一行
  ```

- **键盘也能用**：`Ctrl+Shift+Q`（Windows / macOS 统一用 Ctrl）。
- **深色 / 浅色主题自适应**；刷新页面后草稿里的引用条不会丢，悬停照样能看全文。
- 纯前端插件，无原生依赖，**Windows / macOS / Linux 通用**。

## 下载

**两个平台的包内容完全一样**（同一份前端代码），只是附带的安装说明不同，按你的系统下对应的那个就行。

| 平台 | 下载 | 备注 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | [dsh-quote-to-composer-0.9.2-windows.zip](https://github.com/bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer/releases/latest/download/dsh-quote-to-composer-0.9.2-windows.zip) | 解压后看包里的 `INSTALL-windows.md` |
| macOS | [dsh-quote-to-composer-0.9.2-macos.zip](https://github.com/bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer/releases/latest/download/dsh-quote-to-composer-0.9.2-macos.zip) | 解压后看包里的 `INSTALL-macOS.md` |
| 任意平台（npm 包） | [dsh-quote-to-composer-0.9.2.tgz](https://github.com/bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer/releases/latest/download/dsh-quote-to-composer-0.9.2.tgz) | 给熟悉 npm 包的人 |

也可以不下载，直接在 DSH 里装（见下）。

## 安装

### 方式 A（推荐，不用命令行）：在 DSH 里装

1. 打开 DSH，左侧点 **插件**
2. 右上角点 **添加插件**
3. 输入框里填：

   ```
   github:bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer
   ```

   （如果网络慢，勾上「中国大陆镜像源」）
4. 点 **安装**，然后刷新页面

### 方式 B：下载 zip 装

1. 按上表下载对应平台的 zip，解压得到 `dsh-quote-to-composer` 文件夹
2. 同上打开 **插件 → 添加插件**
3. 输入框里填**解压出来的目录路径**，例如：
   - Windows：`D:\plugins\dsh-quote-to-composer`
   - macOS：`/Users/你的用户名/plugins/dsh-quote-to-composer`
4. 点 **安装**，刷新页面

### 方式 C：命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer
```

> Windows 与 macOS 步骤完全一致——插件是纯前端代码，两个平台跑的是同一份。
> macOS 上快捷键同样是 **Ctrl+Shift+Q**，不是 `Cmd+Shift+Q`（后者是系统「注销」）。

## 用法

**三步**：

1. 用鼠标选中你想引用的文字 → 松开后指针旁出现「引用」胶囊 → 点它
   （或者按 `Ctrl+Shift+Q`；也可以点助手回复下面的「引用这条回复」引用整条）
2. 输入框里出现一条灰色的「引用」小条，鼠标悬停可以确认引用内容对不对
3. 直接继续写你的问题，正常发送即可

发出的消息里引用部分会渲染成卡片，模型看到的是 `> …` 引用块，所以它能准确知道你在问哪一句。

> 胶囊只在「松开鼠标 + 确实选中了文字 + 选区不在输入框内」时出现；
> 点空白处、滚动、按 `Esc` 都会立刻收起。

## 卸载 / 升级

- **卸载**：DSH → 插件 → 已安装插件 → 找到 `dsh-quote-to-composer` → 卸载
- **升级**：再走一次安装即可（或用新版本 zip / 新的 `github:` 拉取）

## 常见问题

| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 选中文字后没有出现胶囊 | 选区在输入框里（插件故意不处理）；或只点了没拖动（没有真正选中）；或选中的是纯空白 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Q` 没反应 | 焦点不在页面上（先点一下正文）；或和其它软件快捷键冲突 |
| 输入框里残留一条引用条 | 点进输入框 `Ctrl+A` 再 `Delete` 清空草稿即可 |
| 引用条上的悬停卡片里是空内容 | 极少数情况下草稿被外部改动；删掉重引一次 |
| 发送后模型好像没看到引用 | 看用户气泡里有没有渲染出引用卡片；没有就是没插进去，重来一次 |
| 引用条样式很怪 | 需要较新的 Chromium（Electron / Chrome 105+）；旧内核会走纯色兜底 |

## 兼容性

- 插件是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` 形式的浏览器模块，**不含任何 Windows/macOS 专有 API**
- 只用浏览器标准能力：`getSelection`、`Range`、`matchMedia` 间接（主题变量）、CSS `color-mix()`（带纯色兜底）
- 字体栈包含 `-apple-system` / `PingFang SC`，图标用 `-webkit-mask` + `mask` 双写

## 开发者说明

### 目录结构

```
client.js           全部前端逻辑（宿主半边 index.js 是空的，纯视图插件）
index.js            export function apply() {} —— 故意为空
cordis.patch.yml    插件挂载声明
locale/{zh,en}.json 文案
icon.svg            商店图标
screenshots.json    商店截图声明
docs/               截图、安装说明、上架流程
scripts/publish.ps1 一键推送到 GitHub 的脚本（给发布者用）
```

### 实现要点

- 四个挂载点（都做了失败隔离，单点注册失败不影响其它部分）：
  - `conversation.input.dock` — 无渲染的 `Capture`，把当前会话的 `inputActions`
    发布到模块级 `live`，并把 `useInput` 的 `occurrences` 镜像到 `liveOccurrences`
    （刷新后从草稿恢复的引用条靠它找回悬停内容）；
  - `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` — 「引用这条回复」按钮；
  - `conversation.user.text.node` + `uiConversation.userText` 规则 `quote` —
    把发出的 `> …` 段落渲染成引用卡片；
  - `inputTriggers.registerSource(QUOTE_SOURCE)` — `source: 'quote'` 的序列化 owner。
- 插入走 `inputTriggers.sessionOf(session.ctx).execute({ insert: reference }, span)`
  → 会话事件 `slash/input-insert-reference` → `shell.insertReference()`，
  生成一个 `ReferenceChipNode`：`label` 是「引用」，`clipboardText` 是完整的
  `> …` 块（提交时模型看到的就是它）。插入失败才回退到纯 `> …` 文本插入。
- 引用条样式不套用 DSH 默认芯片，而是用 CSS 覆盖 `[data-composer-chip="quote"]`：
  灰底、全圆角、21px 高、12px 字，隐藏自带图标，用 `::before` + mask 数据 URI 画自己的引号图标。
- 悬停卡片 `.dqc-tip`：`mouseover/mouseout` 委托监听，内容只取自
  `useInput().occurrences` 里 `source === 'quote'` 的那几条（按芯片顺序对齐、剥掉 `> ` 前缀），
  不在 DOM 上缓存引用原文，避免"插入 A 却标到 B"的错标。
- 提交必须能找到 `source: 'quote'` 的 codec，否则会报
  `slash: no serializer for reference source "quote"` 并让发送失败——所以 `QUOTE_SOURCE` 必须注册。
- 引用在 prompt 里占的文本是 `> 每一行` + 一个**空行**。空行直接写进芯片的 `clipboardText`，
  而不是插入后用 `insertText` 补（补出来的空行会和插入坐标打架，插第二条引用时多出空白行）；
  有了这个空行，紧跟在芯片后面的追问才不会被 Markdown 懒续行吞进引用块。

## 验证状态

- 已在真实页面（`http://192.168.0.109:3822/`，v0.8.2 代码）逐项验证：
  鼠标选中 → 胶囊出现在指针右下方、靠边翻转；点胶囊 → 输入框出现
  `height:21px` 的「引用」条；悬停浮出深色卡片且内容正确；连插两条不串号；
  刷新后引用条从草稿恢复且悬停仍可用；深色主题配色正确；
  端到端「引用一句 + 追问」发出后气泡渲染引用卡片、模型按被引用文字作答；
  控制台无本插件告警。
- 用户气泡渲染规则单测 `_probe/quote-rule.test.mjs` 8/8。
- 0.9.0 / 0.9.1 / 0.9.2 只改发布元数据与文档，未改交互逻辑。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Full-screen SAO-inspired startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with adjustable beam, dial, language and character settings. Original high-fidelity rendering by default; optional compatibility mode for low-end GPUs and a tunnel-only intro.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH SAO Link Start

[中文](#中文说明) · [English](#english)

An unofficial, procedural recreation of an SAO-style login sequence for
DeepSeek Harness. It plays as a full-screen overlay when the Harness UI starts,
then removes itself automatically.

The plugin contains no anime footage, images, fonts, or game assets. Its tunnel,
HUD dials, panels, and sound cues are generated with Canvas, CSS, SVG, and Web
Audio.

| Beam tunnel | Character confirmation |
| --- | --- |
| ![Perspective beam tunnel](media/beam-tunnel.png) | ![Character confirmation dialog](media/character-dialog.png) |

## English

### Features

- Perspective capsule-beam tunnel with near-camera clipping to prevent flashes.
- Five animated cyan HUD dials followed by language, login, and character
  registration panels.
- A dedicated **Settings → SAO Link Start** page.
- Adjustable beam speed, beam length, beam density, and HUD dial size.
- Editable language and character labels; defaults are `Japanese` and
  `Kirito(M)`.
- Click or press `Escape` to skip. Press `Ctrl+Alt+L` to replay while the
  Harness page has keyboard focus.
- Respects reduced-motion preferences.
- The original rendering path is the default; an optional **Compatibility mode**
  (off by default) gives low-end GPUs a compositor-friendly fallback; see
  [Compatibility mode](#compatibility-mode).
- An optional **Tunnel only** intro (off by default) that plays just the beam
  fly-through and skips the rest; see [Tunnel only](#tunnel-only).

### Install

Replace `desktop` with the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
```

Restart Harness after installation. Open the account menu, choose **Settings**,
then select **SAO Link Start** in the left navigation.

### Configuration

| Field | Range/default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Beam speed | `0.4–2.5`, default `1` | Fly-through speed |
| Beam length | `0.4–2.5`, default `1` | Capsule trail length |
| Beam density | `0.4–2`, default `1` | Number of visible beams |
| Dial size | `0.35–1.2`, default `0.65` | Scale of the five HUD dials |
| Language name | default `Japanese` | Label beside the Language pill |
| Character name | default `Kirito(M)` | Name in the registration dialog |
| Compatibility mode | off by default | Low-end GPU fallback that avoids per-frame layout; see below |
| Tunnel only | off by default | Play just the beam fly-through; see below |

Save settings and restart Harness to preview the new values.

### Compatibility mode

**Settings → SAO Link Start → Compatibility mode** is **off by default**: the
default state uses the original 1.3.x rendering, i.e. the high-fidelity
performance path (2x device pixel ratio, exact per-frame layout). Both states
look identical.

Check the box only when the overlay stutters (typically on integrated or older
GPUs). The fallback then keeps the overlay out of the layout pipeline:

- the five HUD dials animate with a compositor-only `transform: scale()` on a
  fixed 200×200 box instead of rewriting `width`/`height`/`font-size` every frame;
- per-dial style writes are cached, so `filter`, `z-index`, and the chip text are
  only written when they actually change;
- the beam canvas caps the device pixel ratio at 1.5 and falls back to 1x with
  fewer capsule details when frame times stay long;
- the `AudioContext` is created on the first user gesture, and sound cues that
  would already be in the past are skipped instead of replayed late.

The choice is stored in the page's `localStorage`
(`dsh:sao-link-start:compatibility-mode`) and applies on the next replay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`) or the next Harness start; toggling it does not require a restart.

Measured with a replay-isolated headless Chromium run of one overlay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`, same environment), original → compatibility: layout count
37 → 9, layout time 0.087 s → 0.028 s, style-recalculation time
0.979 s → 0.252 s.

### Tunnel only

**Settings → SAO Link Start → Tunnel only** is **off by default**. Check it to
play just the perspective beam fly-through and skip everything after it:

- the five-sense HUD dials, the language pill, the login panel and the character
  registration dialog are not rendered at all;
- the overlay fades out at ~3.7 s and unmounts at ~4.3 s instead of 14.4 s;
- only the opening whoosh and a short exit whoosh play — no dial/panel cues;
- the beam/dial/language settings above only affect the full sequence.

The preference is stored in `localStorage`
(`dsh:sao-link-start:tunnel-only`) and applies on the next replay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`) or the next Harness start. Compatibility mode and Tunnel only are
independent: if the full sequence stutters, use Compatibility mode.

### Permissions and network use

The plugin adds a startup overlay and a settings section. It does not request
credentials, read conversations or workspace files, or make network requests.

## 中文说明

这是一个非官方的 DeepSeek Harness 启动动画插件，以程序绘制方式重现
SAO 风格的登录流程。Harness 界面启动时会显示全屏动画，播放结束后自动卸载。

插件不包含动画原片、图片、字体或游戏素材。光束隧道、HUD 圆盘、界面和音效均由
Canvas、CSS、SVG 与 Web Audio 实时生成。

### 功能

- 带近相机裁剪的透视胶囊光束隧道，避免光束穿过镜头时闪屏。
- 五个青色 HUD 圆盘，以及语言、登录、角色确认界面。
- 独立的 **设置 → SAO 连结开始动画** 页面。
- 可调光束速度、光束长度、光束数量与圆盘大小。
- 可编辑语言名称和人物名称，默认分别为 `Japanese` 与 `Kirito(M)`。
- 点击画面或按 `Escape` 跳过；Harness 页面获得键盘焦点时，可按
  `Ctrl+Alt+L` 重播。
- 支持系统的减少动态效果偏好。
- 默认使用原版渲染（即性能模式）；另提供可选的**兼容模式**（默认关闭），
  给核显/低配机器一个更省主线程的回退路径；见[兼容模式](#兼容模式)。
- 可选**仅光束穿行**片头（默认关闭）：只播放光束穿行，跳过后面所有动画；
  见[仅光束穿行](#仅光束穿行)。

### 安装

把 `desktop` 换成你实际使用的配置名称：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
```

安装后重启 Harness。从账号菜单打开**设置**，在左侧选择
**SAO 连结开始动画**即可调节参数。

### 兼容模式

**设置 → SAO 连结开始动画 → 兼容模式**，**默认关闭**：默认状态就是原版渲染，
也就是性能模式（2x DPR、逐帧精确布局），两种状态画面完全一致。

只有在动画卡顿时（常见于核显/较旧的 GPU）才需要勾选。开启后改用合成器友好的
精简路径：

- 五块 HUD 圆盘改为对固定 200×200 盒子做合成器 `transform: scale()`，
  不再每帧重写 `width`/`height`/`font-size`；
- 每个圆盘的样式写入会做缓存，`filter`、`z-index` 与 chip 文本只在真正变化时写入；
- 光束 canvas 的 device pixel ratio 上限为 1.5，帧时间持续偏长时自动降到 1x
  并减少胶囊细节；
- `AudioContext` 延迟到首个用户手势才创建，已经错过的音效不再补播。

选择保存在页面 `localStorage`（`dsh:sao-link-start:compatibility-mode`），
在下次重播（`Ctrl+Alt+L`）或下次启动 Harness 时生效——单纯切换开关不需要重启。

实测（重放隔离的无头 Chromium，一次完整动画，同一环境，原版 → 兼容模式）：
布局次数 37 → 9，布局耗时 0.087 s → 0.028 s，样式重算耗时 0.979 s → 0.252 s。

### 仅光束穿行

**设置 → SAO 连结开始动画 → 仅光束穿行**，**默认关闭**。勾选后只播放最前面的
透视光束穿行，后面全部跳过：

- 五感 HUD 圆盘、语言标签、登录面板、角色注册界面对话框完全不渲染；
- 遮罩约 3.7 秒开始淡出、约 4.3 秒卸载（完整序列是 14.4 秒）；
- 只保留开场音效和一段收尾音效，没有圆盘/面板提示音；
- 上面的光束/圆盘/语言参数只影响完整序列。

选择保存在 `localStorage`（`dsh:sao-link-start:tunnel-only`），
在下次重播（`Ctrl+Alt+L`）或下次启动 Harness 时生效。兼容模式与仅光束穿行是
两个独立开关：完整序列卡顿时再开兼容模式。

### 权限与联网

插件只注册启动遮罩和设置栏目，不读取对话或工作区文件，不请求凭据，也不会发起
网络请求。

## Attribution

[unixzii/SAOLinkStart](https://github.com/unixzii/SAOLinkStart), released under
The Unlicense. This project is also released under The Unlicense.
