# dsh-relay-reasoning

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Real reasoning levels — **off / low / medium / high / max** — on every model of your OpenAI-compatible relay, right in the DSH model picker.

## The problem

Relays such as a self-hosted gateway fronting many models accept the `reasoning_effort` request parameter, but DSH offers no reasoning control for them. The reason is structural: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` only publishes selectable levels for a model whose `reasoningEfforts` field declares them, so a route configured by hand shows nothing.

Declaring those levels by hand means repeating seven lines for every model — and re-doing it whenever the model list changes.

## What this plugin does

It writes `reasoningEfforts` into the `llm-pi-ai` profile entry for every model on the configured providers, and the picker immediately offers those levels. No restart, and no editing of your model list.

**It keeps up with your configuration.** The first pass runs at activation, and every later profile configuration reload — adding a relay or a model from the settings UI, editing a route — runs it again and fills in whatever is missing. A relay you connect while DSH is running gets its levels without a restart.

## Why these five levels

pi-ai understands seven levels, but a relay does not distinguish all of them. Measured over three prompts and two passes on one relay route, median reasoning tokens per level:

| Level | median reasoning tokens |
|---|---|
| off | 0 |
| minimal | 108 |
| low | 122 |
| medium | 155 |
| high | 142 |
| xhigh | 125 |
| max | 359 |

`max` is roughly double every other level, so it is a genuinely stronger tier and is included by default.

The five middle levels (`minimal` through `xhigh`) land within each other's noise on this route, so publishing them would only duplicate choices. They stay out by default but can be requested through `levels` if a route of yours does distinguish them.

If your relay turns out to ignore `max`, drop it with `levels: [off, low, medium, high]` so the picker does not offer a level that does nothing.

## Install

From the DSH workshop (Settings → Workshop → Plugins), or directly:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → dsh-relay-reasoning
```

Development builds can also be installed from a checkout:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → <path to this repository>
```

## Configuration

The plugin row takes an optional config:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: relay-reasoning
      name: dsh-relay-reasoning
      config:
        target: llm-pi-ai                 # profile entry id to configure
        providers: []                     # empty = every provider on that entry
        levels: [off, low, medium, high, max]  # published levels, ascending
        force: false                      # true = rewrite once at activation even if already correct
        debugLog: ""                      # optional file path for diagnostics
```

`providers: []` means the plugin covers every provider on the entry, so adding a new relay needs no plugin change.

`levels` defaults to `off, low, medium, high, max`. Narrow it if your relay ignores a level:

```yaml
levels: [off, low, medium, high]
```

Any subset of `off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` is accepted; names are published in ascending order and unknown names are dropped.

## Idempotent

A pass writes nothing when every model already declares exactly the configured levels; it inspects and stops. Updating the package, and the configuration reload caused by the plugin's own write, therefore never churn your configuration, and any leftover declaration from a manual setup is detected and rewritten.

Changing `levels` does rewrite the affected models, because their current declaration no longer matches.

`force: true` is honoured at activation only — it rewrites once, including declarations that are already correct. Later reloads ignore it, because honouring it every time would rewrite the same declaration and reload in a loop.

## How it works

Three details are worth knowing if you read the source.

**It does not override the `llm-pi-ai` row.** A Cordis loader patch replaces a row's `config` wholesale rather than merging it, so a patch that added `reasoningEfforts` would erase `baseURL`, the credential reference, and the whole model list. The plugin instead calls `settings.mutate()` with path-scoped operations, touching only `providers.<name>.models[i].reasoningEfforts`.

**It writes outside the transaction.** The HMR config editor refuses to nest transactions, and its guard reads an `AsyncLocalStorage` store that survives awaits and timers, so deferring is not enough. The plugin runs the write through `hmr.executing.exit()` — the same mechanism `dsh-hmr` uses when wiring a config watcher from inside a transaction.

**It listens to `app-boot/config-reload`.** Every successful profile reload emits that event — including a relay added from the settings UI. The plugin inspects once shortly afterwards; a reload caused by its own write only finds everything already correct and stops, so there is no loop, and a burst of events collapses into one inspection.

## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1`.
- No runtime dependencies: only `node:fs` and Host-provided services.
- Works with any OpenAI-compatible route declared on the `llm-pi-ai` entry, not just one relay.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-clean-delete

A permanent **Delete session** action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a
confirmation dialog that tells you what is about to go.

DSH ships a *Archive* action, which is reversible and keeps the session in the
Archived list. This plugin adds the irreversible counterpart, and — unlike a
naive `rm` of the session log — it actually makes the row disappear.

## What it does

Adds one row to the per-session `…` menu in the left sidebar, ordered after
Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive. Choosing it opens a modal that reports:

- whether the session is **still open on this machine** (it cannot be reopened afterwards),
- the **log size** about to be removed,
- **running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders** bound to the session,
- how many reminders are deleted with it.

Confirming stops the session's work, unlinks its session directory and projection
checkpoint, and releases the id from every registry that would otherwise keep
listing it. Then the sidebar refreshes and the row is gone.

There is **no undo and no trash folder**. The dialog says so.

## Why it is not just `rm`

A session's directory is not the only thing that makes it appear. The Host's
session corpus is `persistence ∪ live`, so a session the Host still holds live
keeps coming back after its log is deleted:

1. the browser drops the row,
2. the next `sessions.refresh()` rebuilds the rows from the Host list and folds
   the live summary back in,
3. the row **returns**.

The visible symptom of this is that deleting several sessions in a row makes the
earlier ones reappear, and that archived rows come back stuck in Archived forever
(the old id was never removed from the archive set, so it accumulated dead ids).

`release()` therefore detaches through the same teardown the owning fiber uses,
in the order the agent loop's own disposal uses — **agents first, then
sessions** — plus `unarchiveSession(id)` and `workspace.detachSession(id)`. The
browser keeps its own `retired` set and re-applies every retirement after each
refresh, so rows stay retired until the Host's `api-session/removed` agrees.

## Install

This package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin` installs it as a
profile layer by itself — **you do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml`**. Bare
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports are resolved by the host itself, so the package declares
**zero dependencies** — do not add them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That is the npm name, and it is also the repository name.

From a source clone, `dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough, so a `file:` path works
too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-clean-delete
```

That command does two things: it adds the package as a dependency, **and** it
appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The second
half is the one people miss — without it the package is just an unused
dependency, because the bundle patch in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)
is only read for packages the bundle list names.

Verify it joined the tree — the entry must appear under a banner naming the
plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is the part that is easy to miss:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B1 session-clean-delete
```

```
# == …/dsh-session-clean-delete/cordis.patch.yml
- id: session-clean-delete
  name: dsh-session-clean-delete
```

A row under a banner for the *profile's* `cordis.patch.yml` means something
inserted this plugin by hand and it is **not** installed as a bundle — the
dependency is present but the layer never composes. `--dump-config` never
mounts, so it is safe against the live profile.

Finally **restart the harness**. The bundle is composed at boot, so there is no
partial effect: until it restarts, the menu row is not there.

### If nothing happens

- **Re-running the same add is a no-op** — same spec, same version.
  `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete` first, or
  the profile keeps serving the old copy forever.
- pnpm **copies** the package into the profile rather than symlinking it, so
  editing your clone does not change the running plugin. Copy
  `lib/*.js` into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-clean-delete/lib/`.
  `client.js` hot-reloads; `index.js` is host-side and needs a restart.
- `dsh plugin` needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (`corepack enable pnpm`), or it fails with
  "pnpm was not found".
- pnpm installs a version **older** than the registry `latest` when a release is
  less than 24 h old — that is `minimumReleaseAge`, a supply-chain guardrail, not
  a stale cache. Wait, or use a `^x.y.z` range so the newer release arrives on
  its own.

## Design notes

**A Typert `Remote` service, not an HTTP route.** The host half registers one
`TypertRemoteService` named `sessionDelete` with `describe` and `deleteSession`.
The Gateway auto-claims every endpoint a live `TypertRemoteService` declares, and
the browser calls it over the ordinary channel:

```js
ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', `sessionDelete/${method}`, { args: { request } })
```

So there is no route to register and no permission to grant — the browser peer is
the owner principal.

**It deliberately does not check `Origin`.** In the desktop app the renderer
origin is the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, and the shell's `protocol.handle`
strips `origin`, `host`, `cookie` and `sec-fetch-site` before forwarding to the
Host. A plugin route that validates `origin === 'http://' + host` therefore 403s
*every* request from the desktop app while working fine under `dsh web`. The
Remote-service path avoids the question entirely.

**The postcondition is checked against the disk.** A successful `rm` is not
treated as proof; `removeLog()` stats the path afterwards and throws
`delete/failed` if it survived.

## Files

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: `TypertRemoteService`, the delete sequence, registry release. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the menu row and the `shell.overlay` confirmation dialog. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch named by `dsh.bundle`; inserts this plugin into a profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin titles for the Plugins panel. |

The in-app dictionary lives in `lib/client.js` (`zh` is the key-set source of
truth, `en` is checked complete against it); `locale/*.json` is the metadata the
Plugins panel reads.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness: motion-graphics tools, a Miran settings page and DeepSeek motion skills. Needs the Miran Fann engine (npx miran-fann setup).
plugins.readme_text: # Miran Fann for DeepSeek Harness Motion graphics on this Mac, from a dsh session. The plugin starts the Miran engine, hands its tools to the model as `mcp__miran__*`, and adds a **Miran** section to dsh Settings. ```text dsh session ──tool call──► dsh mcp-client ──stdio──► ~/.miran/bin/miran mcp ▲ │ └────────────── frame, video, project JSON ◄───────────┘ ``` ## Install The engine comes first; the plugin only connects to it. ```sh npx miran-fann setup # the engine in ~/.miran/bin/miran ``` Setup adds the plugin to the `web` profile by itself when dsh is installed, and every automatic update of the engine brings the plugin of the same version. To add it by hand, use **Plugins** in the dsh web sidebar with the address below, or: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:rakibulrocky14/miran-fann-dsh#v0.1.6-beta.1 ``` dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer is needed (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@next`). Restart `dsh web` after the install. `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows the `miran-fann` layer when it loaded. ## Sign in Miran's tools run only for a signed-in install. Open **Settings → Miran**: the page shows the account, the engine version, the GPU backend and whether the tools are connected. **Sign in** runs the real flow (the browser opens miranfann.com, the engine receives the code); **Sign out** ends it. The plugin never fakes the sign-in and never works around it. ## Settings Everything on **Settings → Miran** is read from and written to the engine, so dsh, Claude Code and Codex agree: | Part | What it does | | --- | --- | | Account | Who is signed in; sign in and out through the engine | | Engine | Path, version, GPU, setup command when missing | | Workspace | Folder the engine reads and writes | | Tools | Tool surface (default, lean, full); the engine's own choice | | dsh tools | Connected state, reconnect | | Live viewer | Start the viewer, viewer theme, time units, preview quality | | Render defaults | Export quality, file-size limit, default voice | | API keys | Google Gemini, ElevenLabs, OpenRouter, fal, Replicate | | Generation | Image, video and draft models, per-call and per-day caps, spend so far | | Voices | Default voice, cloud voices, built-in voice | | Feedback and updates | Share feedback, auto-update, version, update now | | Skills | The skills this plugin gives the agent | Keys go to dsh's credential store **and** to Miran's own key store, as secret fields. The page only ever shows the last four characters. An environment variable with the same name wins over both. The **Built-in plugins → Miran** tab shows the same state as a card, with **Open live viewer**. ## Tools and skills The model sees the engine's tools as `mcp__miran__`. The default list is the engine's own `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`; **Settings → Tools** offers the engine choice, `lean` (about 30 tools, the rest through `runScript`) and `full` (every tool in the schema). Skills ship in `skills//SKILL.md` and load into dsh's skill registry, so `/miran-...` and model-side loading use the same files. Start with `miran-dsh-studio`; it names the others. | Skill | Teaches | | --- | --- | | `miran-dsh-studio` | The order of work, research, the beat sheet, the handoff map | | `miran-dsh-directions` | Choosing a visual direction per brief, never a house look | | `miran-dsh-reference` | Studying reference videos and turning them into the film's own timing and motion | | `miran-dsh-design` | Hierarchy, readable sizes, depth, real UI | | `miran-dsh-type` | Setting, revealing and reading type | | `miran-dsh-motion` | Eases, timing, holds, the motion library | | `miran-dsh-cuts` | Shot length, cutting, transitions | | `miran-dsh-camera` | Depth, pushes, 3D screens, rack focus | | `miran-dsh-sound` | Music, events, levels, the drop | | `miran-dsh-polish` | Finishing, grade, export, captions | | `miran-dsh-launch` | The arc of a launch film | | `miran-dsh-explainer` | The structure of an explainer | | `miran-dsh-social` | 9:16, hooks, captions, loops | ## Configuration Profile settings live in `cordis.patch.yml`; every field has a default. | Field | Default | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | `enginePath` | `""` | Engine binary; empty means `~/.miran/bin/miran`, then `PATH` (`MIRAN_BINARY` also counts) | | `workspace` | `""` | Folder the engine reads and writes; empty leaves it to the engine | | `tools` | `"default"` | `default` follows `MIRAN_TOOLS_DEFAULT`, `lean` lists about 30 tools, `full` lists all | | `viewer` | `true` | Start the live viewer with the engine | | `viewerPort` | `47800` | Preferred viewer port; the next free one when taken | ## Troubleshooting **"Miran engine not found"** — run `npx miran-fann setup`, or set `enginePath` to the binary. The settings page prints the path it looked for. **Tools connected, but a call says sign-in is required** — open **Settings → Miran** and sign in; the engine gates every tool call on the account. **No Miran section in Settings** — the browser half did not load. Check that `dsh --profile --dump-config` lists `miran-fann`, then restart `dsh web` and reload the page. **A render returns no image** — the engine sends images as MCP image parts; dsh shows them in the session. If a call returns text only, the engine refused the render and the message says why. **The viewer will not open** — the port is taken. Change `viewerPort`, or stop the other viewer.

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加自由分屏：可拖拽窗格，每个窗格渲染一个会话的完整对话。Free split screen for DSH Web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-split

[**中文**](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**给 DeepSeek Harness Web 加一个自由分屏**——开一个分屏视图放在旁边，同时盯住两个、三个甚至四个会话；每个窗格渲染的是那个会话**真正的对话**，连输入框都能直接用。

![三个窗格](screenshots/split-panes.png)

## 功能

- **侧栏入口**：侧栏里的「分屏」按钮把分屏视图作为一个主面板打开。
- **自由布局**：向右/向下分屏；把一个窗格拖到另一个窗格上＝交换；拖到窗格边缘＝把窗格挪过去；拖分隔线改比例；**双击分隔线**横竖翻转并回到 50/50。
- **从各处填充窗格**：从左侧会话列表把一行拖进窗格、点行尾的「放入分屏窗格」按钮，或者用窗格右键菜单。
- **真对话**：每个窗格挂载官方的 `conversation.content` 槽位，流式输出、工具调用、附件、输入框的行为与正常视图完全一致。
- **未读点同步**：侧栏的未读指示同步到窗格标题上，一眼看出哪个窗格在说话。
- **导入运行中会话**：一次把正在跑的会话按窗格上限排进分屏，不会关闭任何会话。**定时任务工作区的会话会被跳过**（cwd 最后一段是 `cron-jobs`；`client.js` 里的 `SCHEDULED_WORKSPACE` 可改）。
- **布局持久化**：整棵窗格树（分栏、比例、分配）存在 `localStorage`，刷新后恢复。
- **中英双语界面**：插件自带中文与英文文案。
- **宿主侧零行为**：宿主那一半只负责声明客户端 bundle，不碰 Session 域。

![窗格右键菜单](screenshots/pane-menu.png)

## 安装

插件是一个带 loader patch（`cordis.patch.yml`）的 bundle，和普通 DSH 插件一样安装：

```bash
# 直接从 GitHub 装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yuloop/dsh-web-split

# 或者从本地目录装
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-web-split
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后刷新页面，侧栏就会出现「分屏」入口。

> `cordis.patch.yml` 用包名 `dsh-web-split` 指向 `index.js`。如果你是手工把文件拷进本地插件目录（而不是用安装器），把 patch 里的 `name` 改成 `index.js` 的绝对路径——开发机上就是这么跑的。

## 已知限制（重要）

在**窗格里点击文件链接或图片**会弹错误框：

```
无法打开文件 / sidebarRight: no session surface is mounted
```

原因：文件链接是通过右侧栏的 `sidebarRight.require()` 打开的，而它只认「当前显示在会话列上的那个会话」。全局的 `main` 面板不带会话上下文，所以这个调用会抛错。窗格本身照常渲染、滚动、输入；**只有文件/图片预览受影响**——想看文件就点侧栏那个会话回到普通视图，再点链接。

这条限制也正是本版本采用「面板式」的原因：还有一个「浮层式」变体（把网格浮在会话列上，让右侧栏继续工作），它换掉了网格所在的位置，发布时还不稳定，因此**不包含在 1.0.0 里**。

## 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness Web，且带官方 UI 包（`dsh-client-ui-layout`、`-session`、`-conversation`、`dsh-client-locale`、`dsh-api-session-controller`）。
- 开发与验证用的是 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`。

## 目录结构

```
client.js          Web 端全部实现（面板、窗格树、拖放、i18n、CSS）
index.js           宿主侧：只声明 bundle，不注册别的
cordis.patch.yml   loader patch 片段（insert id: web-split）
package.json       manifest，含 dsh.client 声明
docs/DEVLOG.md     开发日志，逐日记录（中文）
screenshots/       README 用的截图
```

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH 余额与用量浮层卡片：点图片从左侧滑出 / 再点缩回 + 点击回弹动画 · 官方余额 + 本地会话 token 三段计价估算
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-card

给 DeepSeek Harness 的一张**「余额与用量」浮层卡片**：图片按钮可拖动，**点一下从图片左侧滑出卡片、
再点一下缩回**（带点击回弹动画），显示官方账户余额（含赠金/充值拆分）与本地会话的 token 用量
（今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月）和人民币估算花费。

- 余额：先走官方 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`（密钥由 DSH 的凭据服务**现读**）；
  API key 未配置或被拒时，**回退到 DSH 账号登录态**
  （`platform.deepseek.com/api/v0/users/get_user_summary`，令牌同样由凭据服务现读，
  请求头 `x-dsh-auth-token`），令牌永不落盘、永不出宿主。
- 用量：直接折 DSH 原生会话日志（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），三段计价（缓存命中 / 未命中 / 输出），
  并按官方规则**逐条事件判定峰谷价**（北京时间工作日 9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00 为高峰，周末与法定节假日全天
  为空闲，空闲价是高峰价一半），**只统计当前工作区**。
- 形态：自己往 `document.body` 插一层浮层，**不进任何 slot** —— 官方 0.2.0 删过一个第三方插件在用的
  slot，这是实测教训。
- 卡片在图片**左侧**：图片与卡片都常驻，图片永远在最上层；开合是 `transform`/`opacity` 过渡，
  支持 `prefers-reduced-motion`。
- 客户端**不打包**：`exports["./client"]` 直接指向源文件，宿主原样伺服，改完刷新即可。
- 按钮图标是**位图**（黑塔戴巫师帽那张），经宿主白名单路由下发；取不到就退回内置 SVG。

> GitHub 仓库：<https://github.com/HerTa-st/dsh-balance-card>

---

## 按钮图标怎么换

按钮就是**角色本人的抠图**：没有圆形裁切、没有边框、没有底色，靠 alpha 站住，
显示尺寸 **192×236**（竖长，与抠图 239:268 同比，不拉伸；`button-size.json` 是唯一真相）。问号是保留的。

### 尺寸只有一个来源

**`button-size.json`**（仓库根）是唯一真相。三处需要知道尺寸 —— 客户端 CSS、出图脚本的像素、
验收脚本的断言 —— 靠"改的时候记得同步三处"必然有一天遗忘，所以：

```jsonc
// button-size.json
{ "width": 192, "height": 236 }
```

```powershell
# 改完尺寸跑一次：既重新出图，也会把数字写回客户端的标记区
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\build-icon.mjs
```

`build-icon.mjs` 会按标记区（`// >>> BUTTON_SIZE_START` … `// <<< BUTTON_SIZE_END`）替换
`lib/client.js` 里的 `DOT_W`/`DOT_H`。**标记缺失就直接报错退出**，而不是"大致找个地方改" ——
静默改错地方会让 CSS 尺寸与图片像素不一致，表现为图被拉伸或模糊，极难查。

资产都在 `lib/assets/`：

| 文件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `icon.png` / `icon@2x.png` | 实际下发的 192×236 / 384×472（`srcset` 自动选 2x） |
| `icon-source.jpg` | **原始素材存档**（296×279） |
| `character-cutout.png` | 抠图结果（紧贴包围盒裁切，带 alpha） |
| `character-full.png` | **未裁剪**的透明全图，用于核对取舍 |
| `character-*-preview-checker.png` / `-dark.png` | 棋盘格 / 深色底预览，用来确认透明与暗底可读性 |
| `icon-preview-*.png` | 显示尺寸放大 8×，肉眼确认小尺寸下认不认得出 |
| `icon-shot.png` | 验收时抓的实拍截图 |

### 从原图重做一遍

```powershell
$py = 'E:\deepseek Desktop\resources\runtime\primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'
# 1) 抠图（保留主角 + 问号；丢掉左侧淡色残影与纸张杂点）
& $py scripts\extract-character.py lib\assets\icon-source.jpg lib\assets\character-cutout.png
# 2) 由抠图出按钮资产（按 button-size.json 的尺寸等比放进透明画布，并同步客户端尺寸）
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\build-icon.mjs
# 3) 验收（解码 / 尺寸 / 2x / 不拉伸 / 抠图成立）
& 'E:\node\node.exe' scripts\verify-icon.mjs 'http://127.0.0.1:3210/?token=<token>'
```

**改尺寸只需改 `button-size.json` 一处**，然后重跑上面的第 2 步。

### 抠图的判定规则（是量出来的，不是拍的）

`scripts/list-components.py` 会把原图每个连通块的位置、均色、亮度列出来。实测：

| 块 | 面积 | 均色 | 判定依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 主角 | 35353 | `(135,121,141)` | 面积最大 |
| 问号弯钩 | 1080 | `(146,119,202)` | **紫调**（B−R=56）且离左边 > 40px |
| 问号下点 | 179 | `(144,124,191)` | 同上 |
| 问号第三小块 | 37 | 紫调 | 同上 —— **面积门槛必须 < 37**，否则问号缺一角 |
| 左侧淡色残影 | 7377 | `(201,193,198)` | 太靠左；且不是紫调（B−R=−3） |
| 顶部杂点 | 119–199 | `(210,210,210)` | 不是紫调 |

> 四个踩过的坑（都写进脚本注释了）：
> ① 「外圈全透明」这个判据是错的 —— 抠图紧贴包围盒裁，人物必然贴住右边/下边；
> ② 「四角 4×4 全透明」太敏感 —— 右下角恰好压到肩膀，一个像素就判失败；
>   正确判据是**整条边框里透明像素的比例**（实拍 69.7%，矩形白底图会是 0%）。
> ③ 截图里按钮周围的界面文字会被像素判定当成按钮的一部分 → 截图时把它停到**空白处**；
> ④ 靠心算坐标（pad / scale / ratio）取样，算错过三次 → 改成用**连通块自动定位**。

---

## 点开与缩回（交互与动画）

**形态**：图片按钮和余额卡片**都常驻**在同一个浮层 root 里，图片永远在最上层（`z-index:1`），卡片在它下面（`0`）。
点一下图片，卡片从图片**左侧**滑出；再点一下图片（或卡片右上角的 ✕），卡片缩回图片背后。

**点击动画**：图片按下时 `:active` 立刻缩到 `.96`（即时反馈），松手再跑一次 420ms 的 keyframe
（`.93 → 1.045 → 1`，带回弹）。keyframe 由 `data-tap` 触发、460ms 后复位，所以连点也能再触发。

**开合动画**：只碰 `transform` / `opacity`（不触发布局）。收起态 `translateX(60%) scale(.95)` + `opacity:0`，
展开态归位；展开 280ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.06)`（轻微过冲），收起 160ms。
`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下过渡与回弹都关掉，直接到位。

**落位**：卡片右边缘 = 图片**可见**左边缘 − 8px，垂直中心与图片中心对齐；视口四周留 8px。
卡片（276px 高）比图片（236px）高，靠近视口底部时「居中」会被 8px 边距顶住 —— 这时贴边更优先，
中心会差几像素（实测 3.8px）。视口窄到左边放不下时，卡片会被夹进视口并压到图片上 ——
图片层级更高、仍然可点，所以「缩回」不会失效。

**为什么坐标写在卡片自己身上**：root 的定位只表示「图片在哪」（`localStorage` 里的 `x/y` 就是图片框左上角），
卡片是 root 的绝对定位子元素、用相对 root 的负 `left`。拖动图片时卡片自动跟随，只需要在拖动/尺寸变化时重算夹取，
不需要维护第二套坐标，也不会出现「刷新一下卡片被拽回原处」。

**给验收脚本的诊断属性**：`data-open`（root 上，唯一的展开真相）、`data-dot-box`（图片 viewport 矩形
`left,top,w,h`）、`data-place-info`（`paintedLeft=… card=WxH left=… top=… gap=8`）。
旧版的 `data-align`（`above-button` / `below-button`）随「卡片在按钮上方」的落位一起删了。

---

## 实拍（无头 Edge，真机渲染）

| 收起 | 展开中（约 120ms） |
|---|---|
| ![收起](docs/screenshots/closed.png) | ![展开中](docs/screenshots/mid-open.png) |

| 展开 | 收起中（约 110ms） |
|---|---|
| ![展开](docs/screenshots/open.png) | ![收起中](docs/screenshots/mid-close.png) |

---

## 为什么这么做（每条都有理由，不是随手定的）

| 决定 | 理由 |
|---|---|
| 余额走官方 `/user/balance`（主）| `total_balance / granted_balance / topped_up_balance` 一次给全，且与浏览器登录态无关。DSH 自己那条账号链不是唯一来源。 |
| 余额回退到 DSH 账号链 | 桌面版默认用 `deepseek-account` 账号登录，很多环境里 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 没配或已失效（实测：DSH 里存的那把 key 被官方 401）。DSH 账号链在 0.2.1 里返回 `normal_wallets`（充值）与 `bonus_wallets`（赠金），**同样能拼出拆分**（`total = 充值 + 赠金`），所以 API key 不可用时没有理由让卡片空着。令牌取自凭据服务记录 `deepseek-account-platform/default`，只读不删 —— 卡片不会因为一次查询把用户登出。 |
| 用量走原始会话日志 | 官方给第三方插件的 `ctx.sessionQuery` / `sessionProjections` 只有**会话累计**，没有按天、没有按模型分桶。要「今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月」+ 按 provider 拆分，只能自己折叠。 |
| **逐帧**解压 zstd | 会话文件是**拼接的 zstd 帧**（每追加一次一个帧）。整文件一次 `zstdDecompressSync` 只解出第一帧（约 202 字节的会话头），静默丢掉几 MB 事件。 |
| 三段分开计价 | 实测缓存命中 1.82B、未命中 12.5M。`deepseek-flash` 命中价只有未命中的 1/50，不分段会把花费估到 5 倍以上。 |
| 只读当前工作区 | 本机有两个工作区（`HerTa` 与它的上级目录），混算会分不清「这个项目花了多少」。会话目录名是 cwd 的不可逆编码，用来精确比对。 |
| 增量缓存（mtime+size，只解新增帧） | 全量重算一次实测 **约 2.5 秒**（70 文件 / 45 MB / 34,350 帧 / 63,689 行）。剖析显示瓶颈**全在 CPU**：zstd 解压 59%、JSON 解析 34%、读盘只有 1.6%（帧平均 1.3 KB，小帧固定开销叠加）。同步跑会卡住宿主事件循环。 |
| 已解析事件**落盘缓存** | 进程重启后第一次打开也要快。缓存的是**原始事实**（不是派生结果），键带 `size + mtimeMs + 已消费字节`，文件一变只重解新增部分 → **不可能陈旧**。实测 2571 ms → 23 ms（约 110×）。`cachePath` 设 `-` 可关闭。 |
| 不进 slot | 官方 slot 都是固定座位，做不了「随意拖动」；且 0.2.0 真的删过 slot。 |
| 不打包客户端 | 没有构建步骤，改完刷新页面就生效；文件由 `exports["./client"]` 原样伺服。 |
| 失败不写缓存 | 一次断网不该把「半死」状态锁住 5 分钟。 |
| 峰谷价按官方规则**逐条事件**折算 | 不是按「现在」判峰谷：每条事件用**自己的时间戳**判（固定 UTC+8，与机器时区无关），否则今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月会随查看时刻漂移。官方规则逐字：「北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）9:00 - 12:00、14:00 - 18:00 为高峰时段；其余时段，包括周末及中国法定节假日全天均为空闲时段」「空闲时段价格为高峰时段价格的一半」。窗口左闭右开（12:00 整算空闲）；峰谷定价 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC 才生效，**更早的事件按空闲价**（等于旧版平铺价，历史口径不变）。节假日表收录 2026 年 33 天，来源国办发明电〔2025〕7 号。 |
| 无单价就不算钱 | 小米 token 套餐 / bailian 的 qwen 系列没有公开单价，`estimateCost` 返回 `null` 而不是 0 —— 0 会被误读成「免费」。 |
| 按钮用角色抠图（位图），不用自绘轮廓 | 用户要的是原画里的角色。宿主侧白名单只放两条 `icon.png` / `icon@2x.png`，**写死文件名**，所以不存在路径穿越，不需要写 `../` 过滤。取不到图时客户端退回内置 SVG，按钮不会变空白。 |
| 抠图**保留问号**、丢掉淡色残影 | 问号是画面的一部分（用户明确要）；残影是原画的水印式重复人物。判据用「紫调 + 离左边 > 40px」（实测问号 B−R=56、残影 B−R=−3，分得很干净），不是靠眼睛挑。 |
| 展开后卡片落在**图片左侧** | 用户要的落位：点图片后卡片从图片左侧弹出、再点缩回。卡片右边缘对图片**可见**左边缘（`object-fit: contain` 的实画区，192×236 的框里实画 192×215）留 8px 缝，垂直居中。 |
| 图片和卡片**都常驻** DOM | 旧版展开时把图片换成卡片，于是「再点一次图片缩回」无处可点；而且卡片要从图片背后滑出，就必须让图片压在它上面。现在图片 `z-index:1`、卡片 `0`：图片既不会被盖住，点它也永远命中它。 |
| 点击动画用 CSS keyframe | 按下 `:active` 缩到 `.96` 给即时反馈，松手跑一次 420ms 回弹。用 `data-tap` 触发、定时器复位 —— 不靠 JS 逐帧算 transform，掉帧也还是合成器的事。 |
| 开合动画只碰 `transform`/`opacity` | 不触发布局、不重排卡片内容。收起态只是 `visibility:hidden` + `pointer-events:none` + `inert`，**DOM 不卸载**：动画可以反向、数据不丢、再点开立刻有内容。 |
| 卡片坐标用**相对 root 的负 left** | root 的定位就是图片位置（也是拖动持久化的 `x/y`），卡片跟着 root 走 ⇒ 拖动时自动跟随、刷新不会被「拽回自动位置」。视口夹取在 `onMove` 里每帧重算。 |
| 视口窄时允许卡片压住图片 | 卡片比图片宽（320 > 192），图片贴着屏幕左边时左侧放不下。夹到视口 8px 内、宁可重叠：图片层级更高仍可点，缩回不会失效。 |
| 落位量 **root**、不量按钮 | 点开那一瞬间按钮正在跑点击回弹 keyframe（scale .93→1.045），量它得到的是**缩放后**的框 —— 实测据此落位卡片整体偏高 9～12px，而且动画结束后不会自动纠正。root 不参与动画，`offsetWidth/Height` 就是未缩放的外框。 |
| 窗口缩小后把按钮夹回视口 | 拖动坐标在窗口变小 / 换分辨率后可能落在视口外，按钮就再也点不到了（实测 1400×1500 拖到 x=1188，缩到 400×700 后整块出屏、`elementFromPoint` 返回 null）。所以 resize 时**先**夹 root 并写回 `x/y`，**再**重算卡片。 |
| 「等数据到位再落位」已删 | 新落位只依赖图片位置与卡片尺寸，与数字无关；卡片变高由 `ResizeObserver` 重算。 |
| 「记住收起态矩形」已删 | 图片常驻、随时能量，`lastDotRectRef`/尺寸校验那一套补丁都不需要了；`data-dot-box` 留作诊断。 |

---

## 安装

```powershell
$env:DSH_HOME='<你的 DSH_HOME>'

# A) 从 npm 装（预构建，免 allowBuilds 授权）
& '<DSH 安装目录>\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-herta-balance-card

# B) 或者克隆源码后从本地路径装（本仓库用 herta-lab 验证过）
git clone https://github.com/HerTa-st/dsh-balance-card
& '<DSH 安装目录>\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile <profile> add 'file:<克隆路径>'
```

> npm 包名是 **`dsh-herta-balance-card`**（仓库名 `dsh-balance-card` 在 npm 上已被另一个同名插件占用；
> `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 loader `name` 与包名一致，装的时候按包名来）。

包自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，`plugi

plugins.description: Session-status desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): live counts of running / unread-completed / waiting-for-choice sessions; click a count to jump.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-hud

> **English summary** — A session-status desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
> A small animated pet sits in the bottom-right corner; clicking it opens a bubble with three live
> counts: **running** sessions, **completed-but-unread** sessions, and sessions **waiting for your
> choice** (approval / plan review / question). Clicking a count jumps to that session; clicking the
> same row repeatedly cycles through the sessions in that group.
> Zero npm dependencies, no host-side behaviour: everything is one self-contained client bundle
> (`lib/client.js`, pet animations inlined as base64). Build with `node tools/build.mjs`.
> Third-party content and licensing: see [`NOTICE.md`](./NOTICE.md). MIT.

DSH 会话状态挂件：右下角一只安静的宠物角标，单击展开气泡，实时显示你要的三个数字 ——

```
🌊 3 个在跑
✅ 1 个没看          ← 后台跑完、你还没打开过的
⚠️ 2 个等你选 (1 确认 · 1 提问)   ← 需要你手动做选项选择的
```

单击任一数字行 → 直接跳进对应会话；同类多个会话时**连续单击依次轮换**（右下角会提示 `2/3，再点下一个`）。

---

## 一、数据从哪来（全部是 DSH 原生服务，事件驱动、零轮询）

| 数字 | 来源 | 判定 |
|---|---|---|
| **进行中** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` **＋** `sessions.list.projectionsBySession` | 会话自己 `running === true`，**或**它名下还有 running 的**直接**子代理（`runningChildCount > 0`） |
| **完成未读** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` | 会话自己的 `completionUnread === true`（**只**看主会话；子代理跑完不算） |
| **待你选择** | `uiSession.sessionStatus` | 会话自己的 `pendingInteraction !== undefined`，**或**它名下**直接**子代理的 `pendingInteraction`（v0.6.0，**与侧栏有意分叉**，见 §1.2） |

`sessionStatus.getSnapshot()` 返回 `Map<sessionId, { running, pendingInteraction, completionUnread }>`，
这是 DSH 0.2.0 的**统一会话状态面**（取代了旧的 pendingInteractions），实现在官方包
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session`（源码注释原文：*"Root source combining running,
pending-interaction, and completion-reminder facts"*）。

`pendingInteraction.kind` 的三分类（口径与 `dsh-activity-pane` 一致）：

| kind | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `approval` | 待确认授权 |
| `plan-review` | 待审查计划 |
| `question` | 待回答问题 |

其余服务：`sessions.list`（会话行，用于标题与排序）、`workspaces.list`（归档过滤）、
`uiWorkspace.openSession(id)`（跳转）。

**统计口径**：只算主会话 —— 排除 `origin === "subagent"`（子代理）、`blank`（空白会话）、
已归档会话。与官方侧栏及活动面板一致。

**「进行中」是聚合口径**（v0.4.0 修，之前只数主会话自己的 `running`，于是主智能体空闲、
子代理还在跑时侧栏转圈而桌宠报 0）。官方侧栏 `lib/.../Rows.js` 的表达式是：

```js
// runningChildCount(list, parentId, statuses)
list.projectionsBySession[parentId]?.values.subagentCatalog
  ?.reduce((n, child) => n + ((statuses.get(child.id)?.running ?? list.byId[child.id]?.running) === true ? 1 : 0), 0) ?? 0
// sessionStatuses(): node.running === true 或 runningSubagentCount > 0 → ongoing（转圈）
```

本插件用 `runningChildCount()`（`src/widget.js`）实现同一表达式，只数**直接**子级
（孙辈算在它自己的父会话上，而那个父会话不是侧栏的行 —— 与侧栏严格对齐）。
拿不到 `projectionsBySession` 或形状异常时返回 0，退化为原行为，不抛异常。

> `completionUnread` 的语义（v0.5.0 从 asar 逐行查清，官方实现）：
> ```js
> // 471629
> isMain(id) { return (this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[id]?.retainedBy.mainView ?? 0) > 0 }
> // 718647  source:"mainView" 只在 uiWorkspace.openSession 里 retain
> const reference = this.sessions.retain(target, { source: "mainView" })
> // 471603-471609
> observeRunning(sessionId, running) {
>   const previous = this.running.get(sessionId)
>   const beforeBaseline = this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().phase === "pending"
>   this.running.set(sessionId, running)
>   if (running) this.completionUnread.delete(sessionId)
>   else if ((previous === true || previous === void 0 && beforeBaseline) && !this.isMain(sessionId)) this.completionUnread.add(sessionId)
>   this.publishStatus()
> }
> // 471620  reconcileStatus 只清除 isMain 的那一个
> for (const id of present) if (this.isMain(id)) this.completionUnread.delete(id)
> ```
> **`isMain` 不是「`origin === 'main'`」，而是「你当前打开的那一个会话」**（`mainView`
> 引用同一时刻只属于一个会话）。所以：
> - 你在会话 X 里，会话 Y 跑完 → **Y 置位** → 侧栏 Y 显示 `status.completed`「已完成」
>   （718135 / 719101，字典 721643），桌宠「完成未读」+1 ✅
> - 你正开着 Y、Y 跑完 → **不置位**（你已经在看了）
> - Y 重新跑起来 / 从列表消失 → 清除
>
> 这条曾被怀疑是「对主会话恒为 false 的死信号」，**已证伪**：它是有消费者的活信号。
> `tools/smoke.mjs` 有专门用例把它钉住（非主视图计数、主视图不计数）。
>
> ⚠️ **子代理的 `completionUnread` 谁都不显示**：子代理不是侧栏的行，
> `runningChildCount` 也只数 *running* 的子代理。所以「某个子代理跑完了」在官方 UI 里
> **没有任何信号**（侧栏状态字典 721633-721643 里没有这一项）。按用户裁决，桌宠**也不**
> 把它算进「完成未读」（规则②：只有**主代理**跑完才算），加了就违背裁决。
>
> 注意区分：子代理的 **pending**（在等你交互）**已经算了**（v0.6.0，规则③，见 §1.2）；
> 子代理的 **completion**（跑完了）**不算**（规则②）。

### 1.1 多状态组合矩阵（v0.5.0 穷举并钉住）

官方侧栏的状态词表就这 7 条（asar `721633-721643`）：
`status.running` 进行中 / `status.subagentsRunning` 子智能体运行中 / `status.idle` 空闲 /
`status.waitingApproval` 等待审批 / `status.planReview` 计划待审 / `status.waitingAnswer` 等待回答 /
`status.completed` 已完成 —— **没有「排队输入」之类的状态**（`QueueDock` 的 `queue.count` 属于对话区，418359）。

桌宠气泡是**三行独立计数**，不是 `if/else` 链，所以多状态共存时不丢信息。
唯一的 `if/else` 链是角标（只有一位数字），优先级与侧栏 `statuses[0]` 同序（719092-719108）。

| 组合 | 自身 running | 子代理 running | completionUnread | pendingInteraction | 进行中 | 完成未读 | 待选择 | 情绪 | 角标 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R | ✅ | — | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| S | — | ✅ | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| R+S | ✅ | ✅ | — | — | **1**（同一会话不重复计） | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| C | — | — | ✅ | — | 0 | 1 | 0 | celebrate | 1/done |
| P:approval | — | — | — | approval | 0 | 0 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| **R+P:question** | ✅ | — | — | question | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **S+P:plan-review** | — | ✅ | — | plan-review | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **S+P(child 持有)**（v0.6.0） | — | ✅ | — | **子代理** question | **1** | 0 | **1** | waiting | 1/wait |
| **P(main)+P(child)**（v0.6.0） | — | ✅ | — | main approval **+** child question | 1 | 0 | **2** | waiting | 2/wait |
| S+C | — | ✅ | ✅ | — | 1 | **1** | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| P+C | — | — | ✅ | approval | 0 | 1 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| R+P+C（官方不可能） | ✅ | — | ✅ | approval | 1 | 1 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| P:unknown-kind | — | — | — | 未知 | 0 | 0 | 1 | waiting | 1/wait |
| 孙辈在跑 | — | 孙辈 | — | — | **0**（只数直接子级） | 0 | 0 | dozing | 0/— |
| 孙辈 pending（v0.6.0） | — | 孙辈 | — | 孙辈 question | **0**（只数直接子级） | 0 | **0** | dozing | 0/— |
| C(child 持有)（规则②） | — | — | **子代理** | — | 0 | **0**（子代理跑完不算） | 0 | dozing | 0/— |
| Q:排队输入 | ✅ | — | — | — | 1 | 0 | 0 | busy | 1/run |
| 混合 5 会话 | 3 个 | 1 个 | 1 个 | 2 个 | 3 | 1 | 2 | waiting | 2/wait |

### 1.2 规则③：子代理的待交互也算「等我选」（**有意与侧栏分叉**）

用户 2026-10-16 明确裁决：

> 我觉得桌宠显示的应该是，如果这个对话确实没进行完，**无论是主代理还是子代理，都应该挂着在跑**，
> 只有**主代理跑完了但我没点开**才会标明没看，**无论主代理或者子代理需要我交互选项卡来选择内容/一定需要我回复内容就算做等我选**

三条规则落地成：

| 数字 | 规则 | 与官方侧栏 |
|---|---|---|
| 进行中 | 主会话在跑 **OR** 直接子代理在跑 | **同口径**（`runningSubagentCount`） |
| 完成未读 | **只**看主会话自己的 `completionUnread`；子代理跑完**不算** | 同口径 |
| 待你选择 | 主会话自己的 pending **OR** 直接子代理的 pending | ⚠️ **有意分叉** |

**侧栏不显示子代理的 pending。** 依据是 `718128`：

```js
const pendingInteraction = visiblePendingKind(status?.pendingInteraction?.kind)  // 只看会话自己
```

而桌宠 v0.6.0 起把**直接子代理**的 pending 也算进来。分叉是**明示的取舍**，不是失手 ——
因为「子代理卡在问你问题」这件事，侧栏只会显示「N 个子智能体运行中」（`status.subagentsRunning`），
看不出它在等你。

**子代理的 pending 从哪读**（取证，全部 asar 行号）：

```js
// 336653  每个会话（含子代理会话）都有自己一个 scope，标签就是它的 session id
const { fiber, ctx } = createScope(this.rootCtx, id)      // ClientSessions.materializeScope(id)
// 336567  scopeOf 就是把那个标签读回来
scopeOf(ctx) { return scopeTagOf(ctx) }                    // import ... from "../scope.js"

// 386458  approval：登记在**请求方 agent 的会话**名下
const sessionId = ctx.sessions.scopeOf(owner)              // owner = $on 监听器的 scoped ctx
const pending = new PendingApproval(sessionId, {...})      // 386326 sessionId / 386353 kind="approval"

// 715845  question：同一模式
const sessionId = ctx.sessions.scopeOf(owner)
const card = cards.ensure(sessionId, request.questions, callId)   // 714228 PendingQuestion.sessionId
                                                                 // 714224 kind

// 471591-471596  公开 Map 按 interaction.sessionId 归档（**每个 sessionId 只留一个 pending**）
const precedence = domain.precedence(interaction)
if (previous === void 0 || precedence >= previous.precedence) next.set(interaction.sessionId, { interaction, precedence })

// 471631-471643  汇进同一张 uiSession.sessionStatus
const ids = new Set([
  ...Object.keys(this.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId),   // ← 子代理行也在里面（336695-336741）
  ...this.running.keys(), ...this.pendingSnapshot.keys(), ...this.completionUnread
])
for (const id of ids) next.set(id, { running: ..., pendingInteraction: this.pendingSnapshot.get(id), completionUnread: ... })

plugins.description: DSH plugin: shows the DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the composer bottom bar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-account-balance-pill

A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows the remaining balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account in the composer bottom bar — the stat row under the message box that already carries `N turns · M steps`, tokens/s, token usage and the context ring.

```
[welcome icon] 余额 ¥12.34        [stats] 1 轮 160 步 · 254 tok/s     [usage] 10.9M tok · 缓存命中 98%   (ring) 9%
```

The pill shows the **total spendable balance** (topped-up + granted) per currency, e.g. `余额 ¥17.34`; hovering it breaks the total down into topped-up and granted amounts, shows when it was last refreshed, and reminds you that a click refreshes it.

- Package name: `dsh-account-balance-pill`
- Shape: one DSH **bundle** — a Host row inserted by `dsh.bundle.patch` plus a Web Client half; no dependencies, no build step
- Rendering: a single entry (id `account-balance`) in the slot `conversation.composer.dock`, next to the shipped `activity` and `usage` pills
- Data: the account Remote that ships with DSH (`ctx.get('remote.account').getBalance(...)`, the same call the **Settings → Account** panel makes). The plugin stores nothing, reads no credential file, and makes no network request of its own.

## Install / 安装

Install from GitHub into the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:azkbzxf/dsh-account-balance-pill
```

A newly added bundle activates on the running instance (the Host row is live immediately and the Client half hot-loads into the open page). Replacing an already-installed copy needs a DSH restart for the fresh client build.

Inside DSH Desktop you can also use the plugin manager:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-account-balance-pill" }
```

Remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-account-balance-pill
```

## What it shows / 显示规则

| Account state | Bottom bar |
| --- | --- |
| Signed in with a balance | Wallet icon + `余额 ¥12.34`; tooltip with the topped-up / granted breakdown, last-update time and a click-to-refresh hint |
| Signed out, or no account grant (the Remote returns `null`) | Nothing — no placeholder, no error |
| Read failure (offline, host refused) | Keeps the last known value, dimmed as stale; stays hidden if no value was ever read |
| Currencies | `¥` for CNY and `$` for USD; topped-up + granted are combined per currency, CNY first |

Amounts are formatted by truncating to cents, matching the official Settings page so the pill never shows more money than is actually available; thousands are grouped. `0` shows `¥0.00`, anything under one cent shows `<¥0.01`.

## Refresh / 刷新时机

1. immediately when the pill mounts;
2. every 30 s while the page is visible (skipped while hidden, one catch-up read when it becomes visible again);
3. 1.5 s after a turn completes (when the `sessionStats` projection's `steps` changes);
4. when the window regains focus or the page becomes visible (only if the data is older than 15 s);
5. as soon as a late-loading account Remote appears;
6. on click.

One request is in flight at a time, requests are at least 3 s apart, and failures back off exponentially from 4 s up to 60 s before recovering automatically.

## Compatibility / 兼容性

- Targets the DSH Web GUI (the browser UI shared by DSH Desktop and `dsh web`), verified on DSH Desktop 2.0.18 with client `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- Uses only supported extension points: the list slot `conversation.composer.dock` and the shipped account Remote. It never replaces or edits existing UI, never reads another plugin's DOM or styles, never appends to `document.body`.
- Styles use Harness theme tokens only (`--dsw-*` / `--dsh-*`), so light/dark themes and font-size changes are inherited. All visible text goes through the DSH client locale service (zh/en) and follows the interface language.
- Every dependency is optional: no account Remote → the plugin loads and stays hidden; a read failure keeps the last value; a render failure is caught by an error boundary scoped to this one entry, so the rest of the dock is unaffected.
- The account service is read through the service registry (`ctx.get('remote.account')`) because the `ctx.remote.account` property chain is only readable from contexts that declare that dependency explicitly.
- `package.json` exports `"./package.json"` because DSH's client-module composition locates the package manifest through that export, and the `dsh.bundle.patch` row `name` matches the package name.
- The Host half is a no-op: it registers no credential, network client, tool or session resource.

## Configuration / 可调参数

The poll interval can be overridden globally (milliseconds, clamped to 5 s – 1 h):

```js
window.__DSH_ACCOUNT_BALANCE__ = { intervalMs: 60000 };
```

## Development / 开发

`test/harness.mjs` is an offline smoke test: it loads `client.js` with stub React/document/locale/slots/remote implementations and asserts the slot registration, locale namespace, request metadata, formatting, hidden/stale states and timer counts.

```sh
node test/harness.mjs client.js
```

File map: `client.js` — Client half (pill, store, formatting, styles); `index.js` — no-op Host half; `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch; `locale/{en,zh}.json` — display metadata for the plugin list; `icon.svg` — artwork.

## Known limitations / 已知限制

- The balance comes from the DeepSeek account platform and is up to a few seconds behind, not ledger-real-time.
- The dock row only renders while a session's composer is visible (existing behaviour of the shipped slot).
- If the platform keeps failing while signed in, the plugin keeps backing off and logs one console warning on the first failure; it never opens a dialog.

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read the document the user has open in Word/Excel/PowerPoint, screenshot the app window, and edit it in place through COM.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-office-live

Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read, screenshot and edit **the document the user
currently has open** in Word / Excel / PowerPoint — no file round-trips, no "close and
reopen", the change appears in the window the user is looking at.

Unlike `dsh-office-tools` (which reads and writes `.docx`/`.xlsx`/`.pptx` files), this plugin
attaches to the **running Office application** through COM and works on the live document —
including whatever the user has typed since the file was saved.

## Demo

A live Word window after `office_live_edit` appended two sections and a table — the change is
already on screen, nothing was saved:

![live Word edit](docs/images/word-live.png)

Excel: `office_live_read` returned the evaluated formula values, then `excel.set_cell` wrote a
new "备注" column into the open workbook:

![live Excel edit](docs/images/excel-live.png)

PowerPoint: `ppt.set_text` rewrote the bullet list and `ppt.add_slide` added the second slide:

![live PowerPoint edit](docs/images/powerpoint-live.png)

> How it is built (three layers, the JSON bridge, why results go through a UTF-8 side file,
> why edits are not saved by default): **[docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md)** (in Chinese).

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `office_live_status` | Which of Word / Excel / PowerPoint is running and which documents are open |
| `office_live_read` | Read live contents as JSON (Word paragraphs + styles, Excel cells with evaluated formulas, PowerPoint shapes) |
| `office_live_shot` | PNG screenshot of the application window (ribbon and page) |
| `office_live_snapshot` | `read` + `shot` in one call — best starting point before editing |
| `office_live_edit` | Batch live edits (paragraphs, find/replace, tables, cells, slides) |
| `office_live_open` | Open a file in the real application so edits are visible on screen |
| `office_live_close` | Close the window (optionally saving) |

`office_live_edit` operations:

- Word — `word.append_paragraph`, `word.insert_paragraph_before`, `word.set_paragraph`,
  `word.replace`, `word.insert_table`, `word.insert_page_break`
- Excel — `excel.set_cell`, `excel.set_range`, `excel.add_sheet`
- PowerPoint — `ppt.set_text`, `ppt.add_slide`

## Requirements

- Windows with a desktop Microsoft Office installation (COM ProgIDs `Word.Application`,
  `Excel.Application`, `PowerPoint.Application`). Tested with Office LTSC 2024.
- Windows PowerShell 5.1+ (`powershell.exe`); override with the `OFFICE_LIVE_POWERSHELL`
  environment variable (for example `pwsh.exe`).
- Maybe counter-intuitive but real Office only. Microsoft Store "Office" stubs and web
  versions expose no COM automation; WPS Office uses different ProgIDs.

## Safety

- Attaches to an **already running** instance; it never creates a hidden copy of a document.
- Edits are **not saved** unless `save: true` is passed, so the user can review the change
  in the window, undo it with Ctrl+Z, or ask for more changes first.
- Word reads are capped at the first 400 paragraphs; Excel reads the active sheet's used
  range up to 200 rows × 40 columns.
- Taking a screenshot brings the window to the foreground (it steals focus for a moment).

## Install

```bash
# from the plugin market UI: add  dsh-office-live
# or from a checkout / tarball:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-office-live-0.1.0.tgz
```

Then restart DSH. The tools appear in every new session.

## How it is wired

`lib/index.js` registers the seven tools with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and shells out to
`assets/office-live.ps1`, passing `-ResultFile` (a UTF-8 side file, so Chinese text is not
mangled by the Windows console code page). The script does the COM and screenshot work and
prints one JSON object per call.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH PTC run_code parse-error position plugin (line + code frame)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ptc-parse-frame

> 给 DSH 的 PTC（Programmatic Tool Calling）补上「解析失败时的行号 + 代码框」。

## 这是什么

在 DSH 里，`run_code` 的程序在执行前会先经过 TypeScript 类型剥离
（`stripTypeScriptTypes`）。语法出错时，DSH 只把 `error.message` 转发给模型，
丢掉了错误栈里的行号和 `^^^` 代码框。于是漏一个逗号只会得到：

    code run failed (exception): Expected ',', got 'string literal'

模型不知道是哪一行、哪个字符串列表漏了，只能整段重吐重试。

本仓库提供一个 Host 插件，把这段位置信息补回去（真实结果还会带运行时自己的
`File sandbox:` 行，插件把代码框插在解析消息之后、这些后缀之前）：

    Error: code run failed (exception): Expected ',', got 'string literal'
    run_code.ts:1
    const a = ["x" "y"];
                   ^^^
    File sandbox: workspace-write.

## 状态

**0.2.0 已实现并安装。** 这是一个 Host-only 的 profile bundle：

- 监听 `tools/post-execute`，只在 `run_code` 的解析失败上改写结果；
- 自带 23 个单元测试，覆盖行号、代码框、运行时异常、幂等、配置与回退；
- 已通过 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 安装到 `desktop` profile；
- 端到端用例已在 PTC 会话中通过（用例 1–5、13，见 docs/verification.md）。

## 安装

仓库目录本身就是 bundle 根目录（`package.json` 声明了
`dsh.bundle.patch`）。首选官方入口：

    plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本仓库绝对路径>

安装会：

1. 把本目录作为 `link:` 依赖加入 profile；
2. 把 `dsh-ptc-parse-frame` 加入 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
3. 立即应用 bundle patch（`patchReload: live`）。

卸载：

    plugin_manager  action: remove_bundle  target: dsh-ptc-parse-frame

> 修改 `index.js` 之后，需要让 Host 做一次 profile recomposition（例如
> 开关一次 bundle）或重启 DSH NEXT，运行中的进程才会加载新的模块版本。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 的默认行：

    - insert:
        - id: ptc-parse-frame
          name: dsh-ptc-parse-frame
          config:
            enabled: true
            maxFrameLines: 10
            sourceName: run_code.ts

| 配置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 设为 `false` 时插件完全 no-op（但保持已安装）。 |
| `maxFrameLines` | `10` | 代码框正文的最大行数（1–40），优先保留 caret 附近的行。 |
| `sourceName` | `run_code.ts` | 行号前缀，也是「已经带位置」检测用的名字。 |

## 行为边界

插件只在以下条件**同时**成立时改写结果：

1. 工具名是 `run_code`；
2. 结果 `isError: true`；
3. 工具参数里有原始 `code`；
4. 错误消息以 `code run failed (exception): <parser message>` 开头；
5. 用与运行时相同的包装重新解析原始 `code` 仍然失败，且解析器消息与第 4 步一致；
6. 结果文本里还没有 `run_code.ts:<数字>` 形式的位置。

任一条件不满足就原样返回。运行时异常（例如 `throw new Error("boom")`）的程序
能正常解析，因此不会被误判；其它工具的结果完全不经过改写。

插件自身抛错时返回下游 listener 的原始 decision，绝不改变失败原因。

## 兼容性

| 版本 | 形态 | 本仓库是否适用 |
|---|---|---|
| DSH Desktop 2.0.17（PTC 0.2.0-rc.2） | resources/app 解包 | 旧方案：文件补丁（legacy，见 docs/compatibility.md） |
| DSH NEXT 2.0.19-next（PTC 0.2.1-rc.2） | resources/app.asar + profile 插件 | **本插件** |

## 开发与测试

无运行时依赖，测试直接使用 Node 24 的 `node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes`：

    npm test

等价于：

    node test/plugin.test.mjs

`node --test` 在 DSH 沙箱里会因为测试运行器需要 spawn 子进程而报 `EPERM`，
所以脚本直接运行测试文件（`node:test` 在单文件模式下进程内执行）。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| docs/overview.md | 问题、目标、非目标 |
| docs/background.md | 根因与证据 |
| docs/compatibility.md | 两版本差异与旧方案为何失效 |
| docs/design.md | 插件设计 |
| docs/implementation-plan.md | 实施计划与验收标准 |
| docs/verification.md | 验证矩阵与记录 |
| docs/publishing.md | 发布到 GitHub 的步骤 |
| docs/upstream.md | 上游 issue/discussion 现状与评论草稿 |
| docs/research-notes.md | 复现、源码取证与 API 确认 |
| docs/upstream-comment.md | 可直接粘贴到 #7618 的评论草稿 |

## 许可

MIT，见 LICENSE。

plugins.description: SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: dsh models parts, assembles them, checks interference, counts the BOM and makes drawings in a running SOLIDWORKS 2016+, on the same PC or in a Windows VM. Your files read-only by default.
plugins.readme_text:
``` ___ _ __ dsh-solidworks / __| \ / / \__ \\ \/\/ / SOLIDWORKS for DeepSeek Harness: |___/ \_/\_/ model, assemble, check, draw and export, in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk ``` **dsh drives the SOLIDWORKS you already have open: 2016 and later, on the same PC or in a Windows VM on your Mac.**

21 tools · verified on SOLIDWORKS 2016 SP1 and 2019 SP0 · one bridge exe, no runtime to install, no admin · your files read-only by default · MIT

Watch it · Get started · Tools · What it will not do · How it works · Proof · When to skip it · llms.txt · 中文

---

**One paragraph in, a flange out.** You describe the part; dsh models it in the SOLIDWORKS on your desk, checks the volume against its own arithmetic (158,983.493 mm³ both ways), and looks at it from four sides. It can also put parts together, check them for collisions, count a bill of materials, make the drawing, and work on the files you already have, read-only unless you say otherwise. ## Watch it Every clip is a real session: dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 with `deepseek-flash`, SOLIDWORKS 2019 SP0 in a Parallels VM, recorded from the SOLIDWORKS window. The captions are the session's own tool calls and results, and its own closing words. Time spent thinking is fast-forwarded; nothing is cut or reordered. [How the clips are made](scripts/clips/README.md). ### Point at it You select a face in SOLIDWORKS and say what to do with it. dsh reads your selection (the flange's top face, 8 edges), rounds every edge of it at 2 mm, and explains why the volume went down by 360.218 mm³ even though one fillet adds material.

### Put parts together, check they fit A shaft is modeled, both parts saved, and assembled with the shaft through the bore and the flange 40 mm up. Interference: 0 pairs. dsh also counts faces that only touch, and points out that a 30 mm shaft in a 30 mm bore is a line-to-line fit. Then the bill of materials.

### Draw it The drawing lays its views out in projection at the largest standard scale that fits, brings in the model's dimensions, and comes back to your workspace as a PDF.

Left: the PDF as exported. Right: sw_view, four views on one picture, which is how dsh looks at what it made.

## Get started You need dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or later (its `dsh plugin add` uses pnpm, so pnpm on the PATH) and a running SOLIDWORKS 2016 or later. ### dsh and SOLIDWORKS on the same Windows PC ``` dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks ``` Start SOLIDWORKS, start dsh, ask. The plugin runs its bundled `swbridge.exe` on the first SOLIDWORKS question; there is nothing to pair or install. ### dsh on a Mac, SOLIDWORKS in a Windows VM 1. On the Mac: `dsh plugin --profile web add @dshworks/dsh-solidworks`, then start dsh once. It listens for the bridge and writes a pairing kit. 2. In the VM, signed in as the person who uses SOLIDWORKS, open `\\Mac\Home\.dsh\dsh-solidworks\windows\` (Parallels shares your Mac home folder there) and double-click `pair.cmd`. That installs the bridge for that Windows user, connects it to dsh, and starts it at every sign-in. No administrator, no firewall rule: the bridge dials out to dsh, so Windows never opens a port. If you ask dsh before pairing, the answer says where the kit is. On VMware, another PC, or a Mac without Parallels sharing, copy the `~/.dsh/dsh-solidworks/windows/` folder to the Windows machine and run `pair.cmd` there. If the VM reaches your Mac on an address the kit did not list, set it: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: dsh-solidworks config: advertise: ['10.211.55.2'] # Parallels' usual host address ``` Undo it in the VM with `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-solidworks\swbridge.exe uninstall`. ### Any other MCP client, on the Windows PC `swbridge.exe mcp` is a plain stdio MCP server with the same 21 tools: ``` claude mcp add solidworks -- C:\tools\swbridge.exe mcp ``` The exe is in this package at `bin/swbridge.exe` and on every [GitHub release](https://github.com/dshworks/dsh-solidworks/releases) with its SHA-256. ## Tools Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees, mass kilograms, whatever units the document uses; field names say so (`value_mm`, `mass_kg`). Geometry is addressed in one space everywhere: model-space points `[x, y, z]` in mm, Y up, the front plane at z = 0, top at y = 0, right at x = 0. Faces and edges are picked by a point on them. `doc` is a path, file name or title of an open document and defaults to the active one.
All 21 tools | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `sw_status` | Release (2016 SP1, 2019 SP0, ...), every SOLIDWORKS instance, the open documents, and any dialog SOLIDWORKS is waiting on. Called first. | | `sw_open` | Open a `.sldprt`, `.sldasm` or `.slddrw`, read-only unless asked, and activate it. | | `sw_new` | A new, empty part or assembly from SOLIDWORKS' default template. | | `sw_inspect` | Type, units, configurations, material, custom properties, bounding box, body and component counts. | | `sw_features` | The feature tree with suppression state and rebuild errors. | | `sw_parameters` | Every dimension (`D1@Sketch1`, value, unit, driven or not) and equation, global variables marked. | | `sw_components` | An assembly's component tree: file, configuration, state, fixed, position. | | `sw_mass_properties` | Mass, volume, surface area, density, centre of mass. | | `sw_probe` | What is at a point: the face, edge or vertex there, with its surface or curve, area or length, normal or axis, diameter and the feature that made it. Without points, whatever the user has selected in SOLIDWORKS right now. Two entities also give the distance and angle between them. | | `sw_edit` | In memory, then one rebuild: configuration, suppress/unsuppress, global variables, dimensions, custom properties. Each change comes back with before, after and its own outcome. | | `sw_build` | Model a part in steps: sketch (lines, polylines, rectangles, circles, arcs, centerlines) on a plane or a face, extrude or cut (blind, through all, mid-plane, draft), revolve, fille

plugins.description: A local token usage, API call, and cache statistics dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-TokenDashboard **Your local token usage, API calls, and cache activity in one dashboard.** A lightweight plugin for DeepSeek Harness. No build step. No runtime dependencies. No additional API key. [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Runtime dependencies: 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime_dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg) ![Built for DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/built_for-DeepSeek_Harness-4D6BFE.svg) [Features](#features) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [How counting works](#how-counting-works) · [FAQ](#faq)
_Preview uses sample data. The plugin follows your DSH theme._ ## Why DSH-TokenDashboard? See how much you use across sessions, which projects drive token consumption, and how often your input hits the cache. The dashboard reads existing session logs in your current DSH profile and presents the results inside the native sidebar. ## Features | Feature | What you get | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Usage at a glance | Total tokens, API calls, uncached input, output, cache reads, and cache hit rate | | Flexible summaries | Last 7, 30, or 90 days, or all time, with active session counts | | Activity calendar | 52 weeks of square, rounded cells; hover or focus for exact daily numbers | | Daily cache trends | Stacked input tokens: cache misses below cache hits, with a visible zero baseline | | Adjustable chart range | Zoom from 7 to 30 days; compact K/M/B axis labels | | Model and project breakdowns | Token rankings and API call counts by model/provider and working directory | | Native presentation | Light/dark themes, responsive layout, English and Simplified Chinese | | Refresh controls | Manual refresh or automatic refresh every 30 seconds; polling pauses while the page is hidden | ## Quick start ### 1. Install from npm Use the DSH CLI available in your installation: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @ningtian-byte/dsh-tokendashboard ``` Alternatively, install directly from GitHub: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:NingTiAn-byte/DSH-TokenDashboard ``` ### 2. Desktop or local installation For Desktop, use the CLI bundled with the Desktop application: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NingTiAn-byte/DSH-TokenDashboard ``` Alternatively, download **Code → Download ZIP**, extract it, and install the directory containing `package.json` through the DSH plugin manager or CLI: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "/absolute/path/to/DSH-TokenDashboard" ``` On Windows, paths such as `C:/plugins/DSH-TokenDashboard` work as well. Quote paths that contain spaces. If `dsh` is not on PATH, use its installed executable or command file. The source CLI may reject the Desktop profile; use the Desktop-bundled CLI for that profile. ### 3. Open the dashboard Restart DSH and select **Usage statistics** in the sidebar. Existing completed requests appear automatically; the plugin does not need to run a new model request. > **Compatibility:** Requires DSH with `sessionPersistence`, `connection`, slot, locale, and theme APIs. DSH plugin APIs may change between releases; check compatibility with your installed version. ## Using the dashboard - Select a summary range at the top. Summary metrics and rankings follow this range. - Hover over or keyboard-focus a calendar cell or daily bar for exact usage and API call counts. Press **Escape** to dismiss the tooltip. - Drag the trend slider to show the latest **7–30 days**. One month means a rolling 30-day window. - Calendar history and the trend window are independent of the summary range. Changing that range preserves the trend zoom. - Toggle automatic refresh at the bottom of the page. ## How counting works | Metric | Definition | | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Total tokens | Provider-reported `totalTokens`, or uncached input + output + cache reads + cache writes when unavailable | | Input | Uncached input only; excludes cache reads and writes | | Output | Provider-reported output; reasoning tokens are not added a second time | | Cache hit rate | Cache reads ÷ (uncached input + cache reads + cache writes); `—` when the denominator is zero | | API calls | Settled `assistant/message` and `assistant/attempt` records, including settled failures and attempts without usage | | Daily bars | Input only: cache miss = uncached input + cache writes; cache hit = cache reads | | Sessions | Sessions with at least one settled request in the selected summary range | An in-progress request appears after settlement. Requests without usage increase the API call count but do not add estimated tokens. Repeated settlements for the same attempt are deduplicated; retry attempts count separately, and inherited fork records are excluded. Days follow the browser's IANA time zone. Calendar weeks start on Monday. Output contributes to total tokens and tooltip details, but is not stacked in the input-cache chart. ## Data and privacy The plugin reads local session logs through read-only handles. It does not modify logs, call model APIs, or upload usage data. Numeric summaries, model names, session IDs, and working directories are kept in memory for the dashboard; prompt and response content is not retained in that cache. Each changed session is read in full before its numeric summary is cached by persistence revision. Very large logs can make the first load or a refresh slower. Unreadable sessions produce a visible partial-statistics warning. This is a token accounting view, not a billing or network bandwidth meter. Provider billing may use different accounting rules. ## FAQ ### Why is the dashboard empty? It only sees the session data source available to the current DSH profile. Complete a request in that profile, then refresh. Requests that are still streaming have not settled yet. ### Why do token totals differ from the provider's bill? The dashboard uses usage reported in local logs and has no access to billing adjustments or external requests. It does not estimate missing usage or calculate monetary costs. ### Why doesn't the chart match the selected summary period? The activity calendar always covers 52 weeks. The daily chart has its own 7–30 day window and displays input tokens only. The summary range applies to the headline metrics and rankings. ### How do I update or uninstall it? Replace or reinstall the plugin files, then restart DSH. Remove or disable the plugin through the DSH plugin manager to uninstall it. Session logs remain unchanged. ## Project structure ```text token-monitor/ ├── client.js # Dashboard, chart interactions, styles, and UI dictionaries ├── index.js # Read-only route and session summary cache ├── usage.js # Request deduplication and token aggregation ├── cordis.patch.yml # DSH bundle registration ├── icon.svg # Sidebar/plugin icon ├── locale/ # Plugin metadata translations ├── docs/images/ # Light and dark README previews ├── RE

# dsh-session-janitor · DSH 会话清理

给 DSH 用的会话记录清理工具：**列表 → 勾选 → 移入回收站 → 可恢复 → 确认后彻底清空**。
删除永不直接抹掉，先移进 `~/.dsh/session-trash/<时间戳>/`，所以手滑也能救回来。

## 两种用法

### 一、独立版（立刻可用，不需要重启 DSH）

双击本目录里的 **`启动会话清理.cmd`**，浏览器会打开 `http://127.0.0.1:8788/dsh-session-janitor/`。
关掉那个最小化的黑窗口即停止服务。端口被占用时可手动跑：

```
node standalone.mjs --port 8899 --open
```

### 二、DSH 插件版（推荐 · 已安装）

**2026-10-18 09:3x 已装进 desktop 档案**（`dsh.profile.bundles` 共 12 项，依赖 `link:` 指向本目录）。
**重启 DSH 后生效**：左侧边栏出现 🧹「会话清理」图标，点开就是完整界面（独立页面，不占会话）。
也可以直接访问 `http://127.0.0.1:<DSH GUI 端口>/dsh-session-janitor/`（由 DSH 自己的 web 服务提供，与 GUI 同源）。

重新安装 / 装到别的档案：

```
node install-plugin.mjs            # 演练：只打印将要做什么
node install-plugin.mjs --apply    # 真装（会先备份 profile 的 package.json）
```

卸载：把 `dsh-session-janitor` 从 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉、
并执行 `pnpm remove dsh-session-janitor`（或直接用备份 `package.json.bak-<时间戳>` 覆盖回去），然后重启 DSH。

> 客户端半侧是**手写的 `lib/client.js`**（无构建步骤），走 `sidebar.panellist` + `main` 两个槽位；
> 宿主半侧 `lib/index.js` 注册同源 HTTP 路由。二者靠 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的宿主条目被发现。

## 界面能做什么

| 区块 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| 会话记录 | 勾选 → 移入回收站；「只选 30 天前」一键勾选老会话；`全选 / 清空选择` |
| 归档缓存 | 清理 `session_projcache_archive_manager_v2` 里的历史归档条目 |
| 回收站 | 勾选 → 恢复到原位置；`彻底清空回收站`（不可恢复） |
| 顶部 | `刷新`、`打开回收站文件夹`、`打开会话目录`、`强制` 开关 |

- **使用中保护**：会话的“最后活动时间”取 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 的 mtime，
  最近 **10 分钟**内被写过的会话标黄，默认**服务端拒绝删除**（勾「强制」才放行）。
- **同时清理列表缓存**：删会话时会把 `storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
  一起移进回收站，恢复时一并还原，避免出现“缓存有、正文没”的孤儿条目。
- **安全**：只监听 `127.0.0.1`；每个请求都校验 `Host` 必须是本机回环、
  `Origin` 必须同源、`Sec-Fetch-Site` 不能是 `cross-site`，否则 403。
  所有路径都做白名单校验（禁止 `..` 与目录穿越）。

## 目录与接口

被测数据的默认根目录是 `~/.dsh`（可用环境变量 `DSCC_ROOT` 覆盖，测试用）：

```
sessions/<项目>/<会话>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd                       会话正文
storages/session_projcache/sessions/<sessionId>.json              标题 / cwd / 轮数
storages/session_projcache_archive_manager_v2/sessions/*.json      已裁剪归档
session-trash/<时间戳>/manifest.json                               本工具的回收站（含还原路径）
```

HTTP 接口（插件版挂在 DSH 端口，独立版在 8788）：

```
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/            网页界面
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/api/ping    存活探测 + 数据根目录
GET  /dsh-session-janitor/api/list    会话 / 归档 / 回收站清单
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/trash   {items:[{kind:"session",project,id}|{kind:"archive",file}],force?}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/restore {ids:["<桶>:<序号>"]}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/purge   {bucket?}
POST /dsh-session-janitor/api/reveal  {what:"trash"|"sessions"}
```

## 开发 / 自测

```
node --check lib/store.js
node --check lib/index.js
```

`lib/store.js` 是纯文件系统逻辑（不依赖 DSH），用临时假目录即可全量回归；
`lib/index.js` 的路由可用假 `ctx` + 假 `req/res` 直接调 `apply(ctx)` 验证。

## 已知边界

- 插件版要 **重启 DSH** 才会挂上路由；独立版不需要。
- 「使用中」判定靠写入时间，不是文件锁：正在被写入的会话靠 10 分钟窗口 + 文件占用（rename 失败）双重保护。
- 只处理会话与归档缓存；**不动** `schedule.json`、`workspace.json`、用量账本等运行状态。

## 收录到插件市场（awesome-dsh-plugin）

本插件按市场规范投稿：**一个 YAML 条目文件**（`data/plugins/<owner>__dsh-session-janitor.yml`）
就是全部投稿内容，市场从 **GitHub 仓库**安装（npm 发布是可选的，只影响市场显示下载量）。

仓库侧要求（都已满足）：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle`（`./cordis.patch.yml`）、仓库根有
`cordis.patch.yml`、仓库带 `dsh-plugin` topic、仓库创建满 1 天、代码真实可用。
投稿条目内容见 `market-entry.yml`（市场只收 GitHub 仓库，一个 YAML 文件就是全部投稿）。

## 作者 / 许可

- 作者：**dsh**
- 许可：MIT（见 `LICENSE`）

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness overlay showing OpenCode Go 5-hour, weekly and monthly usage.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencodego-status

A floating overlay for the **DeepSeek Harness Web UI** that shows your **OpenCode Go**
usage — the 5-hour rolling limit, the weekly limit and the monthly limit — at a glance.

![OpenCode Go usage overlay, collapsed pill](docs/pill.svg)

The collapsed pill lives in the corner of the window and shows the three percentages
with a colour dot per limit. Click it for progress bars, reset countdowns, the renewal
date, and the sign-in controls.

![OpenCode Go usage overlay, expanded card](docs/card.svg)

## What you get

- **Collapsed pill** — `5h · 7d · 30d` percentages, coloured by how close you are to the
  limit (brand → warning from 60% → error from 80%), plus the weekly reset countdown.
- **Expanded card** — one progress bar per limit, `resets in` and `renews in` countdowns,
  Refresh, Sign out, and a link to the OpenCode console.
- **Device-code sign-in** — connect from the overlay; the code is shown in the card and
  approved in the browser. No password is ever typed into the overlay.
- **Silent token refresh** — the stored session is refreshed before it expires.
- **English and Chinese UI**, following the Harness locale service.
- **Theme-aware** — every colour and border comes from the Harness theme tokens, so light
  and dark themes both look native.

The numbers come from the OpenCode Console Go subscription meters, the same source the
console page itself renders.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness Web UI (`0.2.x`).
- An **OpenCode Go** subscription. The overlay reads the Go plan meters; it shows
  `Not connected` when no OpenCode session is stored, and an error state when the
  subscription is missing or the API changes.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Assidefok/dsh-opencodego-status
```

Then refresh the Harness Web UI. A small pill appears in the top-right corner.

### Connect

1. Click the pill, then **Connect**.
2. The card shows a short code (for example `GNNM-XQHS`) and an **Open approval page**
   button. Approve the device in the browser.
3. The overlay switches to your live usage as soon as the console confirms.

The session is stored locally at `$DSH_HOME/opencodego-status/state.json` with `0600`
permissions (`$DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`). **Sign out** in the card deletes it.
Tokens are sent only to `opencode.ai`; the browser half never receives them.

## Configuration

The bundle row in the Harness profile's `cordis.patch.yml` accepts:

```yaml
- id: opencodego-status
  name: dsh-opencodego-status
  config:
    enabled: true        # hide the overlay without uninstalling the bundle
    position: top-right  # top-right | top-left | bottom-right | bottom-left
    refreshSeconds: 60   # 15 – 3600
    showResets: true     # show reset countdowns
```

## How it works

- The **host half** (`index.js`) registers a prefix route at
  `/api/opencodego-status` and talks to the OpenCode Console:
  `<origin>/console/auth/device/code`, `<origin>/console/auth/device/token` (device
  grant and refresh grant) and `<origin>/console/api/go/status`.
- The **client half** (`client.js`) registers one entry in the `shell.overlay` slot and
  polls `/api/opencodego-status/status`. It never sees an access token.
- No dependencies, no build step: the client module is plain JavaScript and React comes
  from the Harness browser module table.

> The console endpoint is not a documented public API. If OpenCode changes it, the
> overlay degrades to an error state with a Retry button instead of breaking the UI.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Version browser for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list published versions, switch or roll back, and uninstall from the Plugins page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-versions

Version browser for **DeepSeek Harness** plugins. It adds an **Installed plugins** page under **Settings → Plugins** where you can see every published version of an installed plugin, switch to one, roll back, or uninstall it — all through the host's own `pluginManager` service.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

## Why

The official plugin manager intentionally has no version picker: third-party plugins are upgraded by uninstalling and reinstalling, and only official on-demand bundles get an explicit **Update** button. Pinning a known-good version, or returning to one after a regression, means editing `package.json` by hand.

This plugin adds exactly that missing surface, without replacing the market or the installer.

## Features

- Lists the bundles the current profile installs, with version, source spec, and whether the bundle is removable
- Expands a bundle into its full published version list from the registry (publish date, `latest`, deprecated flags)
- Switches version through `pluginManager.removeBundle` → `pluginManager.installBundle`, saving an exact dependency
- **Automatic rollback**: if the target version fails to install (peer gate, missing version, network), the previous version is installed back and the failure is reported
- Uninstalls a profile bundle from the same tab
- Works with the profile's configured registry (private registries included) and falls back to `registry.npmjs.org`

## Install

The npm package is not published yet, so install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions
```

or with an explicit Git URL:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions.git
```

In DSH Desktop the `desktop` profile is managed by the application, so use **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions` instead of the CLI. Restart or refresh the page afterwards. Add `#<tag>` or `#<commit>` to pin a revision.

Once published to npm, `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-versions` will work as well.

## Use

1. Open **Settings → Plugins**.
2. Select the **Installed plugins** tab.
3. Expand a plugin to see its versions. The current one is tagged, and the newest is tagged `latest`.
4. **Switch** asks for confirmation, then removes and reinstalls the plugin at that version. A failure rolls back automatically.
5. **Uninstall** removes the bundle; its configuration is kept.

Refresh the page after a switch so the browser loads the other version's client half.

## How a switch works

```
pluginManager.listBundles()        find the installed bundle, remember its version
pluginManager.removeBundle(name)   unload + remove the dependency
pluginManager.installBundle(name@version, { saveExact: true, enabled: true })
   ├─ success → ChangeResult.application: applied | restart-required
   └─ failure → remove the half-installed package, install the previous version
```

`installBundle` refuses a package the profile already depends on (`already-installed`) in HMR profiles, which is why the removal is not optional. The host performs the same check before pnpm runs, so an incompatible peer range is reported without touching the profile.

## HTTP surface

The client half talks to the host half over one loopback-only route:

```
POST /plugin-versions/api/{list|versions|switch|remove}
```

Requests must carry `x-requested-with: XMLHttpRequest`, must not be `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`, and must arrive on a loopback `Host` (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`). Only bundles already installed in this profile can be switched or removed, so the route cannot be used as a general package installer.

## Limitations

- Loopback only: a page served with `--trusted-host` from another machine is refused.
- No automatic update check; this is a version browser, not an updater.
- Compatibility is not pre-checked per version — the host rejects an incompatible version and the switch rolls back.
- A switch needs `HMR` to apply live; without it the host reports `restart-required`.
- The page must be refreshed before the new version's client half runs.

## Development

Plain ESM, no build step:

```
index.js          host half: HTTP route + pluginManager calls
client.js         browser bundle: registers the Versions tab into plugins.tab
cordis.patch.yml  inserts the bundle row
locale/*.json     bundle title and description
```

Point the installer at this directory (`dsh plugin add <path>`, or **Add plugin** with an absolute path). The directory is linked, so edits take effect after a restart.

## License

MIT
